text.body:
karmmapradaupaḥ |
prathamaprapāṭhake prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ṃ namaḥ sāmavedāya | śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśasyānukramaṇikā | yasyājñā jayati śrutismṛtimay yatpādapāymay- dhammaḥ kaiścidupāsyate sukṛtibhirgaṅgetyabhikhyāṃ gataḥ | yaṃ jytimmaiyamantarudbhavatama chettuṃ puraskurvate santaḥ, pātu jagañcaturmukhagirāmardhaḥ sa dev hariḥ || 1 || iha jagati vanditapādāḥ sadā narendraḥ pavitrajanmānaḥ | vasudhāsudhābhujaḥ kati nābhūvan kāntivilīyāḥ || 2 || caritamahati teṣāmanvaye smapy samajani paritṣaśchandasāṃ dehabandha: | alabhata sa hi viprācchāsanaṃ tālavā tadiha bhajati pūjāmuttarā yena rāḍhā || 3 || tasmāñcaturthakhaṇḍaṃ piśācakhaṇḍaṃ tathāca vāparth ūlājā | dvijavarṇādikamaparaṃ niḥsṛtamanaghaṅgulasthānam || 4||
bāpā iti va pustake pāṭhaḥ | kapradīpaḥ | jajñe bhūvalayapāvanaheturekaḥ śraute vidhau satata nimmaṃladhīprasāraḥ | prāk pūjit vibudhasaṃsadi dha nāmā nāmānurūpacaritaḥ paritṣasūnuḥ || 5 || tasmādajāyata sadāyatanaṃ guṇānāṃ madrekharī nikhilakvidabandanīyaḥ | madhye satāṃ sthitimatāṃ prathamābhiṣeyaḥ sevābhiṣiktahṛdayaḥ padayrmurāreḥ || 6 || tasmādadādhara iti dijacakravartī [ 1pra. 9kha. ] rājapratigrahaparāmukhamānas'bhūt | puṇyāni kevalamaharniśamajayan yaḥ śāntañcirāya samayaṅgamayāmbabhūva || 7 || tasmādbhūṣitasāvibhūmivalayaḥ śiṣypaśiṣyavrajai- viṃḍamaulirabhūdumāpatiriti prābhākaragrāmaṇīḥ | māpālājjayapālataḥ sa hi mahāvāhaṃ prabhūtaṃ mahā- dānaścārthigaṇārthanārdahṛdayaḥ pratyagrahītpuṇyavān || 8|| tasyānujaḥ sukṛtavāntha kṛtasarvaskhadakṣiṇ bahudhā | udiyāya gnanāmā gururiva tantre purāṇajñaḥ || 8 || śavaddiśvajanīna " nirmalaguṇe bhūlkavācaspatī preśatkrttisaritpravāhanivahapracālitāśāmukhe |
mahāśrāde, irtika pustake pāṭhaḥ | tasā iti va pustake pāṭhaḥ | viprajanīna, iti pustake pāū kapradīpaḥ | yasmin kṛṣṇapadaikalīna hṛdaye dhanmādhikārāspadaṃ bibhrāṇe dvijamandirāṇyadhivasan nirdhūtadṣāḥ śriyaḥ ||10|| [ 1pra. 1kha. ] jātastataḥ smṛtipurāṇavidāmupāsya- vidyaḥ prabhākaramatasthitilabdhaktiḥ | natraḥ satāṃ sadasi mitrajaneṣu ca śrī. - nārāyaṇaḥ satatakṛṣṇaparāyaṇatmā || 11 || chandgapariśiṣṭasya sarvārthālkahetave | pariśiṣṭamakāmākhyaścakre tenaiṣa * dhīmatā || prabhāyā anukramaṇikā | yasmāt sarvvaṃ yataḥ sarvve yasmin savyaṃ pralīyate | yaca sarvvagataṃ sarvaṃ tanmahaḥ samupāsmahe || pratyuhavyūhavidhvastyai ṭuṇḍirājamahaṃ bhaje | viśveśamavapūrṇāñca vande bdhavivṛddhaye || maharṣi gbhilācārthaṃ kātyāyanamṛṣiṃ tathā | pariśiṣṭapraṇetāra praṇamāmi prayatnataḥ || pivrgurūṇāmaca praṇamāmi suhurmuhuḥ | yatkṛpā legamātreṇa mama bdhalavdayaḥ || chandgapariśiṣṭasya kātyāyanakkateriyam | vyākhyā kampradīpasya prabhākhyā kriyate mayā ||
tenaiva, iti ka pustake pāṭhaḥ | kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] athā't gbhilktānāmanyeṣāñcaiva karmaṇām | aspaṣṭānāṃ vidhiṃ samyagdarśayiṣye pradīpavat || 1 || • pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | atha vedādhyayanāntaraṃ gṛhasthāśrama praveśnmukhasya māṇavakasya gbhilktānāmādhānādigṭahyakarmaṇāmanyeṣāñca manvāyuktakaṇā- maspaṣṭānām | "āsīna jaī: prah vā niyam yatra nehaśaḥ" | ityādīnāṃ samyaganuṣṭhānaṃ darśayiṣye | pradīpavat | yathā pradīp- uspaṣṭāni dravyāṇi spaṣṭīkarti tathā'hamapi aspaṣṭaspaṣṭīkaraṇāt pradīpatulya iti granthakārasya pradīpatulyatā, granthasya vā | ataḥ- śabd hetvarthe | yasmādaspaṣṭāni gbhilāyuktaka māṇi, tasmād- vyaktīkarmi | anyathā viguṇaggṛhasthakamānuṣṭhānāt# māṇavaka: pratyavāyī bhavet | athaśabdaya maṅgalārth'pi | tathācktam | "ṃkāracāyaśabdaya dāvet brahmaṇaḥ purā | kaṇṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryāt tena māṅgalikāvubhau " || iti || 1 || prabhā | raha khalu tavabhavān kātyāyana: indgakarttavyānāṃ gṛhyakarmaṇāṃ anyeṣāñcāspaṣṭānāṃ spaṣṭīkaraṇāyeṃ chandgapariśiṣṭāparanāmadheyaṃ kampradīpākhyamimaṃ granthaṃ racayāñcakāra | tasyeyamalpagranyā vṛtti-
manuṣṇavāt iti pustake pāṭhaḥ | L -" [ 1pra. 1kha. ] kammapradīpaḥ | rārabhyate | vyācikhyāsitasya kampradīpasyāyamādimaḥ nka: prathāta ityādi | tatrāthaśabda ārṣeyagranthasyādau prayujyate | śrutyā ca maṅgalapray- janbhavati | bhānantaryyārth vā vedādhyayanāntaramiti tavārthaḥ | ataḥśabd hetvadhaḥ | yasmāt gbhilktāni kānicit gṭahya- karmāsyaspaṣṭāni na ca sarvāṇi chandgakarttavyāṇi karmāṇi gbhilenktāni, ata etasmāt kāraṇāt | vedādhyayanā- nantaraṃ gṛhasthāśramaṃ pravivikṣuṇā chandgabrahmacāriṇā gṛhakarmādi- parijñānāyeṃ gṛhyādikamadhyetavyam | tatra cāspaṣṭānāmanyeṣāñca indgakarttavyānāṃ kammaṇāṃ vidhau samyagapradarśita karmaṇāṃ samyak parijñānābhāvena karmaṇāṃ vaiguṇyaṃ karttuṃbāparādhaḥ syāt | tasmāt gbhilktānāmanyeṣāñca gbhilīyakarttavyānāmasmaṣṭānāṃ vidhiṃ pradīpavat samyag darśayiṣye | yathā mandāndhakāra aspaṣṭāni vastūni pradīpaḥ samyag darśayati, sai dityartha: atra ca gbhiltānāṃ kamaṇāṃ indgakarttavyatvasyāvivādāt anyānyapi kammāṇi chandgakarttavyānyeveti vijñāyate | " prasiddhārthasya sāvidhye y'prasiddhārtha uccate | saṃvidhānasāmayyāttavjātīy'vagamyate" || sa iti nyāyāt | apicāḍuḥ | "saṃyg vipraygaśca sāhacaryaṃ virdhitā| arthaḥ prakaraṇaṃ liṅga śabdasyānyasya savidhiḥ || kapradīpaḥ | ūrddhantu viṭataṃ kāryaṃ tantuvayamadhvṛtam | vivṛtaṃ cpavītaṃ syāttasyaik granthiriṣyate || 2 || [ 1pra. 1kha. ] "sāmarthya maucitī deśa: kāl vyakti kharādayaḥ | śabdārthasthānavacchede viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ" || iti | madhyeṭasampradāya prasiddhicaitamarthamupddalayati adhyetā- rhi granyamimaṃ chandgapariśiṣṭamityācacate | nibandhārathaivam | yathā khullagrāprāye likhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavedayamagrā iti matiḥ, tathā prakkate'pi chandgakarttavyaprāye paṭhitaṃ indgakarttavyametaditi ghrudeti | udeti cet, na yujyate vinā kāraṇamutsraṣṭum | tathāca nyāya: | "prāye vacanāca" iti | tasmāt chandga- karttavyakā pravāhamadhye ghatkiñcidanyat karmpadiṣṭa, tadapi chandgakarttavyamitya vadhārthyate | tasmāt pūrvvasmin parasmiṃśca kampravāha chandgakarttavye sati tanmadhyapaṭhitaṃ kiñcit kammā- kamāīvāījaratauyanyāyena chandgānāṃ na bhaviṣyati bhaviṣyati su kandgetareṣāmiti kut'yamasadāveśa iti na khalvadhi- gacchāmi || 1 || "Et ave pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yajñpavītinā pācāmbdakena kṛtyamiti gbhilenkkā, puna- yajñpavītaṃ kurute sūtraṃ vastraṃ vā api vā kuśaratkumevetyuktam | ghanena yathpavītaṃ sūtramityetāvabhāvamuktam | guṇavisarāyabhi- ghānena tadeva vyaktīkarti | [ 15. 1kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | vāmāvarttavalitasūtravayaṃ triguṇkṛtya dakṣiṇāvarttavalitaṃ kāryyam | evaṃ nava tantavaḥ | tadeva visaramupavītaṃ syāt | tasya catrisarasyaik granthirmunibhirithate | tañca sūtraṃ kārpāsaṃ kauśeyaṃ ca brāhmaṇasya | tathāca manuḥ, - - "kārpāsamupavītaṃ sthāhimasyvṛtaṃ trivṛt | śaṇastramayaṃ rājñ vaiśyasyāvikasvakam" | baudhāyana:, - "kauśaṃ sauvaṃ vistiṃ yajñpavītamānābhaḥ" | kauśaṃ kami - kśtyaṃ vasarapasvādimayam | saulaṃ kārpāsam | visvitaṃ navaguṇaṃ visarīkatamityarthaḥ | "nava vai vivata:" iti śruteḥ | yaca devalavacanam | "kārpāsacaumagbālaśaṇavakhavaṇdbhavam | sadā sambhavat dhārthamupavītaṃ dvijātibhiḥ" | iti | tatpurvapūrvāsambhave uttarttaravidhāyakam | tathā "yajñpavītaṃ kurvīta sūtrāṇi navatantavaḥ | ekena granthinā santuddiguṇastriguṇ'thavā" || dviguṇa iti visarāsambhave disaramityarthaḥ | yañca paiṭhnasivacanam | "kārpāsamupavītaṃ ṣaṭtantu vivṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasya, caumaṃ rājanyasya, bhāvikaṃ vaiśyasya" | tadapi navatantvasambhave tantuṣaṭkaṃ vidhatte | kammapradṣaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] tritaṃ visaramityarthaḥ | athavā navaguṇaṃ visaraḍayena ṣaṭtantuka- mityartha: | kṣaumaṃ atasībhavam | etena, "upavītamayugmasaraṃ viṣamatantukam" iti gṛhyapariśiṣṭktamapi spaṣṭīkṛtam | etacca sūtramaypavītadhāraṇaṃ vastrābhāve | tathāca nigamapariśiṣṭam | "vāsasā yajñpavītāni kuryyāt tadabhāve vivṛtā suveṇa kuśamuñcabālaśararajjubhirvā" | bāl'tra gbāl devalavacanāt | bhatra ca kuśaśaragbālādiṣu guṇavisarādiniyam nāsti | sūtra eva tabiyampadeśāt | avaghātādayastu brīhidhamatvāt tatkārya- kāriyaveṣvapi karttavyāḥ | bhava tu guṇavisarādikaṃ yajñpa- vītāntargataṃ na tu tadaḥ | purḍāśādikaṃ tu na yāgapadārtha- niviṣṭaṃ kiṃ tu dravyamātam| anyathā pradhānasyātideśābhāvāt anatideśāpatteḥ| anye tvādduḥ, - yajñpavītānītyuttarīdhe gauṇaṃ tahambhavinyāsa prātyarthamiti || 2 || . prabhā | yajñpavītaṃ kurute sūtraṃ vastraṃ vā apivā kuśarajjumeveti gbhilasve sūtraṃ yajñpavītaṃ kurute ityetāvanmācamuktam | tadeva guṇasarāyabhidhānena saṣṭayati| tridūīhatamiti | triguṇaṃ kṛtvā jataṃ kā, tantujayamaghhataṃ viṭataca kāryyam | evaṃ guṇa- yasya viguṇkaraṇena nava tantavaḥ sampadyante | tathāca hyā "yajñpavītaṃ kurvīta sūtreṇa navatāntavam" | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] kammapradṣaḥ | iti | ūhatalakṣaṇamāha saṃgrahakāraḥ | "kareṇa dakṣiṇenīṃ gatena triguṇīkṛtam | balitaṃ mānavaiḥ svaṃ śāstre jaīvṛtaṃ smṛtam" || iti | ūrhantu vitaṃ kāryyamiti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ | vāmāvartta- balitaṃ stravayaṃ triguṇīkṛtya dakṣiṇāvarttavṛtaṃ kārya miti pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | tadevaṃ visaramupavītaṃ syāt | upavtameva yajñasambandhāt yajñpavītamityucyate | tasyaikgranthiriṣyata chandgācāryaiḥ | kecit kila pravarasaṃkhyayā granthiṃ kurvvanti | eknthirityanena tatvānanu- matirdarśitā | yacānyerdviguṇitaṃ ṣaṭ tantukañcpavītamuktam | taccha- ndgetaraparam | śākhāntarasūtrakāratvātteṣām | evaṃ svaśabd- pādānāt tasya ca kārpāse prasiḍe: kārpāsamupavītaṃ chandgā- nām | evamācāryeṇa sūtraṃ vastraṃ vā ityabhidhānāt sūtrābhāve vastrasya vidhānāvagate: vastrābhāve sūtravidhānamapi chandgetaraparaṃ bdhyam | | atra yadyapi satyāmapi vrhīnavahantīti vrīhikā- kāriṇi yave'myavaghātādayaḥ kriyante, tathāpi yajñpavītakārya- kāriṇi vastrādau na vitādiniyamaḥ | vitāderyajñpavīta- padārthāntarniviṣṭatvena yajñpavītadhamatvābhāvāt anyana tadaprasakteḥ | avaghātādīnāṃ brīhipadārthānta niviṣṭatvābhāvena vrīhimmatvāt avaghātādividhau vrīhipadena brhiyāgāvāntarāpūrvvasādhanasya lakṣyamāṇatvāca yave tadācaraṇaṃ yuktameva || 2 || 2 9. kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] pṛṣṭhavaṃśe ca nābhyāñca dhṛtaṃ yaddindate kaṭim | taḍāyamupavītaṃ syānnātlambaṃ na ccchritama || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ 10 idānīṃ derdhyamupavītasyāha | pṛṣṭavaṃśanābhyddhṛtaṃ sat yatkaṭiparyantaṃ lambate tadupavītaṃ dhārayet | nāt'dhikaṃ lambamānaṃ nāpi jaḍeṃ vitaṃ hasamitiyāvat | etaca gbhilīyānām| anyeṣāṃ tu, "stanādūīmadhnābherna karttavyaṃ kathañcana" | iti devalenktaṃ pramāṇamiti | "yajñpavītamānābhe:" iti baudhā- yanktasyāpyeṣaiva vyavasthā | snātakaica dve yajñpavīta dhārthe | tathāca vaśiṣṭhaḥ, - "srātakānāṃ hi nityaṃ syādantarvāsastayttaram | yajñpavīte dve yaṣṭiḥ sdakañca kamaṇḍaluḥ" || 3 || prabhā | upavītasya parimāṇamāha | pūṣṭhavaṃśe ceti | yadupavītaṃ pṛṣṭha- vaṃśe nābhyāca ghṛtaṃ sat kaṭiṃ vindate labhate kaṭiparyantaṃ lambate ityetat | tadupavītaṃ dhāyeṃ, na punarat lambaṃ nāpyucchritaṃ ikha- mityarthaḥ | parimāṇāntaramāha gbhilaputr gṛhyāsaṃgrahe | "stanādūī madhnābherna karttavyaṃ kathañcana | stanādū śriyaṃ hanti adhgābhestapaḥcayaḥ" ||
nātibamyaṃ, iti ka kha ga pustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | sadpavītinā bhāvyaṃ sadā baḍaśikhena ca | viśikhvyupavītaśca yatkarti na tatkṛtam || 4 || iti | yat yadupakramya paṭhitaṃ tattatraivāṅgamiti nyāyāt na c- cchritamiti kātyāyanīy niṣedhastaduktakalpa evābhiniviśate, na hyāsaṃgrahte kalpe | evaṃ tadukt nābheradhaḥkaraṇa niṣedhastadukta- eva kalpe'bhiniviśate, na kātyāyankta kalpe iti draṣṭavyam | tadanay; parimāṇyrvikalpaḥ | kutaḥ ? iyreva svaśāstrktatvāt | yaca, gbhilaputvavacanamaviduṣā nārāyaṇpādhyāyena, "stanādūīmadhnābherna karttavyaṃ kathañcana" | 11 iti devalkaṃ parimāṇaṃ tadanādaraṇīyam || 3 || gbhilauyavyatiriktaviṣayamityuktam | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | kamaṅgatvaṃ yajñpavītasya, "yajñpavītinā ācāntkena kṛtyam, " iti sūtrāt | tathāca kammakālamātre dhāraṇaṃ nānyadeti prasaktāvāha | sadpavītayuktena baddacūḍena ca bhavitavyam | etena śikhābandhpavīta dhāraṇayḥ puruṣārthatkkā | tatvādhāraṇe pratyavāyaḥ | puruṣārthatayā sadā dhāraṇāt kammakāle'pi dhāraṇpapatteḥ kiṃ kamaṅgatā nāstye- betyavāha | viśikha ityādi | śikhpavītarahitena yatkam kṛtaṃ, na tatkṛtam | viguṇatvena phalāmādhakatvādityabhiprāya: | kevala kammapradpaḥ | 12 [ 1pra. 1kha. ] puruṣārthave hi daivātkamakāle'dhāraṇe'pi kā viguṇameva puruṣastu pratyavāyī syāt | karmāṅgatve tu naivam | tadā ca viguṇaṛtu- samādhāne yaprāyaścittaṃ tatkarttavyamiti kamāṅgatvpadeśaprayjanam | etena dadhikhādirādivat ṛtupuruṣārthataybhayārthatayā jhāmakatā upavītasyetyuktam | ataeva - "pivat mehatañcāpi bhut'nupavītinaḥ || prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhābaḍaṃ navakaṃ triyutaṃ * kramāt" || ityanyatrāpi vyaktamuktaṃ dhāraṇam | ataeva dhanārjana niyamasya puruṣārthatve tadatikrameṇa kṛpyāvyarjitadhanena ṛtuniṣpattiraviguṇaiva puruṣastu niyamātikramāt prāyaścittīyate| viśikha ityanena ca asatyāmapi śikhāyāṃ śikhābandhābhāve kammaivaiguṇyaṃ natu satyā- mevetyuktam || 4 || prabhā | yajñpavītasya kammaṅgatvaṃ "yajñpavītinācāntdakena kṛtyam" iti gmilastreṇktam | evañca karmakālādanyatra tasya dhāraṇaṃ na prāpnti, tatvāha | sadpavītineti | sarvvadā upavītinā sarvvadā badaśikhena ca puruṣeṇa bhavitavyam| anena yajñpavītadhāraṇasya śikhābandhanasya ca puruṣārthatlā | tatasa viparyaye pratyavāyaḥ svāt | tat kiṃ puruṣārthayḥ śikhābandhanpavītadhāraṇayravarlḍa- nyatayā kaśmaikāle'pyanuvṛttiriti naitayḥ kanmāryatetyāśaṅkāyā
naktaṃ likayutaṃ iti ga pustake pāṭhaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] kama pradīpaḥ | 123 māha | viśikha ityādi | abaḍhaśikh'nupavīt ca yat kama karti, tat kvataṃ na bhavati | viguṇatayā samyak phalājana- katvāt na tat kkata miti nindāvādaḥ | pūvā puruṣārthatayktayḥ śikhābandhpavītadhāraṇayruttarārddha vyatireke nindārthavādamukhena kammarthat terviśikha ityasya viśikhābandhana ityartha: kalpāte | anyathā pūcīparasāmañjasyaṃ na syāt | baddaśi khenetyatra baḍhāyā: śikhāyā upasthitatvāt baḍā śikhaiva vā viśikha iti śikhā śabdena parāmajyate | etena viśikha ityanenāsatyāmapi śikhāyām̐ śikhābandhābhāve kammaivaiguṇyaṃ na tu satyāmeveti pariśiṣṭamakā- śktamasaṅgatam | tathātve kamāṅgatayā śikhābandhanavat śikhā'pi vidhātavyeti vākyabhedacāpadyeta | tadava puruṣārthayreva satḥ śikhābandhanpavītadhāraṇayḥ saṃygapṛthaktvanyāyena kātviṃ na tu karmārthamanyat yajñpavītaṃ dhārthamityuktam | āratakānāntu yatr pavītaiyaṃ dhārthamityāha vaśiṣṭhaḥ | "snātakānāṃ hi nityaṃ syādantarvāsastathttaram | yajñpavīte he yaṣṭi: sdakaśca kamaṇḍalu: " || iti | puruṣārthasyaiva yajñpavītadhāraṇasya karmārthatayā vidhānāt tatrāpyeṣeṣa gatiḥ | smaranti ca | "yajñpavīta ḍe dhā śrautasmāteṃṣu karmasu | tṛtīyañcttarīyārthaṃ vastrābhāve tadiṣyate" | iti || 4 || 14 kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] vi: prāśyāp hirunmṛjya mukha metānupaspṛśet | āsyanāsācikaṇīṃśca nābhivacaḥ śir' sakān ||5|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ācāntdakena kṛtyamiti gbhilktamācamanamavyaktaṃ vyanakti | vāravayamapaḥ prakarṣeṇa bhavet | bhakṣaṇaprakarṣaśca karmakaraṇa karttṛ- prakarṣāt | tatra kasmaikarṣ'nutvāphenatvāvuhudatvahṛdayagāmitvādi- rūpaḥ | karttṛprakarṣaca tapāṇipādaśaucalāsīnatvaprāṅmukhatvādi- rūpaḥ | karaṇaprakarṣathātra brāhmatīrthatvādiḥ | evamap bhavayitvā mukhaṃ vāradvaya mūrkhaṃ lmasthāne mārjayet | na tvalmake| punarācamane- 'navasthāprasaṅgāt | tathāca pariśiṣṭam | "ācāntaḥ punarācāmait | vāsaca paridhāyṣṭhau saṃspṛśya yavālmak" | mārjanaṃ cāṅguṣṭha- mūlena, likhiṣyamāṇadacavacanāt | etena "udagamnerutsṛṣya prakṣālya pāṇī pādau cpaviśya trirācāmet hiḥ parimajīta pādāvabhyucya śir'bhyucayet" iti gaubhilenktam vāradvayamārjanaṃ mukhasya vāratrayabhakṣaṇamapāṃ sphuṭīkṛtam | tam | ava ca udagagrerutsṛṣyeti karmāṅgācamanameva vāratrayamityu- tataba "vikhaturvā bhapa pācāmet" - iti gtamkaṃ vāracatuṣṭayamācamanamadṛṣṭārthakam vyavasthitamiti keci tabirastam| bhācāntdakena kṛtyamiti karmāṅgasyaivācamanasya udagammerāmapya ityādinā viṣecanāt | tataya triḥ prāśitā yadi hṛdayagāna bhavanti tadā caturvveti bahubhiktā vyavasthā | bhāva[ 1pra. 1kha ] kamapradīpaḥ | śāpekṣayeti kalpatarūtā vyavasthā | "indriyāṇyaddhiḥ saṃspṛśet pakṣiṇī nāsike karṇāviti yadyamīmāṃsyaṃ syāt tadadbhiḥ sṛśet" ityuktaṃ gbhilena | tadavyakta vyaktīkarti | etāni vaccamāṇāni samīpe sṭabhet | na tu tattatsthāne | samalatvāt | āsyādīnāṃ samāse- nekapadenpādānaṃ teṣāṃ spasarjanaspṛśatisambandhāyeṃ, nābhyādīnāca pṛthaksamāsenpādānaṃ spṛthatimāvasambandhārtham | ayaṃ cāsyādikram- dakṣkta ityaṅgulniyam'pi sa eva grāhyaḥ | tathāhi dakṣa:- "anenaiva vidhānena ācāntaḥ śucitāmiyāt | prakṣyālya pāṇī pādau ca triḥ pivedambu vkṣitam" || anena vadhyamāṇena | 15 "saṃvṛtyāṅguṣṭhamūlena diḥ pramṛjyāttat mukham | saṃhatya tisṛbhiḥ pūrvamāsyamevamupaspṛśet" | mukhaṃ saṃvṛtya tataḥ pramṛjyādityarthaḥ | evamiti saṃhatyetyarthaḥ | "aṅguṣṭhena pradeśindhā vrāṇampaścādanantaram | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca cakṣuḥ śrtre punaḥpunaḥ || nābhiṃ kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhena hṛdayaṃ tu talena ve | sarvābhistu śiraḥ paścādāha cāgreṇa saṃsṛśet || tisṛbhiḥ pūrvamāsyaṃ sadā'ṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ paścāt ghrāṇaṃ, anantaraṃ cakṣuṣī śrtre punaḥpunarityarthaḥ || 5 || prabhā | "ācāntdakena kṛtyam" iti gbhilkamācamanaṃ vyaktī- karti viḥ prābhyeti | kammapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] vāravayamudakaṃ bhavayitvā vāraiyaṃ mukhamunmṛjya vaccamāṇān mukha- cakṣurnāsikākarṇān nābhivacaḥ sthalaśir' sāṃtha upasabhet | etena "indriyānyahi saṃspaśedakṣiṇī nāsike karṇāviti" iti gbhila- sūtramupanyāsamātraparaṃ na kramaparamiti spaṣṭīkṛtam | itiśabda- vivacit'rthava pradarśitaḥ | yadyapi "virācāmet diḥ parimajīta pādāvabhyuṣya. śir'bhyucayet" iti gbhilasūtre diḥ parimārjanā- nantaraṃ indriyamaca pūrvvaṃ pāda śir'bhyukṣaṇamuktam | tathāpi tasya spaṣṭatvādatra tatrktam | kasyāścidavasthāyāṃ tadantareṇāmyācamana- niṣpatyarthaṃ vā | mānādāvaṅguliniyam dakṣeṇa darśitaḥ | yathā | "anenaiva vidhānena bhāvāntaḥ śucitāmiyāt pracātya pāṇī pādau ca tiḥ pibedambu vcitam || saṃvṛtyāṅguṣṭhamūlena diḥ pramṛjyāttasmukham | [saṃhatya tisṛbhiḥ pūrvvamāsyamevamupasṛśet || aṅguṣṭena pradeśinyā ghrāṇaṃ pracādanantaram | aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyācca catutrtre punaḥ punaḥ || nābhiṃ kaniṣṭhākuḍena hṛdayantu talena vai | sarvvābhiśva śiraḥ pavādāha prāgreṇa saṃsṛśet" || iti | kvacit kvacit kammapradīpa evaitasminnavasara vacanānyetāni prayante | saṃhatyetyanena murkha sehata kṛtvā salmakasthānaṃ spaṣṭavyam | anyathā[pra. 1kha. ] kamma pradīpaḥ | prabhā | 17 iti "ācāntaḥ punarācāmehās viparidhāya ca | ṣṭhau saṃspṛśva ca tathā yatra sthātāmalmak" || vaśiṣṭhenālīmakṣṭha sparśe ācamanavidhānena tadanavasthāpā- tāt | na caitat parakīyatvādanācaraṇīyamiti vācyam | smṛtyu- tasya parakīyatvānupapatteḥ | smṛtyuktamapi svaśāstraviruddhaṃ nācara- lyameva | na cātra tathā apica, dattaḥ kila smṛtikārāṇāṃ pariśiṣṭakārakalpa iti naivāva kimapi śaṅgitavyaṃ bhavati | tathāca dakṣeṇaivktam— "ukta kama kram nkt na kāl munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | dvijānāntu hitārthāya dakṣastu svayamabravīt || iti | na kālastata eva hi iti dvitīyacaraṇe pāṭhāntaram | ācamane viśeṣ gṛhyasvās yathāsambhavaṃ smṛtyanta rebhyaścāvagantavyaḥ | granthagauravamayādiha na likhitaḥ | ava hyasūtre ca vāratrayaṃ jalapāna vidhānāt, "tricaturvā apa ācāmet" iti gautamasvaṃ gbhilīya vyatirikta viṣayam | yattu upaspṛśediti vacanāt indriyā- khupa spe saṃspṛśet na randhrasthāne samalatvāt iti nārāyaṇ pādhyāyenktam | tadasaṅgatam | "indriyāṇyabhiḥ saṃspṛśet" iti gbhila sūtravirdhāt | samasatve'pi vacanāt sparśe dṣakalpanā- nupapatteḥ | sāmānyasya viśeṣataraparatvpapatte: | "dehācaiva cyutā- malā: " - iti smṛtadehacyutānāmeva malasvena deha sthitānāṃ malatvā- bhāvāca | āsyādīnāṃ samāsenaikapadenpādānaṃ teṣāṃ spasarga- | kama pradīpaḥ | yatrpadiśyate karma kartturaṅgaṃ na tūcyate | dakṣiṇastatra vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥ || 6 || [ 1pra. 1kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ācamanādikāprasaṅgādanyadapi sādhāraṇa maṅgamāha - yatra smṝtyādau kama karttavyatvencate karttuḥ punaḥ savyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vā'ṅgaṃ ncate | tatra dakṣiṇapāṇi: karmāṅgatayā jñātavyaḥ | yasmādas sāikaniṣpādakatayā pāragaḥ | savyena tu viguṇaṃ karmeti | etena gbhil takansu validānahmādiṣu anykteṣu ca anupa. diṣṭakartaṅga viśeṣeṣu aṅga viśeṣa niyamenānuṣṭhānaṃ sphuṭīkkṛtam || 6 || prabhā| smṛthatisambandhāyeṃ, nābhyādaunāṃ pṛthaksamāmenpādānaṃ sṛthatimātra- sambandhārthamityapi tasya kalpanāmātraṃ pramāṇābhāvādanupādeyam | kuvacit spasargasya kutracicpasameṃ vihāya dhātumātrasya sambandhabana kāpi dṛṣṭacaraḥ | vacanavirdhaścaivamavarjjanīya: syāt | tasmādupetyupasarg dhātvarthamanuvarttate | ataeva kenāpi muninā saṃgrahakāreṇa ca naiṣa viśeṣ'bhihitaḥ 5 athedānīṃ gbhilānukkamataravāspaṣṭa kaścit vidhimupadiśati karmpadiśyate ityādibhistribhiḥ | yatretat karttavyamiti karmpa- diśyate karttusvaṅgaviśeṣaḥ savy dakṣiṇī vā ncyate tatra hma- taṃkṣiharaṇādau karmaṇāṃ pāragāmī sarva kankaraṇasamarthdakṣiṇa: kar- vijñeyaḥ | tatra dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragvijñeyaiti vā'rthaḥ ||6|| [ 1pra. 1kha. .] kapradīpaḥ | yatra diniyam nāsti japahmādikarmasu | tisastana diśaḥ prktā aindrī saumyā'parājitāḥ ||7|| āsīna ū: pr vā niyam yatra nehaśaḥ | tadāsnena karttavyaṃ na praddhena na tiṣṭhatā || 8 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | 16 aparamapi sādhāraṇamaṅgamāha - yatra japādikamata, teṣu karmasu digviśeṣamukha tāniyam- ntaḥ, tatra pūrvvā uttarā aiśānīti tisr diś munibhi ruktāḥ || 7 || yatra upaviṣṭa utthit'vanatapūrvvakāyaḥ kuryyādityetādṛś- niyam nāsti tatkarmpaviṣṭena karttavyam | nāpadyapi praddheva utthitena karttavyamitvarthaḥ || 8 || prabhā | aparamapi sādhāraṇamaṅgamāha - yatra diniyam nāstīti | yatra karmaṇi diniyam nāsti karturdigviśeṣamukhatā nktā, tatrendrī saumyā'parājitā strisrdiś munibhiḥ prktāḥ | jñeyā iti pāṭhe jñātavyā- ityarthaḥ | tayācaitāsāṃ diśāmanyatama diṅmukhatā karturbhavyā | aindrī prācī, saumyā uttarā, aparājitā aiśānī | tathāca hyāsaṃgraha:kampradīpaḥ | gaurī padmā śacī medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā | devasenā khadhā khāhā mātar lkamātaraḥ || (ka) | dhṛtiḥ puṣṭistathā tuṣṭirātmadevatayā saha | gaṇeśeṇādhikā htā vṛddhau pūjyācaturdaśa | ( kha ) || [ 1pra. 1kha. ] prabhā | "prakramaṇe tathddāhe h me khriṣṭakate tathā | yasyāṃ diśi vidhiṃ prāhustāmāhuraparājitām" || iti || 7 || āsīna iti | yasmin kammaṇi āsīna ūī: pr vā kuryyādityetādṛś niyam nktaḥ, tat kama āsīnena karttavyaṃ na praddhena na vā tiṣṭhatā| āsīna upaviṣṭaḥ | ūdaṇḍavat sthitaḥ | prvanatapūrvvakāya: | tiṣṭhatā daṇḍavat sthitena || 8 || prasaṅgāicyamāṇpayginaṃ kaścidarthamāha gaurī padmeti vābhyām- gaṇeśasahitā etāyatuībha mātar vṛddhāvādhānādau pūjanīyā: | catuīśevyupādānāt mātar lkamātara iti sarvvāsāṃ viśeṣaṇam | etā mātar lkamātara ityarthaḥ | haḍī pūnyāya ṣḍama iti pāṭhe mātar lkamātara iti khatantraṃ devatāiyam | tadidaṃ nka- dayaṃ sarveṣu pustakeṣu dṛṣṭatvāt kasalākaraṇa chandgapariśiṣṭa- nākhā likhitatvād vyākhyātatvāñcāsmābhirvyākhyātam | nārāyaṇ pādhyāyena tu naitat paṭhitaṃ na vā vyākhyātam || kapradīpaḥ | karmādiṣu ca sarveṣu mātaraḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ | pūjanīyā: prayatnena pūjitāḥ pūjayanti tāḥ || 6 || pratimāsu ca śubhrāsu likhitā vā paṭādiṣu | api vā'catapuñjeṣu naivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 10 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | aparamapi sādhāraṇaṃ karmāṅgamāha - sarvvavaidikakammarambhātpūrvvaṃ gaṇapatisametā gaurṣyādimātaraḥ prayatnat- bhaktivaddhābhyāṃ pūjayitavyāḥ | pūjāphalamāha | tāḥ pūjitāḥ pūjākarttāramabhyudayasampādanena prṣayanti || 8 || pūjāsthānāni tadupakaraṇāni cāha pratikṛtiṣu śubhrāsa rajatasphaṭikādimayīṣu | śahākhiti pāṭhe- prabhā | na kevalaṃ haḍau, kintarhi, kammādiṣu ceti | sarveṣu ca kammādiṣu gaṇādhipasahitā gauyyādimātaraḥ prayatnena bhaktivahātithyena pūjanīyā: | pūjitāstā mātaraḥ pūjayitāraṃ pūjayanti abhyudaya sampādanena prṇayanti yataḥ, ataḥ pūjanīyā iti pūjāphalavādaḥ | savrveṣvityasyāpavād vakṣyate | tadanena, sarvvāsyevānvā hāyavantīti gbhilasūtreṇa kammādau yadanvāhāvyavāhamuktaṃ tanmāṭapūjādipūrvvakaṃ karaṇīyamiti spaṣṭīkkṛtam || 8 || pūjāyāṃ viśeṣamāha pratimākhiti | śubhbhrāsa sphaṭikalikhitvā iti pāṭhāntaram | kapradīpaḥ | kuyalagnāṃ vasrdhārāṃ saptadhārāṃ ghṛtena tu | kārayet pañcadhārāṃ vā nātilambāṃ na ccchritām ||11|| 22 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | 'pyaya mevārthaḥ | ayaṃ mukhyakalpaḥ | anukalpamāha paṭhādiṣvityādiḥ | varṇakalikhitā vā | āpakalpamāha | yavapucceṣvapi vā | mātaraḥ pūjanīyā ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | nivedanvaiśca nānāvidhairgandhapuṣpadhūpadīpa- pāyasamdakāpūpakādibhiḥ | cakārī bhaktiśraddhāsamuccaye || 10 || tadanantara- bhittisaṃsaktāṃ ghṛtena saptadhārāṃ bahuṭatāsambhave pañcadhārāṃ, basvedi- rājasya taduheśapratvena sambadhinṃ, nātidghāṃ nātihakhāṃ vā kuryyāt | vasca sarvtsavapravarttakatvena maṅgalahetutvāt vivāha puvajamādimaṅgale pūjā yukteti | vasragnervā || 11 || prabhā | rajatādinimtiāsa pratimāsa mātaraḥ pūjanīyā ityanuṣajyate | paṭādiṣu varṣakailikhitābivitā vā mātaraḥ pūjanīyāḥ | athavā, akṣatapuṣtreṣu yavaputreṣu mātaraḥ pūjanīyāḥ | "acatāstu yavā: prktāḥ" ityukteḥ | pṛthagvidhairnānāvidhairnaivedrnivedanīyairgandhayuṣpa- dhūpādibhirvividhairbhakṣya mātaraḥ pūjanīyāḥ || 10 || māṭapūjānantaraṃ yat karttavyaṃ, tadāha, kujyatyagnāmiti | bhittisaṃsalāṃ saptadhārāṃ pañcadhārāṃ vā nātinīcāṃ nātihastrāṃ nātyucata nātidṣī ca vasvedirājasthāgnervā, taduheśana [ 1pra. 1 kha. ]. • kama pradīpaḥ | āyuṣyāṇi ca śāntyarthaṃ naptā taba samāhitaḥ | ṣaḍbhyaḥ pitṛbhyastadanu śrāhadānamupakramet || 12 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | āyuve hitāni amaṅgalanāśāya jambā | tatra karmādau | mātṛpūjāvasudhārā''yuṣyajapebhy'nantaraṃ pitrādibhy mātāmahādi bhyaya vibhyaḥ śrahādānamārameta | etacca vṛddhiśrāī vaidikakammevādī karttavyam | tadaṅgaṃ ca | tathāca śātātapaḥ- "nāniṣvā tu pitṝn yāhe karm vaidikamārabhet" | bhaviṣyapurāṇañca - "niṣekakāle sme ca saumantnnayane tathā | jñeyaṃ puṃsavane caiva yā karmāṅgamevaca" || etaca vaidikakamātrpalakṣaṇam | phalavatsavidhāvaphalaṃ prabhā | pravṛttatvāt tasaṃbandhinmityetat tena dhārāṃ kārayet kuyāt | svārthik ṇic || 11 || vasrdhārāyāḥ karaṇādanantaraṃ kṛtyamāha āyuṣyāṇīti | āyu- pyāṇi āyuṣe hitāni āyurvṛddhikarāṇi, ā nbhadrāḥ katava- ityādistāni iti madanapārijātaḥ | tāni ca taittirīya- śākhāyāṃ pavyante | śāntyarthamamaṅgalanāśārthaṃ samāhit'vikṣipta- cittaḥ tatra kamādau jatā, tadanu tadanantaraṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitrādibhyaḥ vibhyaḥ mātāmahādibhyaca tribhyaḥ śrāḍadānamārabheta | kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | tadaṅga miti nyāyasyāviśeṣāt | lkike tu karmāṇi na vaidi- kasya śrāvasyāṅgatā | kintu tacchrāisya nimittamātram | nimittānantaraca naimittikam | ataḥ puvajanmāyuttarakālameva sūryagrahādinimittakaśrāivat haḍiśrāimiti sthitam | ataeva mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇam - "naimittikamadh vacye śrāimabhyudayātmakam | 24 [ 1pra. 1kha ] putrajanmani tatkāyeṃ jātakasamaṃ naraiḥ" || etadapi putramukhadarśanādyupalakṣaṇārtham | anupādeyatvāpradhāna- tvayraviśeṣāt | etena sarvāṇyevānyāhārthavantauti sūtrktamatvā- hāryapadaṃ mātṛpūjādibhy'nvāḍriyamāṇatvāt ḍivāiparamiti spaṣṭkkṛtam | ataeva, "yacchrāī karmaṇāmādī yā cānte dakṣiṇā bhavet | amāvāsyāṃ dvitauyaṃ yadanvāhāyyaṃ taducyate || " iti gṭahyāntaram | piṇḍa piṭayanarūpaścāt dvitīyaṃ śrāddha- prabhā | javā tadanu iti nirdeś lekhaśailī | nāva punaruktirāśaṅganīyā | kramaviśeṣārth vā | kathaṃ nāma ? kṛtāyuṣyajapasyaiva śrāhadāne- adhikār na tvakṛtāyuṣyajapasyeti | ṣaḍbhya ityupādānāt chand- mānāṃ mātādivāī nāsti | vakṣyati ca "na yṣihāḥ pṛthagdayādavasāna dināhate" | kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | mityarthaḥ | tathā ca gbhilaḥ | "anvaṣṭakyasthālīpākena piṇḍa- pitṛyajñ vyākhyātaḥ | amāvāsyāyāntacchrāi ḍamitaradanvāhāyeṃ māsnam" | vṛddhivāhe ca pitṛṇāvādīmukha viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭānāṃ devatātvam | tathā viṣṇupurāṇam - "kanyāputra vivāhe ca praveśe navaveśmanaḥ | nāmakammaṇi bālānāṃ cūḍākarmādika tathā || saumantnayane caiva putrādimukhadarśane | nāndīmukhaṃ pitṛgaṇamarcayet prayat gṭahī" || brahmapurāṇam- "kamme vyathābhyudayike maṅgalyavati śbhane | janmanyathpanayane vivāhe putrakasya ca || pitṛvāndmukhāgrāma tarpayedidhipūrvakam" | gbhilenāpi, nāndaumukhāḥ pitaraḥ prauyantāmiti deve vācayitvā nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥna prabhā | iti | pitṛbhya iti pitṛpadastha sambandhiśabdatayā padinyāyāt yajamāna pitrādiparigrahaḥ | tena yajamānapitrādīnāṃ, natu,- "pitā pitāmaha caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | vay hyamukhā hte pitaraḥ parikīrttitāḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe, iti kha pustake pāṭhaḥ | pipitāmaha prapitāmahebhyaḥ iti va pustake pāṭhaḥ | 4 mātāmaha-pramātāmaha-haḍapramātāmahebhyava yadyapi, kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | tathā, - [ 1pa. 1 kha. ] pryantāmityuktam | "pitā pitāmahameva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | y hyamukhā hte pitaraḥ parikīrttitāḥ | tebhyaḥ pūrvvatarā ye ca prajāvantaḥ sukhedhitāḥ || ne tu nāndmukhā nāndī samṛhiriti kathyate" | "ye syuḥ pitāmahādū te sv㌚rvāndmukhāsviti | prasannamukhasaṃjñāstu maṅgalīyā yatastu te" | iti brahmapurāṇavacanāt pramukhatā prasanramukhatārūpaṃ nāndmukhatvaṃ •prapitāmaha pitrādaunāṃ vyāyāmeva | ye syuḥ pitāmahādūī mitya vāpi pitāmahavadaṃ prapitāmahaparam | tebhya: pūrvvatarā ye ca prabhā | tebhyaḥ pūrvvatarā ye ca prajāvata: sukhaidhitāḥ | te tu nāndmukhā nāndī samṛviriti kathyate || kābhyudayika māityavati śbhane | janmanyaypanayane vivāhe munakasya ca || pitṛvāndmukhān nāma tarpayeḍidhipūrvvakam" | iti brahmapurāṇavacanāt prapitāmahapitvādīnāṃ vāham | vakṣyati kama pradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | ityetaharśanāt | tataśca teṣāmeva vṛddhiśrāḍe devatātvaṃ yuktam tathāpi ṣaḍā: pitṛbhyaḥ iti yajamāna pitṛṇāmeva pratītadevatātvaṃ yuktam | tathāca- "khapitṛbhyaḥ pitā dadyāt sutasaṃskārakasa " | iti spaṣṭamevttam | khapadasya prapitāmahapitrādivyāvarttaka- tathaiva sārthakatvāt | tathā, nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraḥ prīyantāmiti pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāmātāmahāśca pryantāmiti kātyāyana- vacane, nāndmukhebhya: pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ mātāmahebhyaḥ pramātāmahebhya: vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaśca pryantāmiti gbhilasūtre ca yajamānasyaiva pitrādayaḥ sambandhiśabdatvāt mātāmahasamabhivyāhārāñca gamyante | nāndīmukhatā ca teṣāmevā- [ 1pra. 1kha. ] prabhā | "khapitṛbhyaḥ pitā dadyāt sutasaṃskārakarmasa" | iti | svapadañcātra prapitāmahapitrādivyāvarttakatayaiva sārthakam | anyathā'nardhakaskhāpatteḥ | kintu pitrādīnāṃ nāndmukhaviśeṣaṇa- viśiṣṭānā mevāla devatātvam | śrāhakalpe, nāndīmukhāḥ pitara ityādi nirdeśāt | evaṃ tatraiva nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pitā- mahebhya ityādi nirdeśāt | "nāndmukhe vivāhe ca prapitāmahapūrvvakam | vākyamuccārayeddiddānanyava pitṛpūrvvakam" | iti bṛhaddaśiṣṭktavākyaracanāpi gbhilyānāṃ na bhavati | kama pradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | rpāt māṇavakasyevāgnitvam | maṅgalye ca vivāhaputrajanmādī aśrumukhānāmamāṅgalikānāṃ śrāisavidhī ārpādapi māṅgalika- nāndmukhaśabdena nirdiśṃ yuktaḥ | ataevāmāṅgalika kapālādi- śabdavāce ārpādapi camaṅgalaparihārāya bhagālādiśabdaṃ śrī- kāmajñānādivācaka- bhagapadayukta munayaḥ prayuñjate | evamāyuṣya- mantrajap'pi śāntyarthamupapann bhaviṣyati | ataeva " paṭhet chandāṃsi suntu khastisktaṃ śubhaṃ tathā" | iti brahmapurāṇe'pi svastyayanārthaṃ suktājappadeśa evamupapann- bhaviṣyati | kvacikatyasya ca kvacidārpāt ārpārthameva vāstava nāndīmukhatvaṃ brahmapurāṇe darśitam | kecittu śākhāviśeṣavyavasthita brahmapurāṇīyaḥ paca ityāhuḥ | prabhā | [ 1pra. 1kha. ] saveṃ etat śrāddhakalpabhāvyādau vivecitamasmābhistatraivānusandheyam | granthagauravabhayādiha nccate| yaccktaṃ nārāyaṇpādhyāyena, sva- janakādīnāṃ devatālāvagatesteṣāmevārpeṇa nāndīmukhatvaṃ māṇa- vakasyāgnitvavat | māṅgalike vivāhādāvamāṅgalikānāma- mukhānāmārpeṇā'pi māṅgalikanāndmukhapadena nirdeś yuktaḥ | ataevāmāṅgalikakapālādiśabdavāce amaṅgalaparihārāya ār pādapi śrīkāmajñānādivācakabhagapadayuktaṃ bhagālā diśabdaṃ munayaḥ prayute | kvacit satyasyaivāndhavārpāt ārpārthameva vāstavaṃ nāndaumukhavaṃ brahmapurāṇe darśitam, iti | seyaṃ kalpanā ramaṇīyā | [ 1ma. 1kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | vaśiṣṭhkkvidhiḥ kṛtsn draṣṭavy'tra nirāmiṣaḥ | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣa dūī y bhavet || 13 || prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | jīvatpitrāditrayavyavasthita ityapare | tadayuktam | svapitṛbhya: pitā dayādityasmin vacane pitrabhāva eva sutasya vṛddhiśrāividhā- nāt | triṣu jīvatsu naiveti viṣṇunā pāṇyāḍaniṣedhāt | tavikṛtitvāt ca vṛddhiśrāvasyeti | yataevārpitaṃ nāndmukhatvam, ataeva, - -- "mātāmahebhyaśca tathā nāndvaktrebhya eva ca | iti brahmapurāṇe mātāmahānāmapi nāndaumukhatvamuktam | tathā kātyāyanena nāndmukhāḥ pitaraḥ pryantāmityādinā, gbhilena ca, nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ ityādinā mātāmahānāmapi nāndī- mukhatvamuktatam || 12 || kayā paripāṭyā śrāvaṃ karttavyamityāha - vaśiṣṭhena vāndgyagṭadyapariśiṣṭe yaḥ pāṇavidhikktaḥ s'va prabhā | vacanārthastvevaṃ na bhavati | kutaḥ ? brahmapurāṇe vṛhaprapitāmahādīnāṃ nāndmukhasaṃjñāmabhidhāya kanmeṇyathābhyudayike ityādinā parata- steṣāmeva śrāddhpadeśāttathāvidhakalpanānuṣapatteḥ || 12 || - anvāhārtha śrāisyetika vyatāṃ vaktumupakramataṃ vaśiṣṭhkta iti | kī pradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | sarvva pāmiṣaparyudāsena draṣṭavyaḥ | at'nantaraṃ vaśiṣṭhktāddidhery'va yā viśeṣ bhavet taṃ samyagvacyāmi | madhu cāva dātavyam eva - "śālyannaṃ dadhimadhvaktaṃ vadarāṇi yavāṃstathā | miśrīkṛtāni catvāri piṇḍān śrīphalasa vibhān" || iti brahmapurāṇavacanāt || 13 || prathamakhaṇḍa | prabhā | bāhakalpe vaśiṣṭena pālacatrāce y vidhiruktaḥ sa kṛtyvidhi- rāmiṣapaśudāsenāsmin yāce draṣṭavyaḥ | asmin yātre tasmāddighaiḥ [ 1pra. 1kha. ] ryṃ viśeṣ bhavet taṃ viśeṣamataḥ paraṃ prakarṣaṇa kathayiṣyāmi | bāikalpaḥ kila vaśiṣṭhapraṇīta iti tatvabhavatī bhaṭṭanārāyaṇastha mataṃ lakṣyate | 'any'pi prātamantritānityevamādik viśeṣa: kapradīpādāśiṣṭhāca śrāḍakalpādupalabdhavyaḥ' - iti gbhilabhāṣye senkatvāt | atrāmiṣaparyudāsena vaśiṣṭhktasya kṛtvasya vidhe ratideśāt madhun'pi deyatā pratīyate | kalauṃ tāvatra bhavati - - "akṣatā gpaśyaiva yāde māṃsaṃ tathā madhu | devarāca suttpattiḥ kalau pañca vivarjayet" # iti mayūkhādau nigamavacanāt || 13 || iti prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | reatme prātarāmanvitān viprān yugmānubhayatastathā | upaveśya kuṇāndadyādṛjunaiva hi pāṇinā || 1 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | viśeṣamāha prathamaghaṭikāye āmantritān yugmabrāhmaṇān | daiveṃ pitre ca tathā pārvvaṇavat prāmukhān deve udasukhān pitre upaveśya ṛjunaiva hastena kuśānāsane dadyāt || 1 || prabhā | pratijñātaṃ viśeṣamāha prātariti prātarāmantritān yugmān brāhmaṇān ubhayata: devapace pitṛpakṣe ca tathā pālaṇavadeva deveṃ prāṅmukhān pivera cdaṅmukhānupaveśya | ṛjunaivāvakreṇaiva hastena kuśān dadyāt | pārkaṇe yāhe pūrvvadine tadahava brāhmaṇa- nimantraṇamuktam | atra tu pūrvva dine nimantraṇaṃ na bhavati | kintu idine prātaḥ | evaṃ pārvvaṇe pitrera ayugmā brāhmaṇā uktāḥ, ava tu tatrāpi yugmā: | pārśva pitṛtīrthena dāna muktam | atra tu ṛjunā hastena devatīrthenetyarthaḥ || 1 || kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 2kha. ] haritā yajñiyā darbhāḥ pītakā: pākayajñiyāḥ | samūlā: piṭadaivatyāḥ kalmāṣā vaiśvadevikāḥ || 2 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | kuśān dayādityukteryādṛśāḥ kuśāḥ kanmāṅgabhūtāstānāha darśādiyajñāryā haritāḥ, pañcayajñārthā: pītavarṇāḥ, piḍhadaivata- karmārthā: samūlā:, viśvadevaśrādārthāstilakpetāḥ | kuśā- utpāvyā iti śeṣaḥ | kāṣāyaiva daivikā iti kalpatarupāṭhaḥ | tadā ca vyakta evārthaḥ | atra ca prasaṅgādyajñādyarthā apyuktāḥ || 2 || prabhā | kuśān dadyāditi prasaṅgena yasmin karmāṇi yādṛśāḥ kuśā- bhavanti tadāha haritā iti | haritā darbhā darśādiyajñāḥ | pītavarṇā darbhā: pākayajñārhāḥ | pitṛdevatyā darbhā: samūlā mūla- sahitāḥ | piṭakamaṇi samūlā ityarthaḥ | viśvadevārthā darbhā kalyāpāstilakpetāḥ kṛṣṇapāṇḍarā iti yāvat | kalmāṣāścaiva daivikā iti samdhara: paṭhati | tadābyakta evārthaḥ | nanu ka- ime pākayā nāma ? tatra vyākhyātār vivadante | kecidāhuḥ | pākāṅgakayajñā iti | pañcayajñā ityeke | praśastayajñā ityanye | avyayajā ityapare | devayajñādaya iti kecit | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ | ekāgnī ye yajñāste pākayajñāḥ | kasmāt ? "pākayajñā- ityācacate ekāmnī yajñān" iti sūtrakāravacanāt || 2 || [ 1pra. 2kha. ] kama pradīpaḥ | haritā vai sapiñjulāḥ śuṣkāḥ snigdhāḥ samāhitāḥ | rabimāvāḥ pramāṇena pitṛtīryeṇa saṃskṛtāḥ || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | pitrarthānāṃ varṣaparimāṇadīnyāha- sapilāḥ prādeśamātrārdrakānyataraśaurṇapuṣpamañjarīsahitāḥ, sthūlapavāḥ, kmalāḥ, samāhitāḥ netastatī vikṣiptaparṇāḥ, kṛta- muṣṭihastapramāṇāḥ, pitṛtīrghasaṃygasaṃskṛtāḥ, piṭaka nyupādeyā- iti śeṣaḥ | ratnipramāṇatā ca piṇḍāstaraṇārthānāmeva | āsanā- iyatsargādyarthānāntu gkarṇapramāṇatā tathāca vāyupurāṇam- "ratnipramāṇāḥ śastā ve pitṛtīrthena saṃskṛtāḥ | upamūle tathā lūnāḥ prastarārthe kuśā matāḥ " || brahmapurāṇe- "haritāca sapicūlā : snigdhāḥ puṣṭāḥ samāhitā; | gkarṇadīrghāta kumā: sakacchinnā: samūlakāḥ || pitṛtīrthena yā dūrvā śyāmākameva ca | kāśā: kuśāvavajāśca tathā'nye tīkṣṇarmaśāḥ || maujāśca śādalācaiva ṣaḍdarbhāḥ parikīrttitā : " || prabhā | haritā iti | haritāḥ haridvarṇāḥ sapicūlāḥ mañjarīsahitāḥ sāgrā vā | puṣṭāḥ sthūlapavāḥ | sidhā : kmalā prakarkaśā iti · kuśttamāḥ iti kha pustake pāṭhaḥ | kamapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 2kha. ] piṇḍārthaṃ ye stṛtādarbhāstarpaṇārthe tathaiva ca | dhṛtaiḥ kṛte ca viṇmūtre tyāgasteṣāṃ vidhīyate ||4|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | trmaśā iti vatvajānāṃ viśeṣaṇam | tena teṣāmalābhe śūka- tṛṇaśaraśauryabatvajamutavanalasuṇṭhavarja sarvatṛṇānīti gbhilktana 34 tayatiriktavatvajñānāṃ niṣedh bḍavyaḥ | gkarṇaparimāṇañca, prādeśatālagkarṇa ityabhidhānakṣe pratipāditam | mukhyakuśā- bhāve dūrvādaunāṃ grahaṇam | tadabhāve sarvvaṭaṇānīti gbhilenka- tvāt| ataeva, kuśābhāve kuśasthāne kāśaṃ dūvā vā dadyāditi viṣṇuḥ || 3 || tyānyān kuśānāi - ye piṇḍāstaraṇe ye kuśāḥ, ye ca tapeṇārtha, yaisa tairvigamūle kvate, teṣāṃ tyāgaḥ karttavyaḥ | te kammasu na yjyā ityarthaḥ | anye'pi tyājyāstān āha laghuhārīta:- prabhā | yāvat | samāhitā nirdṣā: itastat'vikṣiptapatrā vā | rabimāvāḥ kṛtamuṣṭihast raviḥ, tatparimāṇā: | pitṛtīrthena takaṃygena saṃskṛtāḥ | ta ime darbhā: piṭakamaṇi bḍavyāḥ || 3 || tyānyān darbhānāha piṇḍārthamiti | piṇḍadānārthaṃ ye darbhā stṛtāḥ, pitṛtarpaṇārthaṃ ye htāḥ | bhṛtairityupalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | yedhṛterdarbherupalacitena puṃsā vismūce kṛte, teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ darbhāṇāṃ kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāmaḥ | "citau pathi ca ye darbha ye darbhāyajñabhūmiṣu | staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu ṣaṭkuśān parivarjayet || nauvīmadhye tu ye darbhā yajñasūtre ca ye kṛtāḥ | pavitrāṃssānvijānīyādyathā kāyastathā kuśā: "# etaca te kṛte cetyasthāpavādakaṃ- [ 1pra. 2kha. ] - . "piṇḍāyeṃ ye stṛtādarbhā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam | sūtrcchiṣṭe dhṛtā ye ca teṣāṃ tyāg vidhīyate" || ityetadanantaraṃ laghuhārītena nauvīmadhye ityuktatvāt | tyājyavyati- prabhā |. tyāg vidhīyate | naiva te kammai viniyjyā ityarthaḥ | piṇḍāyeṃ stutānāṃ darbhāṇāṃ pitṛtarpaṇārthaṃ gṛhītānāca tyājyatve teṣu piṇḍadānaṃ taiḥ pitṛtarpaṇañca na syāt | naiṣa dṣaḥ | tathāle stṛtānāṃ piṇḍārthatvasya, gṛhītānāṃ tarpaṇārthatvasya cānupapatteḥ | tasmāt yeṣu darbheṣu piṇḍadānaṃ yaiṣa pitṛtarpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ karmā ntareṣu tyājyatvamucyate, na tattatkama khapi tyājyatvamucyate | tathā sati darbheṣu piṇḍadānasya dameṃ: pitṛtarpaṇasya cpadeśa: pramattagītaṃ syāt | etasmādavagamyate, ekatra viniyuktānāmapi darbhāṇamanyava viniyg'stauti | • tathāca gṛhyapariśiṣṭam - "darbhā: kṛṣṇājinaṃ mantrā brāhmaṇā haviramayaḥ | ayātayāmānyetāni niyjyāni punaḥ punaḥ " || kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | riktāstu viniyuktā api viniyjyā: | tathāca gṛhapari 19 śiṣṭam - pap "darbhā: kṛṣṇājinaṃ mantrā brāhmaṇā haviragnayaḥ | ayātayāmānyetāni niyjyāni punaḥ punaḥ" || iti | yātayāmaṃ jīṇeṃ, tat yad bhavati tadayātayāmaṃ savakheṃ kāryakṣamamiti yāvat | atra marcyukt viśeṣaḥ- "māse nabhasyamāvasyā tasyāṃ darbhṃccaymataḥ | ayātayāmāste darbhā viniyjyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ" iti || 4 || iti | marīci:- [ 1pra. 2kha ] prabhā "māse nabhasyamāvasyā tasyāṃ darbhacay mataḥ | ayātayāmāste darbhā viniy jyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || • etamādacanāt śrāvaṇāmāvasyāyāmāhatānāmeva darbhācāmaghāsayāsatayā punaḥ punarviniyjyatvamiti bahusammatā vyavasthā | kecittu gṭahmapariśiṣṭavacanāt sāmānyata eva darbhāṇā- mayātayāmalam| marīcivacanatu- "kadācitrāireḍidvān prasṛte keśave kuśān | abhāve tu sasuvṛtya pare'hani vivarjjayet || itya sthāpavādaka miyāḥ | laghuhārītastvanyeṣāmapi keṣāści irbhāṇāṃ parivarjanamāha tadyathā- [ 1pra. 2kha. ] kamapradṣaḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ pātayejjānu devān paricaran sadā | pātayeditarajjānu pitṝn paricarannapi || 5 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | viśeṣāntaramāha- pāvasiṣṭha ke devārthayāḍe devān paricaran dakṣiṇajānupātanaṃ kuryāt | pitṝn punamtadarthavādakaraṇe paricaran vāmaṃ jānu pātaye- diti || 5 || - prabhā | "citau darbhāḥ pathi darbhā ye darbhā yajñabhūmiṣu | staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu ṣaḍdarbhān parivarjjayet" || iti | tathā tasyaiva- - "piṇḍāyeṃ ye stṛtā darbhā yaiḥ kvataṃ pitṛtarpaṇam | mūtrcchiṣṭaidhṛtā ye ca tyāgasteṣāṃ vidhīyate || nīvīmadhye ca ye darbhā brahmasūtre ca ye dhṛtāḥ | pavitrāṃstān vijānīyāt yathā kāyastathā kuśā : " || iti | yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpamityabhidhānāt yairdevatāditarpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ taiḥ pitṛtarpaṇa karaṇe tvadṣaḥ | nauvīmadhye ceti vacanaṃ mūtr- cchiṣṭairvṛtā ye cetyasyāpavādakam | mūtrcchiṣṭarghṛtā ye cetyatra mūtrcchiṣṭapralepe ceti kvacit pāṭhaḥ || 4 || dakṣiṇamiti | pālaṇe devaṃ karmama kurvvan dakṣiṇaṃ jānu pātayet bhūmau sthāpayet | pitrā kama kurvan | na tu 'svagṭahyktamātra mevānuṣṭheyamiti tasyārthaḥ | gṛhmānuktānāṃ sādhāra khānā upadeśānartha kyāpatteḥ | śākhāntarādhikaraṇavirdhāñca || 3 || [ 1pra. 3kha. ] prabhā | tatra makriyetyuktam | dvitīyaślkena svaśāstrktaṃ praygamupekṣya para śāstrkta praygasyānuṣṭhānaṃ niṣiddham | tṛtīyena tu yat svaśākhāya ncyate, aviruddhaṃ tat parktamapyanuṣṭheyamityupadiṣṭam | svaśākhāśrayamityanena skhabhāstrkta praygaparityāgena paraśāstrka praygānuṣṭhānasya ninditatvāt parktā cetyanena khaśāstrkapraygā nuṣṭhānakāle parktasyānuṣṭhānamakriyetyucyate | evañca svaśāstrktasya praygasthāntarā'ntarā parkṣānuṣṭhānaṃ na karttavyamiti tasyārthī | anyathā'naryakatvāpatteḥ| taccedaṃ svaśāstrkta praygasyāntarā'ntarā paraśāstrktasyāṅguṣṭhānaṃ śrauteṣu na śakyate niṣecum | htrādi- tattacchākhāsa teṣāṃ "praygaśāstraṃ gṛhyādi na samuccīyate paraiḥ | praygaśāstratāhāneranārambha vidhānataḥ || bahulyaṃ vā svagṭahyktaṃ yasya kanma prakīrttitam | tasya tāvati śāstrāyeṃ kṛte sarvvaḥ kṛt bhavet || śrauteṣu iti | tadidaṃ tavabhavat gbhilaputrasya vacanatrayaṃ kātyāyana- samānārtham | tatra prathamavacanaṃ yavānātamityanena, dvitīyavacanaṃ parktā cetyanena, batauyavacanaṃ svaśākhāśrayamutsṛjyetyanena bhākhāntarādhikaraṇanyāya- virdha iti vācyam | takrāyasya śrītaviṣayatvāt | vācanike- the nyāyānavatārāca | kiñca nān'bhede'pi yathāsambhavaṃ rūpabhedā- dibhyaḥ tasya tasya karmāntaratvameveti kutra kasya guṇpasaṃhāraḥ | na hi kammantire kamantiraguṇānāmupasaṃhāraḥ śāstrānumataḥ | ataeva - "naikasmin kamaṇi tate karmānyattāyate yataḥ" | ityanena vaiśvadevava likamaṇḥ sāmānyayḥ viśeṣtābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ karmāntaratvaṃ svayameva vakṣyati | yaca purāṇta sādhāraṇaṃ, tat yadyapina pārakyaṃ, tathāpi svaśāstrkta prayge na tasya guṇpasaṃhāraḥ | tasya karmāntaratvāt kamāntare caṃ karmāntaraguṇānāmupasaṃhārā ygāt| pūrvvktagṭahyapariśiṣṭe anārambha vidhānādanyairgṛhyādeḥ samu cayaniṣedhācca | kintu svaśāstrktapraygānuṣṭhānānantaraṃ phalabhūya- stvārthamicchayā tasyāpyanuṣṭhānaṃ bahvalpaṃ vā svagṭahyktamityādi | madana- pārijāte'pyuktam | asamarthayet khagṭahyktamātrameva karti tātaiva tasya śāstrāryativerutatvāt, iti | tasmāt śrauteṃṣu pāraśākhikaṃ karttavyaṃ, gṛhykteṣu tana karttavyam | anārabhya vihitantu gṛhykt'pi prayga karttavyaṃ, parameṣāmakaraṇe'pi kapradīpaḥ | pravṛttamanyathā kuryyādya dimhātkathañcana | yatastadanyathābhūtaṃ tataeva samāpayet || 4 || [ 1pra. 3kha. ] pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | devādavathā kriyāyāṃ yatkarttavyaṃ, tadāha- pravṛttaṃ prārabdhaṃ yatkarma karaṇe satyevānyathā kramānyatvena kuyāt | tatra yasmātpadārthādārabhya yaska mānyathājātaṃ apaḥ cipenmūladeśe'vamenikṣveti nistilāḥ ||11|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ādyaṃ pitaraṃ aādāna iva sambdhanāntanāmagtrābhyāṃ nirdiśya pūvāgreṣu staraṇakuśeṣu mūladeśe bhavaneniveti tilarahitā apaḥ cipet | ava ca prāgagratā nislilatā ca vasiṣṭhktā ḍiśeṣaḥ || 11 || prabhā | mākhāmede'nyathpadeśāca | na hi tatparityāgenādivarāhakata praygaviṣayaṃ brahmapurāṇavākyamādarttumucitam | śeṣabhjana- caivaṃ yajamānasya na syāt brahmapurāṇe śeṣastheṣṭebhy dānkteḥ | tathāca gṛhmādivirdhaḥ| śeṣamanamastauti brāhmaṇebhy nivedaye- diti nārāyaṇpādhyāya vyākhyānamapi pramāṇaśūnyam || 10 || pitar hyāceṣṭāḥ | tava piṇḍadānena pitṛṇāmupabhg- bhavatīti piḍadānaṃ vaśumupakrasate prāgagreṣviti | athaśabd- viśiṣṭānantavyajñāpanārthaḥ | brāhmaṇapratyuttarapiṇḍa piṭavātideśa- prāptarekhākaraṇādyanantaramityarthaḥ | mādyaṃ pitaraṃ ardhapradānktavat saṃbdhanāntagvādibhirāma nvā bhavaneniyetyuvā piṇḍa pradānārtha- māstu teṣu pūrvvāśreṣu kuśeṣu mūladeśe tilarahitamudakaṃ kṣipet | nistitā ityukteḥ apāṃ sayavatvamavagamyate | yavaskhilārtha iti vacanāt || 11 || kampradīpaḥ | dvitīyañca tṛtīyañca madhyadeśāgra deśayḥ mātāmahaprabhṛtastu eteṣāmeva vāmataḥ || 12 || sarvasmādannamuddṛtya vyañjanairupasicya ca | saṃyjya yavakarkandhūdhimiḥ prāṅmukhastataḥ ||13|| [ 1pra. 3kha ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | dvitīyaṃ pitāmaham | hṛtīyaṃ prapitāmaham | ādyavadāmantrā staraṇakumānāṃ madhyāgrayrmūlavadap vinicit | eteṣāmeva trayāṇāṃ vāmatdakṣiṇasyāṃ digi, yathā dakṣiṇpacārbhavati tathā, āstīrṇa kuśeṣa prāgagreṣu mātāmahādaunāṃ mūlamadhyāgra deśeṣu pūrvyavadap vinikṣipet || 12 || tadanantarañca - sarvasmātprakṛtādavādanaṃ gṛhītvā vyañjanaimmiśrayitvā yavavadarada dhibhiḥ prabhā | dvitīyaśceti | dvitīyaṃ pitāmahaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prapitāmahaṃ pūrvyava dāmantrā avane nivatyuccārya yathākramaṃ āstṛtakuśānāṃ madhyadeśe agradeśe ca nistilā apa: kṣipedityanuṣajyate | eteṣāmeva pitrā- dīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vāmat dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśtyartha: | pilḍapradānārtha- māvāhitānāṃ pitrādīnāṃ pratyamukhatvasyaucityāt | evañca sati pradakṣiṇamupacāra: sampadyate| mātāmahaprabhṛtīn mātāmaha pramātā- mahahaḍapramātāmahān pūrvvavadā mantrātyādi pūrvkta manuvarttate ||12|| piṇḍadānaprakāramāha sarvvasmāditi iābhyām | sarvvasmāt kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 3kha. ] avanejanavatpiṇḍān datvā vilvapramāṇakān | tatpātracālanenātha punaramyavanejayet || 14 || tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | saṃyjya prāmukh bilvamātrān ṣaṭ piṇḍān kṛtvā'vanejanavaddatvā piṇḍapāvapracālana jalena punaravanejayet | atra svktaprāṅmukha- tvenāśvalāyanktam ābhyudayike yugmā brāhmaṇāḥ samūlā: darbhāḥ prāmukhebhyaḥ udamukhdayāditi udamukhatvaṃ bādhyam || 13 || 14 || iti tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | prabhā | śrāddhārthādatrādityarthaḥ | śeṣamacaṃ nivedayedityanena tathaivāvagateḥ | sarvvatvamādhikārika miti siddhāntāt | "sarvvasmāt prakatādanāt piṇḍān madhutilānvitān" | iti pālaṇe darśanāca | prakṛtādavādanamuhṛtya pātrāntaraṃ kṛtvā vyaśvanairupasicca mitrayitvā yavakarkandhūddhibhiḥ saṃyjya prāṅmukh- bilvaparimitān piṇḍān avanejanavat dattvā piṇḍapātrapracālana - jalena punaravanejayet| karkandhūvaṃdaram | prasiddhamanyat | avane- anavadityanena mūlamadhyāyadeśeṣu piṇḍadānamuktam | avanejaye- divyukteravāpyavamenive tipraygaḥ || 13 || 14 || iti tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | uttarttaradānena piṇḍānāmuttarttaraḥ | bhavedadhaścācaraṇādadh'dhaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || 1 || tasmācchrādveṣu sarveṣu vṛddhimatkhitareṣu ca | mūlamadhyāgradeśeṣu īṣatmaktāṃśca nirvpet || 2 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | mūlādikrameṇa piṇḍadānaṃ stauti - piṇḍānāṃ mūlādikrameṇa uparyupari dānena dātā uparyupari bhavati jagatibhāgī bhavatīti stutiḥ | viparītadānena tvadhgatiḥ śrāika bhavati || 1 || tasprāiviśrādeṣvanyeṣu ca pārvaṇādiṣu mūlādikrameṇa īṣallagnāṃca piṇḍārvipediti || 2 || prabhā | mūlādikrameṇa piṇḍadānasya phalavāda manvayavyatirekābhyāmāha uttarttarati | - śrāddhakamaṇi mūlādikrameṇparyupari pradeśe piṇḍānāṃ dānena dātā'pyuīgatirbhavati | agrādikrameṇādh- 'dha:pradeśe piṇḍānāṃ dānena dātā'pyadhdhgatirbhavati || 1 || mūlādikrameṇa piṇḍadānamupasaṃharati tasmāditi | yasmādevaṃ, tasmāt vṛddhimatku itareṣu pārvvaṇeṣu ca saveṃṣu yātreṣu piṇḍadānārtha- rṭa kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 4kha ] gandhādīnniḥ cipettūṣṇa tata ācāmayeddijān | anyatrāpyeṣa eva syādyavādirahit vidhiḥ || 3 || dakṣiṇāplavaṇe deśe dakṣiṇābhimukhasya ca | dakṣiṇāyeṣu darbheṣu eṣ'nyatra vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 4|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | piṇḍeṣvamantraka gandhapuṣpādnarpayitvā brāhmaṇācamanaṃ kārayet | eṣa eva piṇḍadānavidhiḥ anyatrāpi pārvaṇādau yavadevatīrthpavīta- dakṣiṇpacāraśūnyaḥ syāt || 3 || na kevalaṃ yavādirahita: dakṣiṇānave, na vṛhāviva prācīna nave dakṣiṇāmukhasya dātuna prāmukhasya | dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu na prāgadveṣu | eṣa piṇḍadānavidhiḥ pārvaṇādau munibhiḥ smṛta iti || 4 || prabhā | māstṛtakaśānāṃ mūlamadhyāgrapradeśeṣu alpalamnān piṇḍān dadyāt | harirāśāsyamānaṃ maṅgalakamī || 2 || ganyādīniti | piṇḍeṣvamantrakaṃ gandhādīn niḥkṣipet | tataḥ śrāddhabhktṛbrāhmaṇānācāmayet | lepagharṣaṇapracālanādibhirmukhahasta- śdhanaṃ kārayet | anyatra pārvvaṇe'pi yavādirahita eṣa eva vidhiḥ syāt | yavādītyādipadāt devatīrthpavītitvaprāmukhatva- draciṣaṇānupātadakṣiṇpacāraparigrahaḥ || 3 || dakṣiṇājhavane iti | daciṇanik deśe dakṣiṇābhimukhasya kampradīpaḥ | athāyabhūmimāsiñcetsusaṃprkṣitamastviti | śivā āpaḥ sanviti ca yugmānevdakena ca ||5|| saumanasyamastviti ca puṣpadānamanantaram | akṣatañcāriṣṭañcāstu akṣatān pratipādayet || 6 || [ 1pra. 4kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ācamanānantaraṃ brāhmaṇāgrabhūmiṃ susaṃprcitama sviti prkṣayet | śivā āpa ityādinā yugmāneva naikaṃ udakena haste āsiścet ||5|| saumanasyeti haste puṣpadānaṃ kuryāt | anantaramacatamityā- dinā yavān dadyāt || 6 || prabhā | kartuḥ dakṣiṇāgreṣu kuśeṣu eṣa piṇḍadānavidhiḥ anyatra pārvvaṣādī smṛt munibhiḥ || 4 || atheti | brāhmaṇanāmācamanānantaraṃ teṣāmagrabhūmiṃ susaṃ- prkṣitamasvityanenāsiñcet | udakeneti vakṣyamāṇamanuṣajyate | śivā āpa ityanena yugmāneva brāhmaṇān na tvekaikaṃ, udakenā- siñcet | haste iti śeṣaḥ || 5 || saumanasyamiti | saumanasyamityādinā brāhmaṇahaste puṣpa- dānaṃ kuryyāt | tadanantaramacatañcetyādinā brāhmaṇahaste yavān dadyāt | akṣatā yavāḥ | akṣatāstu yavā: prktā ityukteḥ | 'dāpayediti khārthe ca | khayamaśaklāvanyadvārā'pi vṛddhiśrā karttavyamiti prajñāpanābhiprāyeṇa vā || 6 || L kamapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 4kha ] akṣayydakadānaca arghyadānavadiṣyate | ṣaṣṭheva nityaṃ satkāryaṃ na caturdhyā kadācana || 7 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ardhājaladānavat jyeṣṭhttarakarayugmabrāhmaṇakare pratyeka kuryyā divyarthaḥ | kintu tatrāmagtrāntcāritaṣaścaiva kuyāt na kadācidapi caturtheti | ṣaścaiva nityamiti gvanāmānte saṃbuddhi- sthāne ṣaṣṭhṃ vidhatte | na caturṣyā kadācaneti tasmai te khadheti caturthīniṣedhakamityapunaktiḥ | ava gbhilīyaḥ-- "gvaṃ kharāntaṃ sarvatra gtrasyātavyakarmaṇi | gvastu tarpaṇe prktaḥ karttā evaṃ na muhyati | sarvatraiva pitaḥ prktaḥ pitā tarpaṇakarmaṇi | piturakṣayyadāne tu acayāṃ tṛptimicchatā" tathā "śa maṃtrarṣyādike kāryyaṃ śarmā tarpaṇakarmaṇi | śarmaṇ'jjayyadāne tu pitṛṇāṃ dattamakṣayam" || 7 || prabhā | - avayyeti | ayyadakadānaṃ punarardhya dānavadiṣyate | ardhā- dānavadityanena jyeṣṭhttarakaratvamāvasyātideśaḥ payevasyati | bhadrāpyatu ityanuṣacyate, tenācavyamastu iti praygaḥ | ataevaitada- namvara prārthanāsa pratiprśe ityādikamāvasyenpapatyate | sadacavydakadānaṃ nityaṃ ṣaṣṭheva kāvyamityanena gvasaṃbandhanātrāṃ kammapradīpaḥ | prabhā | ṣaṣṭhāntatāmabhidhatte | tenārvādānavadityatideśena gtrasaṃbandhanātrāṃ saṃbdhanavibhaktayansatāuna na bhavati | upadeśenātideśabādhāt | śara- mayavarhiṣā kuśamayavahirvādhavat | tathāca svānasūtrapariśiṣṭam – "gtraṃ svarāntaṃ sarvvatra gtrasyātayyakamaṇi | gtra tarpaṇe prktaḥ karttā evaṃ na muhyati || sarvvatraiva pitaḥ prktaṃ pitā tarpaṇakamaṇi | piturakṣayyakāle tu akṣayāṃ tṛptimicchatā || • śammannarthyādika kā śarmā tarpaṇakamaṇi | śamaṇ'cayyakāle tu pitṝṇāṃ dattadakṣayam" | iti | tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panyā vidyate anāya iti maheśvarasvāmbaka eva nāparaḥ iti caivamādivat ṣaṣṭhaitravetyeva- kāravyavacchedyaṃ darśayati na catuththā kadācaneti | s'yaṃ vihitapratiṣedhaḥ | vihitaṃ keṣāñcit catuththā akṣayydakadānam | tathāca aranti [ 1ma. 4kha ] 68 "nāndīmukhebhyavājavyaṃ pitṛbhya idama stviti" | iti | tadanena niṣiṣyate | tathācktam | "vihitapratiṣedhvā" iti | yattu nārāyaṇpādhyāyairuktam | ṣaṣṭhava nityamityanena gvanāmānte sambuddhisthāne ṣaṣṭhṃ vidhatte, na caturṣyā kadācaneti tī te svadheti caturthīniṣedhaka mityapunaruktiriti | tadasaṅgatam | te iti yuṣmadaḥ sambdhyamānārthavācitvāt ṣaṣṭhayānirdeśe tasyā- asamavetārthatayā prasaktayabhāvena niṣedhānupapatteḥ | na hyaprasa kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 4kha. ] prārthanāsu pratiprkta sarvāṃkheva hijttamaiḥ | pavitrāntarhitān piṇḍān siñceduttānapātrakṛt ||8|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | anantarañca - susaṃprkṣitama stvityādyāsu pañcasa prārthanāsu brāhmaṇairastu sanvi- prabhā | niṣidhyate | nityānuvādatu syāt | yaśa tattvakatāṃ matam | akṣayydakadāne na catuthyā kadācanetyanena ye cā veti mantrasya niṣedhena acavydakadānetaratra sarvatra ye cāva veti mantraḥ paṭhanīya- iti jñāpyate | anyathā akṣayydakadāne tanmantrasya prasatyabhāve niṣedh na sambhavati | tattatsthāne viśiṣya gbhilasya tamantrpa- deśastu pradarśaka iti | tadayuktam | akṣayydakadāne tanmantrasyā- prasaktedarśitatvāt | na catutyasya vihitapratiṣedharūpatvasykta stvāca | tasmātrāyaṃ ye cātra tveti mantrasya niṣedha: | kintu keṣāścidabhimatāyāyatucyā eveti kathamanena sarvvava ye cātra veti mantr jñāpyate iti śakyate vaśum | yena gbhilasya viśiṣypa- deśa: pradarśaka: syāt | arghadāne ye cātra tveti mantrīpadeśāt avayydakadāne ardhagdānavadityatideśāca prasatasya tanmantrasya niṣedh'pyupapadyataeveti kathamanenānupadiṣṭasthale'pi tanmantr- jñāpyate iti na khalbadhigacchāmi| vistareṇa caitat śrādakalpabhāṣye vivecitamasmābhirityupāramyate || 7 || prārthanākhiti | susaṃmcitamastu ityādikā pañca prārthanāsa kammapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśa | tyādi uttare prśe svadhāvācanasthāne'rvaprapātrīyapavitrācchādi- tān piṇḍān nāndīmukhebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pryantāmityuktā siñcet | anantaraṃ nyunīkṛtaṃ pātramuttānaṃ kṛtvā yugmānevetyādi- vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryyāt | gbhilabhāṣyakatā tu, susaṃprcitama stvi- tyādi svadhāvācanāntaṃ kṛtvā kṛtttānapāvaḥ tatpravitrāṇi piṇḍānāmupari datvā piṇḍānū vahantīriti siñcediti vyākhyātam || 8 || [ 1pra. 4kha ] prabhā | yathāyathamastu sanviti brāhmaṇe: pratyuttaraṃ kṛte pavitravyavahitān piṇḍān nyuñjapātramuttānaṃ kṛtvā siñcet | yattu piṇḍame𳇊nānantaraṃ nyunapātramuttānaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryyāditi nārāyaṇpādhyāyena vyākhyātam | tadasamīcīnam | yathāśrutārthaparityāge mānā- bhāvāt | mmāṃsābhāṣyakāreṇāpi śabdasya śravaṇamātrāt y'rth- vagamyate satyā'vagamyate ityuktam | na ca śrutiḥ parityakṣaṃ yuktā | gṭahyabhāṣye bhaṭṭanārāyaṇenāpi uttānapātrakaditi pariṣecanakartṛ- viśeṣaṇatayaiva vyākhyātam | yañcktaṃ tattvakāraṇa uttānapātra- kvaditi yathāśrutadarśanāt pariṣecanakarttṛviśeṣaṇatayā bhaṭṭena yadyākhyātaṃ tagbhila śrāvastrānavalkanena | tathāca pariṣecana- suvānantaraṃ gbhilaḥ | uttānaṃ pāvaṃ ktvā yathāśaktidakṣiṇāṃ dayāditi | tatra brūmaḥ | śrāhakalpe tāvat tattvakārktapāṭh na dṛśyate | kampradīpaḥ | tava khalbevaṃ paṭhyate | prabhā ·· svadhāniyanīye dhārāṃ dadyādū 4 vahantīrityuttānaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā viśve devāḥ prauyantāmiti daive vācayitvā piṇḍapātrāṇi cālayitvā yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt iti | vyākhyātaścānayaivānupūrvvā grany'yaṃ māyakvadbhiḥ | tatra tāvat uttānaṃ pāvaṃ kṛtvā iti madhyapaṭhatasya viśeṣābhāvāt pūrvva svapratīkatvamapi śakāte vasuṃ parastrapratīkatvamapi 1 prayga- svbhayathā darśanāt | tathāhi abhyudite śūrye devadatta prātarāśaṃ bhule caṃkramaṇaṃ kṛtvā madhyandine khātvā vāsasī paridhāyāpūpān bhavayati ityatva yadi abhyudita sūrye dadattaḥ prathamaṃ caṃkramaṇaṃ karti tataḥ prātarāśaṃ bhuṅkṣe tadā cakramaṇaṃ kṛtveti pūrvvasyaiva vākyasya pratīkaṃ viparyaye ca parasya prayuṣve caivaṃ munayaḥ aba ne janadānapratyaya neja neṣu nāmagrāisityādau | tadevamubhayathā praygadarśanāduttānaṃ pātraṃ kṛtye tyasya parasūtrapratīkatāyāṃ na pramāṇam | avamavataḥ kātyāyanasya vacanāttu pūrvvastraprkatvameva tasya niyatavyam bhavati | yathārthaparityāgaścānucita ityukta- mādāveva sa khalapaṭānṃ karmaṇāṃ vidhi samyaga darśayiṣye iti pratijñātavān | tadalaṃ mānyānāsupari kaṭākṣapātena | pavitrāntarhitānityabhidhānāt piṇḍānāmantardhānārthaṃ pavitra- mutpādayitavyam | yastvayaya vivetanavarṇanam | tadasaṅgatam | viniyuktaviniyge mānābhāvāt | anyathā piṇḍadānāyeṃ rekhā- karaṇamapi tenaiva paviṣeṣa syāt || 8 || 99 [ [ 1pra. 4kha. ] kamapradīpaḥ | yugmāneva khastivācyānaṅguṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ sadā | kṛtvā dhuryasya viprasya praṇamyānuvrajettataḥ || 8 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yugmāneva naikaṃ dakṣiṇādānena svastivācca, dhuryasya paṃktimūnyasya brāhmaṇasyānaṅguṣṭhapāṇigrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamya tat'nugacchet | atra ca dakṣiṇā drācāmalakādi | tathā brahmapurāṇam- tapaḥ- "drācāmalakamūlāni yavāṃcātha nivedayet | tānyeva dakṣiṇārthantu dayāhimeṣu sarvadā " || mūlamāīkādi nivedayet śrādebiti | vṛddhau ca gbhilauyai- māyā na karttavyam | na yṣiyaḥ pṛthagdayāditi vakṣyamāṇa- vacanāgbhilenānuktatvācca | ancaitu karttavyameva | tathāca mātā- "mātṛśrāddhaṃ tu pūrvaṃ syāt pitṝṇāṃ tadanantaram | tat mātāmahānāṃ ca vṛddhau śrāivayaṃ smṛtam || triṣvapyeteṣu yugmāṃstu bhjayedrāhmaṇān śuciḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ tu savyena pradadyāddevapūrvvakam" || prabhā | yugmāneveti | yugmāneva naikaikaṃ dakṣiṇādānena khastivācya dhuvyasya paṃktimūrdhanyasya brāhmaṇasthānaṅguṣṭhapāṇigrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamya 10 kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 4kha ] eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ kṛtsna uktaḥ saṃkṣepat mayā | ye vidanti na muhyanti śrāḍakarmasu te kvacit ||10|| 74 pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | iti | anena ca mātṛvāsyāpi sadaivatvābhidhānāt vṛddhau mātrāmadaivamiti kaicciduktam, tanirastam | yattu mārkaṇḍeya - purāṇam - "vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu kecidicchanti mānavāḥ" | iti 1 tacchākhiviśeṣavyavasthitam | ataeva laghuhārīta:- "māṭavāī tu yugmai : syāt sadaivaṃ prāṅmukhaiḥ pṛthak " | iti || 8 || upasaṃharati- eṣaḥ prakṛtaḥ śrāividhiḥ alpagranthena mayā kṛtsna uktaḥ | ye imaṃ bāividhi jānanti vāḍhakriyāviṣayeṣu na bhrāmyanti || 10 || prabhā | tānanugacchet | śrāddhakartā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt brāhmaṇaca svastauti brūyuriti svastivācetyasyārthaḥ || 8 || eṣa iti | eṣ'nantarśaḥ ūtna eva vāḍhavidhiralpena granthena mayā kathitaḥ | ye khalvimaṃ śrāividhiṃ jānanti te śrāddha- kasa kvacidapi na mhaṃ prāpnuvanti || 10 || [pra. 4kha ] kamapradīpaḥ | idaṃ śāstrañca gṛhyañca parisaṃkhyāna mevaca | vasiṣṭhktañca y veda sa śrāddhaṃ veda netaraḥ || 11 || iti caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | 75 pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: śrṭaprtsāhāyeṃ svagranyaṃ stauti - damadu śāstraṃ gṛhyaṃ gbhiltaṃ, parisaṃkhyānākhyañca granthaṃ khanāmaprasiddhaṃ, vasiṣṭhkaṃ chāndgyagṭahyanāmakaṃ, y jānāti sa śrā jānīte nā'nya iti || 11 || caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || prabhā | idamiti | idaṃ madula śāstraṃ, gbhilkaṃ gṭahāṃ, parisaṃkhyānaṃ svanāmaprasiddhaṃ śrāddhamantrāvāhanādipratipādakaṃ, vasiṣṭhktaṃ śrāddha- kalpañca y jānāti sa vāheṃ jānāti netar nktagranthacatuṣkāna- bhijaḥ || 11 || iti caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | WWW.BA 352 pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | SIK asakṛd yāni karmāṇi kriyeran kamekāribhiḥ | pratiygaṃ naiva syurmātaraḥ śrāimevaca || 1 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | karmādiṣu ca sarveṣu mātṛpūjā yācaṃ cetyuktam | tatra keṣu citkammasu viśeṣamāha - pūjā sarvadā sakadeva | yathā, yajanye'hani nitye navayajñavāstuśamanagyajñākha- yajñeṣu samudāyena kriyamāṇeṣu śrāimapi teṣu gaṇādau ekameva, na karmasaṃkhyānusāreṇa śrāddhānyapi tāvatsaṃkhyā nīti || 10 || prabhā | bhavatīti gbhilkte vastradaśānāṃ granthibandhane, tathā mā bhaiṣrna mariṣyasīti viṣavatā daṣṭamagirabhyucan japet iti gbhilkta viṣavatā dṛṣṭasya kammaṇi, tathā hastaste aviṇā krimiriti krimimantaṃ deśamadbhirabhyucan japet paśūnāñcañcikrṣedaparāhṇe stā- lṭamāhatya vaihāyasaṃ nidadhyāt tasya pūbā pāścabhiḥ pari- kiran japediti tenaivktāyāṃ krimidaṣṭasya cikitsāyāṃ, evaṃ tadanantaraṃ tenevttaṣu arhaṇīyāya pādyārghya pradānādiṣu śrāddhaṃ nāsti || 8 || 1 gaṇaśa iti | gaṇaśabda: saṃghavacanaḥ | ekadine kriyamāṇe- bvanekeṣu kamsa, yathā yajanīyadine navayajñavāstuyajñagyajñā kha- yajñeṣu kriyamāṇeṣu anyeṣvapyevaṃ vidheṣu gaṇasthādau mātṛpūjanaṃ śrāddhañca sakadeva bhavati na tu gaṇāntargatānāṃ kamāṇāṃ pratyekamādī pṛthak pṛthak māṭapūjanaṃ śrāvañca karttavyam || 10 || 86 kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 5kha ] yatra yatva bhavecchrāī tatra tatra ca mātaraḥ | prāsaṅgikamidaṃ prktamataḥ prakṛtamucyate || 11 || pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | pūjyā iti śeṣaḥ | karmādiṣvityaneneva vaidikakarmādau yahā tava pūjpakrame mātṛpūjktā, idānṃ putrajanmamukhadarśanādyante'pi yacchrācaṃ tatrāpi mādapūjeti yatra yatra ityanenktamityapuna- ruktiḥ | prāsaṅgikamidaṃ prktamataḥ prakṛtamucyate iti | idaṃ yā mātṛpūjanaṃ ca sūtre yatyakttamādhānaṃ tatprasaṅgasiddhamuktamataḥ paraṃ prakṛtamādhānamucyata iti || 11 || , prabhā | yatra yatreti | yatra yatra śrāī bhavati tatra tatraiva mātaraḥ pūjanīyāḥ | tadanena yavāṣṭakādau śrāhaṃ na bhavati tatra māṭa- pūjāpi na karttavyevyuktaṃ bhavati | vasrghārāpātanāyuṣyamantrajapay- rapi tavākaraṇaṃ pūrvvameva vyavasthāpitamasmābhiḥ | māḍhapūjādikaṃ, śrāividhiḥ, taba viśeṣaḥ, karma viśeṣe śrāhādi niṣedhaśtyetat •sa sarvvāyevānyāhārthavantauti gbhilasvaspaṣṭīkaraṇa prasaṅgen- śam | ataḥ paraṃ prakalamagnyādhānamucyate || 11 || iti pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | ādhānakālā ye prktāstathā yāñcāgniynayaḥ | tadāśray'gnimādadhyādagnimānagraj yadi || 1 || dārādhigamanādhāne yaḥ kuryādagrajāgrimaḥ | parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrbajaḥ || 2 pariśiṣṭaprakāśa | brahmacārī vedamadhītyāntyāṃ samidhamabhyādhāsthan | jāyāyā vā pāṇiṃ jiṣṭacan, ityādinā ye'gnyādhānakālā uktāḥ, yāca vaiśyakulādambarīṣādvetyādinā'gniynaya uktāstadanurudhyāgnyādhānaṃ kuryyāt | yadyagraj'gnimāniti || 1 || anagnau tu jyeṣṭhe'gnyādhāne dṣamāha - jyeṣṭha bhrāturagrakālavarttī y vivāhāgnyādhāne kuryyāt sa parivettā vijñevī jyeṣṭhaśca parivittiriti || 2 || prabhā | ādhānakālā iti | gbhilena, brahmacārī vedamadhīlyānyāṃ samidhamabhyāvāsyacityādinā ye prādhānakālā uktā, vaiśya kulā- dāmbarṣāhā'gnimā ityābhyādadhyādinā ca yā agniynaya ukttā:, tadāśrayaḥ savagnyādhānaṃ kuryyāt yadyagraj'gnimān bhavati | tadane- nāgrajasthānagnimattve'nujenāgnyādhānaṃ na kāryamityukta bhavati ||1|| agrajasthānagnimattve'nujenāgnyādhāne kate kiṃ syāt ? kammapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. kha. ] parivittiparivettārau# narakaṃ gacchat dhruvam | acīrṇaprāyaścittau taupādnaphalabhāginau || 3|| pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | tathāca k dṣa ityāha t pūrvāk akṛtaprāyaścittau itarpapātakaphalasya pād- naphalasya bhāginau | "parivittitā'nujena parivedanameva ca | iti manunā upayātakagaṇe iyamidaṃ paṭhitamiti || 3 || prabhā | tadāha dārādhigamaneti| dārādhigamanaṃ vivāhaḥ | ādhāna- agnyādhānam | agrajena vivāhe agnyādhāne cālate y'nujaḥ vivāhamagnyādhānaṃ ca karti, sa parivettā agrajastu parivitti- vijñeyaḥ || 2 || astu tāvat, kastatra dṣa ityavāha parivittīti | pūrvvāī- matirhitārtham | tayrnarakagamanasya dhruvatvamupapādayavāha api- crṇa prāyaścittāviti kṛtaprāiścittāvapi tau pādnaṃ narakaphalaṃ bhajete iti tayrnakagamanaṃ dhruvamityarthaḥ | na ca prāyaścitte kate tenaiva pāpanāśāt kathaṃ pādnaphalamāgiteti vācyam | ananya gartervacanāt | taduktam | kimiva hi vacanaṃ na kuryyāvāsti parivittiḥ parivettā ca, iti pāṭhāntarama| api cīrthaprāyaścittau iti ka ga pustake pāṭhaḥ| kamapradīpaḥ | klīvaikavṛṣaṇānasahdarān | || 4 || vaiśyātisaktapatitaśūdratulyātirgiṇaḥ | jaḍamūkāndhavadhirakulavāmanakuṇṭhakān [[atiṅadānabhāṣyaśca kṛṣisaktānnṛpasya ca || 5 || dhanabṛddhiprasaktāṃśca kāmataḥ kāriṇastathā | kulaṭnmattacaurāṃśca parivindanna duṣyati || 6 || [ 1pra. 6kha. ] deśāntarastha pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yādṛśe jyeṣṭhe parivedanadṣ nāsti tamāha - klvaḥ ṣaḍavidhaḥ | tathāca devala:- "baṇḍak vātajaḥ ṣaṇḍa : paṇḍa : klv napuṃsakam | kaulaka śceti ṣaḍdhā'yaṃ klīvabhed vibhāṣitaḥ || 88 prabhā | vacanasyātitāra iti | kecittu acīrṇa prāyaścittāviti paṭhitvā kṛtaprāyaścitta t itarpapātakāpekṣayā pādnanarakaphalastra bhāginī | "parivittitā'nujena parivedanameva ca | iti manunā upapātake tadubhayḥ pāṭhāttadapekṣayaiva pādnatvasya varṇayitumucitatvādityāhu: | api caurṇaprāyaścittāviti pāṭhasyaiva sarvata mūlapustakaṃṣu dṛṣṭatvāt sa eva pāṭhī vyākhyāt- ismābhiḥ || 3 || yādṛśeṣu agrajeṣvakṛtavivāheṣvakṛtāgnyādhāneṣu cānujasya 12 kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśa | veṣāṃ strītulyavākceṣṭaḥ strdharmā ṣaṇḍak bhavet | pumān kṛtvā khaliṅgāni paścādbhindyāttathaivaca | strī ca puṃbhāvamāsyāya puruṣācāravadguṇā | vātaj nāma ṣaṇḍa: syāt strṣaṇḍ vāpi nāmataḥ || asalliṅg'tha ṣaṇḍaḥ syātpaṇḍastu glānamehanaḥ | ameṣyāśī pumān klv naṣṭaretā napuṃsakam || saklaka iti prktya: kaivyādātmanaḥ striyam | anyena saha saṃyjya paścāttāmeva sevate" [ 1pra. 6kha. ] pumān kavvetvāderayamarthaḥ | yaḥ pumān liṅgāntarāṇi kṛtvā khaliṅga bhindyāt, sa vātajnāma ṣaṇḍaḥ iti saṃbandha: | anena dākṣiṇātyaprasiddhaṃ vidaprajananatvamuktam | tathā, yā strī gṛhīta- puruṣacihnā svāntaramabhigacchati s'pi vātajnāma ṣaṇḍaḥ | tathā sa eva strīṣa ṇḍanāmāpi tathā asaliṅg'pi vātajaḥ ṣaṇḍa: syāditi saṃbandhaḥ | etena triprakār vātajaḥ ṣaṇḍa ityukram | glānamehannirvikāraliṅgaḥ | amedhyāśī mukhebhagaḥ | yastvātmanaḥ striyaṃ paraṇpabhujyamānāṃ snmādastāmeva sevate, sa klaka iti | prabhā | vivāhāgnyādhānakaraṇe na parivedanadṣastānāha deśāntarastheti vibhiḥ | deśāntarasthādīn jyeṣṭhān, parivindan na duṣyatītya- grimeṇa saṃbandhaḥ | deśāntaramāha bṛddhamanuḥ -kapaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśa | ekaṭaṣaṇān ekasyāmeva striyāṃ ratisaṃtān | asahdarā vaimātreyāḥ | ekamātṛjātā api bhinnapiṣṭakāḥ na sahdarāḥ | ataeva bhīmasya hiḍimbāpariṇayane na parivedanadṣa iti manu- vṛttikāraḥ | śūdratulydāsyādivṛttiḥ | ataeva, [ 1pra. 6kha. ] - "grakṣakān vāṇijakān tathā kārukuśīlavān | preṣyān vārḍaṣikāṃcaiva viprān śūdravadācaret" || 81 - iti manuḥ | kuṇṭhaḥ kāṇa: | sarvvakriyāsu alasa ityapare | abhārthyā: śāstraniṣidabhāyāsambandhāḥ naiṣṭhikabrahmacārivānaprastha • bhicava: | nṛpasya ca satāniti sambandhaḥ | kāmataḥ kāriṇ- yatheṣṭācaraṇaśīlā: | kulāndhaṭanti - iti kulaṭā: parakulāṭana- śīlā iti yāvat | unmattapaurānitipāṭhe paura: preṣyādibhāvena puravāsī | kerāniti pāṭhe ker viṣamaśīlaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam etān parivindan eteṣu bhakkatadārāgnisaṃygeṣu dārāgnisaṃygaṃ kurvvan | na dṣabhāk bhavatīti || 6 || prabhā | "mahānadyantaraṃ yatra girirvā vyavadhāyakaḥ | vāc yatna vibhiyante taddeśāntaramucyate || deśanāmanadbhedācikaṭpi bhavettu yat | tattu deśāntaraṃ prktaṃ svayameva svayambhuvā || daśarātreṇa vā vārtā yatra na śrūyate 'thavā" | 82 kammapradīpaḥ | prabhā | [ 1pra. kha. ] klauvamāha kātyāyana:- "na mūvaṃ phenilaṃ yasya viṣṭhā cāpsu nimajjati | medraṃ cnmādaḍakrābhyāṃ hnaṃ klīvaḥ sa ucyate" tatra devalena ṣaḍavidhā nāradena ca caturdaśavidhā: klīvabhedā- abhihitāḥ, granthagauravabhayātreha pradarśitāḥ | ekavṛṣaṇa ekāṇḍa : paṇḍaviśeṣa iti ratna raḥ rgapravṛddhavṛṣala iti caturvarga- cintāmaṇiḥ | ekasyāmeva striyāṃ ratiśakta iti pariśiṣṭa- prakāśaḥ | asahdarā: mahdarabhinnāḥ | ekamāḍhajātā api bhinnapitṛkā na sahdarā: | ataeva bhīmasya hiḍimbāvivāhe na parivedanadṣa iti manuvṛttiḥ | veśyātisakt veśyāyāmati- śayena saktaḥ | patit mahāpātakādinā | śūdratulyamāha ṛtu: vargacintāmaṇau devala:- "anupāsitasandhyā ye nityamasrātabhjanāḥ | naṣṭaśaucā: patantyete śūdratulyāca dhammataḥ" atirgī apratisamādheyargayuktaḥ | jaḍ vikalāntaḥkaraṇa: hitāhitāvadhāraṇācama iti mitākṣarā| jaḍ'cama : kāryeṣva pravṛtta iti mādhavācāryā | aprājñārthatve'pi phalat na viśeṣaḥ | mūk varṇñcāraṇāsamarthaḥ | anvabadhirau prasiddhau | kulaḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge māṃsādiviśeṣeṇātvantavikṛtadehaḥ | vāman hrakha | khḍakī- bhagnacaraṇadaya iti hemādriḥ | kuṇṭhakāniti pāṭhe kuṇṭh[ 1pra. 6 kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | prabhā | dhana- hemādriḥ | khecchyaiva 'ka maiṃṇyaḥ | kuṇṭh'ka maṇyamūrkhayriti medinyukteḥ | kāṇa iti pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | sarvva kriyālasa iti śūlapāṇiraghunandanau | kuṇṭh mandaḥ kriyāsa yaḥ iti, mūḍhālyāpaṭunirbhāgyā iti cāmarkteḥ| kriyākhapaṭuriti vā'rthaḥ | śrabhārthyāḥ śāstraniṣiddha- bhārthyāsaṃbandhāḥ naiṣṭhikabrahmacārivāṣaprasthasaṃnyāsāśramiṇaḥ | nṛpa. stheti śevik ṣaṣṭhī | cakāreṇa saktānityavagamyate | haḍaprasaktā: dhanavaḍī prakarṣeṇa saktā: kāmat'kāriṇaḥ khecchayaiva nityaṃ vivāhamakurvvāṇā iti vivāhābrihattā iti mādhavācārya: | nārāyaṇpādhyāyaśūla- pāṇiraghunandanaitu kāmataḥ kāriṇa iti paṭhitam | kāmataḥ kāriṇ yatheṣṭācaraṇaśīlā iti nārāyaṇpādhyāyāḥ | śrauta smārttanirapeca khacchandavyavahāriṇa iti śūlapāṇiraghunandanau | kuhaka: paravañcanāya thdygapara iti hemādriḥ | ācāra- māghavīye'pi tathaiva pāṭhaḥ | nārāyaṇpādhyāyena tu kulaṭa iti paṭhitaṃ parakulāṭanagla iti vyākhyātañca | sa ca dattaka iti raghunandanaḥ | caurānityava paurāniti pāṭhe preṣyādibhāvena puranivāsī purapreṣyvetyarthaḥ | kerān iti pāṭhe ker viṣama- śla: | aṣṭamanyat | parivinda nityatra parerlakṣaṇārthatvāt sarvvatra dvitīyā | tathāca etān lackkṛtya vindan eteṣu agrajeṣu akkata - dārāgnihtra saṃygeṣu dārāgnihtrasaṃygaṃ kurvvan na dṣabhāg- bhavatītyarthaḥ || 6 || 84 kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra, 6kha. ] dhanavāīṣikaṃ rājasevakaṃ karṣakaṃ tathā | prṣitañca pratīkṣeta varṣavayamapi tvaran || 7 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | vāṣikādayaścatvār'grajāḥ samāvarttanānantaraṃ dārāgni- parigrahe tvarayā yuktenāpi varṣālayaṃ pratīkṣaṇīyāḥ | tataśca yatpūrvvaślke etān parivindava duṣyatītyuktaṃ taharṣavayāmiti bdavyam || 7 || prabhā | 2 tatrāpi kaciddiśeṣamāha dhanavārduṣikamiti | dhanavārhaṣikaṃ rājasevakaṃ kṛṣisataṃ : deśāntaragataścāgrajaṃ dārāgnihtrasaṃyge kharāvānapi kaniṣṭh varṣavayaṃ pratīkṣeta | etān parivindan na duṣyatīti yaduktaṃ taharṣatrayādūīmityanena viśeṣitam | dhanastha vāvik dhanavāṣika: | saṃbandhalacaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| vārṣuṣika, "samadhye dhanamuddhṛtya mahāṣrghyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati| sa vai vārḍaṣik nāma brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ" || iti mṛtyā vyākhyātaḥ | "yastu nindet paraṃ jīvan praśaṃsatyātman guṇān | savai vāīṣik nāma samsa garhitaḥ" | iti viṣṇūtāvāduṣi kāntaravyavacchedārthaṃ dhanavārhaṣikamityuktam | varṣa trayamapi kharatriti kurvvatā larāyā abhāve adhikakālapratī- caṇaṃ sūcitam | taca mṛtyantarādava gantavyam || 7 || J [ 1pra. 6 kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | prṣitaṃ yadyaśṛṇvānamabdāditi samācaret | āgate ca punastasmin pādaṃ tacchrucaye caret || 8 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | prṣita viśeṣamāha | prṣitamakhānam pratyayavyatyayenā- śrayamāṇamityarthaḥ | yadyavdādūīmiti samācaret parivindet, tadā''gate tasmin tacchuḍāyeṃ parivedanaprāyaścittasya pādaṃ kuryyāt | andādūīntvanāgamane dṣābhāvaeva | tābdapratīkṣā tu śrayamāṇaviṣayā| tatrāgatepi dṣābhāva iti || 8 || 2.9 prabhā | prṣite viśeṣāntaramāha prṣitamiti amṛkhānaṃ pratyaya- vyatyayenāmā mityarthaḥ | akhāna iti ratnākarasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ | prṣitasyāgrajasya vārttāśravaṇābhāve yadyabdādūī kanauyān dārāgnihtrasaṃygaṃ karti, tadā samāgate jyeṣṭhe tatpāpā parivedanaprāyaścittasya pādaṃ kuryāt | anāgamane tvadṣa eva | evañca prṣitasya vrābdapratīcaṇaṃ yūyamāṇaviṣayamiti paryyavasyati | atra ca yadyadhdādūī samācaredityanuvādaliṅgāddidhiranumātavyaḥ | caturavattaṃ pañcāvattaṃ vā juhti iti yadyubhayaṃ cikṣadhtrañcaiva brahmatvañcaiveti caivamādivat | yathāhu:- "liṅgādapi vidhirjñey darbheṣu vikir yathā" | dṛśyateca, yadi brāhmaṇ yajeta bāīspatyaṃ madhye nidhāyāhutimā- malhādūrddhaṃ, iti pāṭhāntaram . kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 6kha. ] lakṣaṇe prāgātāyāstu pramāṇaṃ ḍādaśāṅgulam | tanmūlasaktā ydīcī tasyā evaṃ navttaram ||8|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | prāgudak lavaṇaṃ deśaṃ samaṃ vā parisamūhypalipya madhyataḥ prāca lekhāmullikhya udcauṃ ca saṃhatāṃ paścānmadhye prācīstisra ullikhyābhyukṣet | lakṣaṇāvadeṣā sarvvaveti sūtre lakṣaṇamuktaṃ, talekhā- parimāṇāntarābhidhānena spaṣṭīkarti | yā prathamā prāgagrā lekhā tasyāḥ parimāṇaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ, tanmūlalagnā yttarāgrā tasyā nāṅgulādhikaṃ dvādaśāṅgulameva pramāṇam | ekaviṃśatyaṅgula mityarthaḥ -prabhā | hutiṃ hutvā'bhivārayet yadi rājanya aindraṃ yadi vaiśy vaiśvadevam- iti sa yadikādapi vākyāt kratvidhānam || 8 || prāgudapravaṇaṃ deśaṃ samaṃ vā parisamūhypalipya madhyataḥ prāca rekhāmullikhydcṃ ca saṃhatāṃ paścāt madhye prācīstisra ullikhyā- bhyucet lakṣaṇādṛdeṣā sarvvavetvanenādhānaprasaṅgena gbhilena lakṣaṇa- muktam | tat aṣṭīkarti lakṣaṇe iti iābhyām | lakṣaṇe yeyaṃ prathamā prāggatā rekhā tasyāḥ pramāṇaṃ dādaśāṅgulam | tanmūlalagnā yā udaggatā rekhā tasyā navttaraṃ navāṅgalādhikaṃ evaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ pramāṇaṃ, eka viṃśatyaṅgulamityarthaḥ || 8 || [ 1pra. 6kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | udaggatāyāḥ saṃlagnāḥ śeṣāḥ prādeśamātrikā: | saptasaptāṅgulāṃstyaktā kuśenaiva samulikhet || 10 || iti | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | uktayravaśiṣṭā yāstisraḥ uktāstā udīcyāṃ rekhāyāṃ saṃlagnāḥ saptasaptāṅgulāntarāḥ prādeśapramāṇāḥ kuśenaiva samullikhediti | kuśeneti sarvvābhiḥ saṃbadhyate || 10 || prabhā | udaggatāyā iti | śeṣā avaśiṣṭāstisr rekhā udaggatāyā: saṃlagnāḥ prādeśaparimāṇā: saptasaptāṅgulāntarālā: kuśenaiva samu- llikhet | kuśenaivetyādi sarvvābhiḥ rekhābhiḥ saṃvadhyante | sarvāsāṃ rekhānāmullekhanaṃ kuśenaiva kāryyamityarthaḥ | ayantāvadekaḥ prakāraḥ | prakārāntaramukta gbhilaputreṇa hyāsaṃgrahe| taduyathā-
"lakṣaṇaṃ tat pravakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ daivataca yat" | ityabhidhāyānatidūrī,
"prākkatā pārthivī jñeyā āgneyī cāpyudak smṛtā | prājāpatyā ca aiṃndrī ca saumṃ ca prāk kṛtā smṛtā ? || 87 "pārthivīṃ caiva saumī ca rakhe he hādaśāṅgule | ekaviṃśatirāgneyī prādeśinye ume smṛteḥ || ṣaḍaṅgulāntarāḥ kāryyā āgneyīsaṃhitāstu tāḥ | pārthivāvāstu rekhāyāstisrastā uttarttarāḥ" || kamapradṣaḥ | [ 1pra. 6kha. ] mānakriyāyāmuktāyāmanukte mānakarttari | mānakṛdyajamānaḥ sthāhiduṣāmeṣa niścayaḥ || 11|| puṇyamevādadhītāgniṃ sa hi sabai: praśasyate | anakatvaṃ yattasya kāmyaistat nīyate śamam || 12 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | mānaparibhāṣāmāha- nigadavyākhyātam | tataścāṅgulādimānaṃ yajamānāṅga leneti siddham || 11 || vaiśyakulādā ambarīṣādetyādisūtreṇāgniynay bahava uktāḥ | prabhā | iti | ante ca - "eṣa lekhavidhiḥ prkt hyāka sarvasu | sūkṣmāstāṛjavaḥ kāryyā rekhāstāḥ susamāhitāḥ || etāni tattvat jñātvā gṛhyākammāṇi kārayet" || iti ca| tadanayḥ prakārayrvikalpaḥ | iyreva svaśāstrkta tvāt || 10 || aṅgulimānādikaṃ kasya grahītavyamityapekṣāyāṃ mānapari- bhāṣāmāha mānakiyāyāmiti | mānameva kriyā mānakriyā | sā yavktā mānakarttā tu ntaḥ, tatra yajamān mānakarttā syādityeṣa viduṣāṃ nirṇayaḥ || 11 || puṇyameveti | gbhilena vaiśyakulāday bahav'gniynayakama pradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāyaḥ | tathā api vāraṇiṃ mathitvā'bhyādadhyāt | puṇyasvevānaḍuk- bhavatīti sūtreṇāraṇeyaḥ puṇya ityuktam | tatastamevādadhyāt | hi yasmāsa āraṇīya: savveṃ: praśasyate | puṇyātiśayahetutvāt | anvāhite'gnau # nirvāṇa punarādhānayneḥ svādhīnatvāca | yaiva hi prathamādhāna yniḥ saiva punarādhāne'pi | vaiśyakulādīnāṃ tu tathā gṛhyāntaram | ynitve na svādhīnateti na prāśastyaṃ teṣām | pūrvaivānugate'gnau yniḥ | svayaṃ ca vakṣyati, - - [ 1pra. kha. ] iti | "pūrvyeva yniḥ pūrvvāhat punarādhānakarmaṇi" | nanvasāvapi ṛddhisādhanatra bhavati, anarduk bhavatī- tyuktate | vaiśyakulādyāhṛtastu ṛḍisādhanam | ataḥ sa eva praśast- netaraḥ | tathāca gṛhyāntaram | brāhmaṇakulāi hmavarcasakām- agnimāhatyādadhīta rājanyādjvryakām vaiśyātputrapaśakām- 'mbarṣāhanadhānyakāmastvāraṇeyaṃ puṇyakṣakāma iti | tavāha | dhanakatvaṃ yattasvāratheyasya tatkāmyaiḥ kabhirbrahmavarcasādisādhanai- svadādhāraḥ | śāntiṃ nauyate kammaṃdārā ṛḍisādhanatvāt | ava cādhānaṃ lakṣaṇapūrvakaṃ samanvakamagnisthāpanam | na tvaraṇi- nirmanyanam | vaiśyakulāvyāhate tadasambhavāt | bhāṅpūrvasya dadhāte- cārpaṇavācitvāt || 12 || M · Ee

| tatvccate | puṇyamevāgnimādadhīta | yasmāt sa sarvveḥ praśasyate | puṇyātiśayahetṛtvāt | tathāca gṭahyā- ntaram | ārīyamurupuṇyakṣakāma iti | devāca punarādhāne karttavye pūrvevāgliynirājayitavyā
