vedamadhītyāntyāṃ samidhamabhyādhāsya vityādinā [ 1praḥ 6kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | anūḍhaiva tu sā kanyā pañcatvaṃ yadi gacchati | na tathā vratalp'sya tenaivānyāṃ samuhahet || 14 || 101 pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | yasya kenacitkanyādāvā satyena vācā kanyā dattā bhavet, sa evāntyamamidādhānaṃ kariṣyannādadhīta nānyatheti || 13 || sā yadyakṛtapāṇigrahaṇaiva vināśaṃ yāti, tathā satyasya htāṃgnerā hitāgnitāvratasya vāgdattāyā adāhe na lpa: | kiṃ tarhi tenaivāgninā anya samuhahet || 14 || | prabhā | H brahmacaryyaparisamāptisamaye'ntya samidāghānārtha magnyādhānaṃ gbhile- nktam | tatra viśeṣamāha yasyeti | yasyeti saṃbandhalakṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī | kenacit kanyādāvā yasmai kanyā satyena vācā dattā bhavet, sa evaṃ anya samidhamādhāsyavagnimādadhīta | nānyathā na tathā- vidhavāgdānābhāve | tathāle samāvarttanāt paraṃ jhaṭiti kanyāyā alābhe kañcit kālamanāśramau syāditi bhāvaḥ || 13 || anūḍheveti | yadyakṛtavivāhaiva sā kanyā mriyate, tathā satyasyāhitāgnervatalp na bhavati | tenaivāgninā'nyāṃ kanyā- muddahet | etenāhitenāgninā vāgdattāyā dāh na karttavya ityukta bhavati | tathā karaṇe hyāhitāgnitāvratamasya lupyeta | tenaivānyāṃ samudrahediti cānupapanaṃ syāt || 14 || kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 6kha. ] atha cenna labhetānyāṃ yācamān'pi kanyakām | tamagnimātmasāt kṛtvā kṣipraṃ syāduttarāśramī || 15 || ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | . yadi cānyāṃ kanyāṃ prārthayavapi na prāpnti| anena brāhmā- daivādivivāhavyatirekeṇa yājjāpūrvvakāpraśastavivāhenāpi gāī- sthyāya yatanayamityuktam | tadā''hitāmniḥ prājāpatyeṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tamagnimālanyārpya śīghraṃ caturthāśramī svāditi || 15 || prabhā | atha cediti | yadi prārthayamān'pyanyāṃ kanyāṃ na labhate; tadā tamāhitamamnimātmasāt kṛtvā prājāpatyeṣṭividhinā śrāmani samārpyāvilambena caturthāyamī bhavet | yācamān- uptyanena brāhmarādipraśastavivāhāsanbhave yātrā pūrvvakā praśasta vivāhenāpi gṛhasthāśramapraveśāya yatitavyamityuktam || 15 || iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | aśvaty yaḥ śamaugarbhaḥ praśastvasamudbhavaḥ | tasya yā prāṅmukhau śākhā ydaucī yṅkṣagā'pi vā ||1|| araṇistanmayī prktā tanmayau cttarāraṇiḥ | sāravaddāravaṃ cātramvilī ca praśasyate || 2 ||
pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | mathanetikarttavyatāmāha - āraṇeyasya medhyabhūbhau yaḥ śamgarbh'khatyjātaḥ, tasya yā prāyagrā uttarāgrā ūrhagā vā śākhā, tanmayī araṇiruttarāraṇiya śāstrkkā | sārayukta khadirādidārubhavaṃ manyanadaṇḍarūpaṃ cāvaṃ cāvaīyantraṇārthakāṣṭharupā vilī ca praśastā bhavatīti ||1||2|| prabhā | āraṇeyasya manthanaprakāra va prathamaṃ manyanayantraghaṭaka maraṇyā- dikamāha ambatyya iti dvābhyām | śamgarbhasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate | pavitrabhūmau jāt yaḥ śamgarbh'khayaḥ tasya prāṅmukhī udak- gatā ūrhagatā vā yā śākhā, adharāraṇiruttarāṇiñca tanmay
mauvilī, iti pāṭhāntaram | evaṃ parala | 104 kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 7kha. ] saṃsatamūl yaḥ śamyā śamīgarbhaḥ sa uccate | alābhe tvaśamgarbhādāharedavilambitaḥ || 3 || caturvieśatiraṅguṣṭhā dairghyaṃ ṣaḍapi pārthavam | catvāra ucchraymānamaraṇyḥ parikīrttitam ||4|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | śamgarbhaṃ vyākarti | śamyā saha mūlaṃ yasya rumyak lagna- mekībhūtaṃ, sa śamgarm'bhidhīyate | tadalābhe akhatyāntarādapi vilambarahit'raṇyāharaṇaṃ kuryyāt || 3 || aravidayaparimāṇamāha -- ṣaḍaṅguṣṭhāḥ pārthavaṃ pṛthutvaṃ prastāra iti yāvat | ucchāya. prabhā | munibhiḥ kathitā | cātramvilī ca sārayukta khadirādikāṣṭha- nirmitaṃ munibhiḥ praśasyate | cātraṃ nāma manyanadaṇḍaṃ, cāvīībhāga- niyantraṇārthaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣa śrvil || 1 || 2 || idānīṃ śamgarbhasya lakṣaṇa māha saṃsaktamūla iti | yasyākha- tyasya mūlaṃ śamyā saha saṃsaktaṃ samyaga lagnaṃ, s'śvatyaḥ śamgarbhaḥ kathyate | śamīgarbhasyāśvatthasthālābhe punaraśamgarbhādapyaraṇimāharet | guṇalpe ca mukhyastheti nyāyādivyabhiprāyaḥ | śamgarbhasyānveṣaṇyā kālavilamb na karttavya iti vaktuma vilambita ityuktam || 3 || bharaṇyādīnāṃ parimāṇamāha caturviṃśatiriti ḍābhyām | caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākā aṅguṣṭhā aṅguṣṭhāṅgulā araṇyderdhvaṃ dīrghatā- A [ 1pra. 7kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | aṣṭāṅgula: pramantha: syācāvaṃ syād dvādaśāṅgulam | vilī dvādaśaiva syādetanmanthanayantrakam || 5 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | araṇyretapramāṇaṃ kāna kathitam | uccatā catvārṃ'guṣṭhāḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 4 || cātragarbhasth manthanārthaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ prasanyaḥ, s'ṣṭāṅgula: syāt | etadaraṇyādicatuṣṭayaṃ manthanārthaṃ yantrakaṃ yantra ityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 5 || prabhā | parimāṇamityartha: | ṣaḍaṅgutlāstayḥ pārthavaṃ pṛthutvaṃ, tatparimāṇamiti yāvat | catvār'ṅgulā araṇyrucchraya uccatāparimāṇa mityetat | tadevamaraṇyḥ parimāṇaṃ sarvvatbhāvena kathitam || 4 || aṣṭāṅgula iti | cātramadhyasth manyanārthaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣa: pramanya- ityucyate | sa khakhaṣṭāṅgulaparimāṇaḥ syāt | cātramvilī ca dādaśāṅgulaparimāṇaṃ syāt | etat sarvve militaṃ yathāvinyastaṃ atyanayantraṃ iti kathyate manyanayantrakamiti svārthe kan | gbhilapuveṃgā pyetrameva manyanayanvamuktam | kevalamaraṇydīrghatāyāṃ anyadapi parimāyaḍayamuktam | tathāca gṭahyāsaṃgraha:- "āśvatyntu śamgarbhāmaraṇīṃ kurvīta sttarām | jarudghī ranidghī caturviśāṅgulāṃ tathā || iti | khādire bannāti pālāśe banāti rhitake banātīti vadamṣāṃ vikalp bdavyaḥ || 5 || 14 106 kapradīpaḥ | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimānaṃ tu yatra yavpadiśyate | tatra tatra bṛhatpardhvagranthibhirminuyātsadā gbālaiḥ śaṇasaṃmiśraistridṛddṛttamanśukam | vyāmapramāṇaṃ netraṃ syātmamadhyastena pāvakaḥ || 7 || [ 1pra. 7kha. ]] || 6 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśa: 1. yatra yatra aṅguṣṭhamānametāvadaṅgulimānametatkarttavyamucyate, tava sarvvavāṅguṣṭhasya yadvandhisthānaṃ madhyasthitaṃ tena mānaṃ sarvvadā kuryyāt || 6 || prabhā | śaṇasaṃmiśragbālessiguṇaṃ vartulaṃ aṃśakarahitaṃ vistṛtasva hastaiya#tiryagantaramānaṃ netraṃ rajjurbhavet | tena netreṇāgni- mainyanīyaḥ || 7 || aṅguṣṭheti | bṛhatparvvagranthibhiḥ madhyarekhābhiḥ | nigadavyākhyāta- manyat || 6 || manyanasādhanaṃ netramāha gbālairiti | śaṇa saṃmiśrargbāla- meṃ sthāditi saṃbandhaḥ | nevaṃ rajjuḥ | nevaṃ viśinaṣṭi viṣṭadiyā- dinā | triṣṭat triguṇaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, anaṃśakaṃ aṃśarahitam | aṃgavastuntūnāṃ kṣudrā avayavāḥ | vyāmapramāṇaṃ vistṛtasahasta- bāhuiya tiryyagantarālaṃ vyāma ityucyate | tatparimāṇam | tena netreṇa prakarṣaṇāgnirmanyanīyaḥ || 7 ||
sahastavāḍaiya, iti sa pustake pāṭhaḥ | [ 1pra. 7kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | mūcikarṇavakāṇi kandharā cāpi pañcamī | aṅguṣṭhamātrāṇyetāni hāṅgulaṃ vakṣa uccate || 8 || aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ hṛdayaṃ cāṅguṣṭhamudaraṃ smṛtam | ekāṅguṣṭhā kaṭijñeyā hau vastiau tu guhyakam || 6|| ūrū jaṅge ca pādau ca catuskaṃ yathākramam | araṇyavayavāhyete yājñikaiḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 10 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | araṇyaṅgaṃ tanmānañcāha - kandharā grīvā, bacgrīvā hṛdayayrmadhyam | etaca mūlādārabhya mānam | vṛcadārvādīnāṃ tathaiva mānasya śrīlagikatvāt | śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 8 || vastirnābheradhbhāgaḥ | guhyamupastha iti yāvat | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||8|| jarujaśāpādaṃ yathākramaṃ caturaṅguṣṭhāṅguṣṭhaikāṅguṣṭham | ete'raṇya- prabhā | araṇyavayavaṃ tatparimāṇavāha sūjhacauti vibhiḥ | vak mukham | kandharā grīvā | grvāhṛdayayrmadhyaṃ vakṣaḥ | sugamamanyat | etacca mūlādārabhya mānaṃ, hacadārvvādīnāṃ tathaiṣa mānasysargika tvāditi nārāyaṇpādhyāyāḥ || 8 || aṅguṣṭhamātramiti | hau aṅguṣṭhau | evamuttaratna | vastirnāme- radhbhāgaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 8 || urū jaṅke ceti | uru ja pādau cetyetāni yathākramaṃ kapradīpaḥ | yatadguhyamiti prktaṃ devaynistu scyate | tasyāṃ yjāyate vahniḥ sa kalyāṇakṛducyate ||11|| [ 1pra. 7kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | vayavāyajña vyavahāribhiḥ kāyeṃnktā iti caturviṃśataraṅguṣṭhānāṃ vibhāga: | hiśabd'vadhāraṇe || 10 || yatpūraṅguṣṭhaṃ guhyamityabhihitaṃ taddevānāmutpattisthānam | atastasyāṃ ynau y'gnirjāyate s'bhyudayakārī uccate | tasmāttava manthanaṃ kāyam | etadarthameva cāṅgavibhāgakathanam || 11 || prabhā |- caturaṅguṣṭhatrāṅguṣṭhaikāṅguṣṭhaparimitāni bhavanti | s'yaṃ caturviṃśa- tyaṅguṣṭhānāṃ vibhāga: | ete araṇyavayavā yājikaiḥ sarvvatbhāvena niścayena kathitāḥ || 10 || , manyanasthānamāha yattaditi | yattaditi sarvvanāmaiyena prasihimavadytayati | yadguhyamiti kathitaṃ sā devasyāgnery- nirutpattisthānamucyate | seti vidheyaprādhānyavivakṣayā skhaulvena nirdeśaḥ | tasyāṃ manyanena y'gnirutpadyate sa kalyāṇakadabhyudaya- kārti munibhiḥ kathyate | gbhilaputratvāha - "mūlādaṣṭāṅgulamuvsṛjya vīṇi trīṇi ca pārśvayḥ | devayniḥ sa vijñeyastatra mathy hutāśanaḥ || mūlādaṣṭāṅgulaṃ tyaktvā agrāttu hādaśāṅgulam | devayniḥ sa vijñeyastava mathy hutāśana: " || kammamadīpa: | anyatra mathyate yattu tadrgabhayamāpnuyāt | prathame manthane hyeṣa niyamnttareṣu ca || 12 || uttarāraṇiniṣpannaḥ pramanyaḥ sarvadā bhavet | ynisaṅkaradṣeṇa yujyate anyamanyakṛt || 13 || [ 1pra. 7kha ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yatpunarandhatra madhyate tasmāḍet rgabhayaṃ prāpnti | ayaṃ dṣaḥ prathamāgnyādhānamanyane dvitīyādiṣu punaneṃti || 12 || pramanyya: pūrvvamuktaḥ sa uttarāraṇe: kāṣṭhaśakalamuhṛtya randhu- pūraṇāyeṃ niṣpāditaḥ | sarvvadā dvitīyādhānādiṣvapi bhavet | anyathātve dṣamāha hi yasmādanyataḥ pramanyakārī ynisaṅkara- dṣeṇa pāpena saṃbadhyate || 13 || prabhā | iti | tatra prathamavacanena guhyasya devaynitvaṃ bhaṅgāntareṇktam | dvitīyavacanena tu tasandheriti viśeṣaḥ | s'yaṃ vikalpaḥ || 11 || anyaveti | yaditi manyanakriyāviśeṣaṇam | yat punardeva- yneranyava pathyate, tamāḍet rgabhayaṃ prāpnti manyanakartā | ayaśca niyama: prathamādhāne yanmanthanaṃ kriyate tatraiva, na punarādhāne karttavye dvitīyādimanyaneṣu || 12 || idānīṃ pramanthanirmāṇa viśeṣamāha uttarāraṇīti | uttarā anyeṣu ye ta mananti te rga bhayabhānuyuḥ iti pāṭhāntaram | ye 110 kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 7kha. ] ārdrā saśuṣirā caiva ghuṇī sphuṭitā tathā | na hitā yajamānānāmaraṇittarāraṇiḥ || 14 || saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | savirā sarandhrā | ghuṣānī ghuṇādinā viśrṇākyavā| śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 14 || 1 saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || prabhā | ratheḥ sakāśāt kāṭhaśakalamuvṛtya tena pramany niṣpanī bhavet | sarvvadā dvitīyādyādhāneṣvapi | anyena kāṭhana pramanyakaraṇe dṣa- māha ynīti manyaḥ pramanyaḥ | yasmādanthena kāṭhena pramanyakarttā ynisaṅkaradṣeṇa yujyate, tasmāt sarvvadevttarāraṇiniṣpannaḥ pramany bhavet iti pūrvvā te'rthe hetuvacanamuttarāīm || 13 || 1 araṇyrviśeṣamāha āti| saśaṣirā sacchidrā ghuṇaḥ kauṭaviśeṣaḥ | sa aṅge yasyāḥ sā ghuṇāṅg | saṣṭamanyat || 14 || iti saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | aṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | paridhāyāhataṃ vāsaḥ prāvṛtya ca yathāvidhi | bibhṛyātprāṅmukhyantramāvṛtā vakṣyamāṇayā || 1 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | navavastra paridhāya uttarīyaṃ ca kṛtvā pūrvābhimukhyantraṃ cātrau- vilyādi baccamāṇaparipāvyā niṣpīḍayet | yathāvidhītyanena,- "paridhānāihiḥ kakṣā nibaddhā hyāsurī bhavet | dharmye kammaṇi vidbhirvarjanīyā prayatnataḥ" || iti ygiyājñavalkarktaparidhānavidhiḥ | "savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭaḥ kaṭideśe dhṛtāmbaraḥ | ekavastrantu taṃ vidyāt daive pitreya ca varjjayet" | iti śātātapkkttarīyadhāraṇa vidhiya vihita iti || 1 || prabhā | idānīṃ manyanaprakāramāha paridhāyeti | aṛtaṃ yantranirmu navamiti yāvat | vāsa: parivāya prāvṛtya ca uttarīyamapi vidhāya | yathāvidhītyubhayatra saṃbadhyate | tataśca paridhāne uttarīya- karaṇe ca- "paridhānāihiḥ kakṣā nivaḍā hyāsurī bhavet | ghara kammaṇi vidbhirvarjanauyā prayatnataḥ" # 112 kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha ] cātravune prathanthāgraṃ gāḍha kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | kṛtvttarāgrāmaraṇiṃ taddubhramupari nyaset || 2 || cātrī kīlakāgrasthāmvilīmudagagragām | viṣṭabhya dhārayedyanvaṃ niṣkampaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | cātrarandhe pramanyāgraṃ randhrapūraṇena niścalaṃ kṛtvā pramathanābhijña uttarāgrāmaraṇiṃ kṛtvā tacāvamūīsthitamaraṇyupari nyaset || 2 || cāvsthalhaśaṅguśirasi vilmuttarāgrāmārpya gāḍha pḍayitvā prvilni:pḍanena niścalaṃ kṛtvā ekacittaḥ kṛtāca- manādirayet || 3 || iti | prabhā | "savyādaṃsāt paribhraṣṭaḥ kaṭideśe vṛtāmbaraḥ | ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāt daive pivetra ca varjjayet" || iti caivamādismṛtyansarkt vidhiranusaraṇīya ityuktaṃ bhavati | evambhūt bhūtvā prāṅmukhaḥ san vakṣyamāṇayā paripāvyā manyamayantraṃ dhārayet || 1 || cātravudhne iti | vicakṣaṇ manyanaprakārābhina cātrasya mūle pramanyasyāgraṃ randhrapūraṇena nicalaṃ kṛtvā araṇimuttarāgrāṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat ūrjesthitaṃ cāvaṃ araṇerupari sthāpayet || 2 || cāvrḍeti | cāvasyreṃ yat klakaṃ lhaśatruḥ tadavasthitā [ 1pra. 8kha. ] kapradīpaḥ | triruḍeṭyā'tha neveṇa cātraṃ patnagrahatāṃśukā 1. pūrve manyedaraṇyantaṃ prācyagneḥ syādyathā cyutiḥ || 4 || naikayāspi vinā kāryamādhānaṃ bhāryayā dijaiḥ | akṛtaṃ tadvijānīyātsarvā nānvārabhanti yat || 5 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: pūrvktagbālarajjvā cāvaṃ vāratrayamuparyuparikrameṇa veṣṭayitvā navavasvā patnī prācyāndiśyaraṇyante madhet | yathā prāgdeśe agne- niḥsaraṇaṃ bhavet || 4 || sarvā: patrī yadādhānaṃ netrākarṣaṇenānukūlāḥ saty na niṣpā- dayanti tadakkataṃ jñātavyaṃ viguṇatvāt| śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 5|| prabhā | mudagagrāmvilīṃ kṛtvā viṣṭabhyāśritya gāḍhe pīḍayitvā vā yantra niṣkampaṃ sampādya śuciḥ kṛtācamanādiḥ prayata: prayatnavān tajñata citta iti yāvat | yantraṃ dhārayet || 3 || triruḍeśyeti | athānantara netreṇa pūrvktalakṣaṇena cāvaṃ uparyuṃparikrameṇa vāratrayaṃ veṣṭayitvā ahṛtavasanā patnī pū araṇyante manyet | araṇipūbyānte manyanasya prayjanamāha prācīti| ammethupratirniḥsaraṇaṃ prācī prākpradeśagatā yathā bhavat tathā manyet | prāci iti saptamyantapāṭhe'pi tathaivārthaḥ || 4 || naikayāpti | yajamānasya yāvaty bhārgyā: santi tāsā524 kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha. ] varṇajyaiṣṭhāna bahībhiḥ savarṇābhiśca janmataḥ | kārthyamagnicyuterābhiḥ sādhvībhirmanyanaṃ pṛthak||6|| jātra śūdrāṃ niyuñjīta na drhadveṣakāriṇīm | nāśāsanasyāṃ nānyena puṃsā ca saha saṅgatām ||7|| pariśiṣṭa prakāmaḥ | prathamaṃ brāhmaṇyā, tadanu catriyayā ityevaṃ yathā varṇajyaiṣṭham asavarṇābhiḥ savarṇābhiśca janmajyaiṣṭhākrameṇāgniniḥsaraṇaṃ yāvatra bhavati tāvasatībhiḥ pṛthagmanthanaṃ kāryyam || 6 || atrādhāne śūdrāṃ bhāya na niyuñjīta| aṃśūdrāpi prāṇa-
prabhā | mekayā'pi bhāryayā vinā ādhānaṃ na kāryaṃ, sarvvābhireva kārya- mityarthaḥ | sarvvā yajamānabhāya anvārabhaṃ na kurvvanti cet, tadādhānaṃ kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ vijānīyāt | tasmādekayāpi bhārthyayā vinā ādhānaṃ na kāryyamityarthaḥ | anvārambh nāma nevākarṣaṇena manthanānukūlyam ||5|| tatra viśeṣamāha varṇajyaiṣṭheneti savarṇāsavarṇabahustrīsattve varṇajyeṣṭhena tābhirmanyanaṃ kāryam | prathamaṃ brāhmaṇyā tadanu kṣatriyayā sadanu vaiśyayetyartha: 1 savarṇabahastrīsattve janmajyaiṣṭhakrameṇa manyanaṃ kāryyam | ukta krameṇābhiḥ sādhvībhiḥ strībhiragniniḥsaraṇaparthyantaṃ pṛthaṅmanthanaṃ kārym || 6 || nātreti | avāgnimanyane vivāhitāmapi śūdrāṃ na niyujīta | kampradīpa tataḥ śaktatamā paścādāsāmanyatamā'pi yā upetānāṃ cānyatamā manthedagniṃ nikāmataḥ || 8 || [ 1pra. 8kha. ] jātasya lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ praṇīya samidhya ca | ādhā samidhañcaiva brahmāṇamupaveśayet || 8 || 115 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | virdhakāriṇī dveṣakāriṇī ājñāvighātinī niygadharmeṇāpi puruṣāntarasaṅgatā nādhāne niyjyā | itarā tu patitaiveti || 7 || tataḥ sarvāṃbhirmaghane kṛte paścādāsāmeva manyanakartrīṇāṃ yā atyanta balavatī upanītānāṃ ca traivarṇikānāmanyatamāpi, agne- mghanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ agniniṣpattiṃ yāvatkuryāt || 8 || jātasyāgnerlakṣaṇaṃ rekhllekhanādirūpaṃ kṛtvā tatra sthāne praveśya samidhaṃ pratipya brahmpaveśanaṃ kuyāt || 8 || prabhā | tathā drhakāriṇīṃ dveṣakāriṇṃ ājñāsampādanamakurvvata anyena puṃsā saṅgatāca na niyujīta | drh jighāṃsā, dveṣa: prasiddhaḥ ||7|| tata iti | uktakrameṇa savābhirmanyane kṛte paścāt āsāmanya- tamā upetānāmupanītānāṃ traivarṇikānāmanyatamā yā śaktatamaḥ atiśayena balavatī asavarṇā savarṇā vā sā yatheṣṭamagniṃ manyet | agniniḥsaraṇaparyyantaṃ manyanaṃ kuryyādityarthaḥ || 8 || jātasyeti | jālasyeti saṃbandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| nau jāte kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha ] tataḥ pūrṇāhuti hutvā sarvatantrasamanvitām | gāndayādyajñavāstvante brahmaṇe vāsasī tathā ||10|| pariśiṣṭa prakāśa: | brahmpaveśanānantaraṃ sarvāṃdhānetikarttavyatāyuktāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā darbhaju ṭikāh mānte brahmaṇe gāṃ vāsdayaśca dayāditi || 10 || prabhā | niḥsṛte sattyarthaḥ | rekhllekhanādirūpaṃ gṛhyktaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃjñakaṃ kanma kṛtvā tamagniṃ tattra praṇīya samidhya prajvālaya samidhañcādhāya brahmpaveśanaṃ kārayet | samidādhānānantaraṃ brahmpaveśanamityā- dhāna evāyaṃ kramaḥ | tatraivābhidhānāt | anyatra tu karmakram- gṛhyāsaṃgrahe gbhilaputreṇktaḥ | yathā - "lekhanābhyucaṇe kṛtvā nihite'gnau samiddadat | tat bhūmigrahaṃ kṛtvā kuryyāt parisamūhanam || brahmāṇamupasaṅghalpā caruṣapaṇamāt" || iti || 8 || tata iti | tantramitikarttavyatā | tat brahmpaveśanānantaraṃ sarvāṃbhirādhāne tikarttavyatābhiḥ sahitāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā gṛhyta- yatraṣāstunāmakakarmaṇ'nte brahmaṇe gāṃ vāsasī ca dadyāt || 10 || katvā, iti pāṭhāntaram | kama pradīpaḥ | hmapātramanādeśe dravadravye suvaḥ smṛtaḥ | pāṇirevetarasmiṃstu sucā cātra na iyate || 11 || khādirvā'tha pārśvā ḍivitastiḥ suvaḥ smṛtaḥ | sugvāhumātrā vijñeyā vṛttastu pragrahastayḥ ||12|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | kṛtādhānasya nānāvidhahmaprasatī prathamaṃ tatparibhāṣāmāha- dravadravyātī āhutyāvārapātrānupadeśe munibhiḥ suvaḥ smṛtaḥ | dravetarāhutau pātrāntarānupadeśe pāṇinaiva htavyam | ubhayatvaivānu- padeśe juḍā hm na kāvye iti | juhariti samākhyāvalāt juhvā api vaikalpika hmasādhanatvaśaṅgānirāsāyeṃ sucā cātra na iyate ityuktam || 11 || gbhiltaṃ suvaṃ sucañca spaṣṭīkarti | khadiramaya: palāśa- prabhā | [ 1pra. 8kha ] 117 kṛtādhānasya yajamānasya nityanaimittikānānāvidhā hmā- vihitāḥ | tatra paribhāṣāṃ tāvadāha hmapātramiti | hma- sādhanapāvasyānādeśe dravadravye haviṣi suvhmapācaṃ smṛt munibhiḥ | dravadravyetara smiṃstu haviṣi pāṇirava hmapātram | atra pātrānādeśa sucā na hayate | srucā na hayate iti vakṣanāt yānika sampradāyāgat'yamarthaḥ ityuktaṃ bhavati | suk juharitya- narthāntaram || 11 || sruvaṃ sucaca lakṣyati khādira iti | parṇa: palāśa | 118 kabhapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha. ] suvāgre ghrāṇavat khātaṃ ṅguṣṭhaṃ parimaṇḍalam | juhvāḥ śarāvavat khātaṃ sanirvāhaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulam || 13 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa | may vā vitastiddayamānaḥ sruvaḥ smṛtaḥ | juhūrbāhupramāṇa bḍavyā pragṛhyate'sminniti vyutpattyā pragrah daṇḍaḥ | sa sruva- sucrvartulbḍavyaḥ || 12 || suvāgre nāsārandhravanmadhya sthitamaryādam adbhuuhayamitaṃ varttulaṃ bilaṃ jevam | juhāsa khātaṃ śarāvākkṛti niḥśeṣahavanasādhanatayā nirvāhapadavāccapraṇālīsahitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ jānīyāt || 13 || prabhā | vitastidaśāṅgalam | vitastiddayaparimitaḥ khādira: pālāś- vā suvaḥ smṛtaḥ | jurbāhupramāṇā veditavyā | tayḥ suvasucīḥ praṭate asminniti pragrah dhāraṇadaṇḍa: vṛtt varttulaḥ vijñeyaḥ || 12 || suvāgre iti | suvasyāgre yat khātaṃ, tat ghrāṇavat aṅguṣṭhaddaya- parimitaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ varttulaṃ karttavyam | prāṇavadityanena yathā nāsārandhraiyaṃ madhyasthitamaryādaṃ tathā suvāgrasthitaṃ khātamapi madhya sthitamavyādaṃ karttavyamityupadiśati | juhāḥ khātaṃ ṣaḍagula- parimitaṃ śarāvavat karttavyam | tattu sanirvāhaṃ praṇālīsahitam | sāhi niḥśeṣahavanasādhanatayā nirvāhapadencyate || 13 || [ 1ma. 8kha. ] kama pradīpaḥ | 118 teṣāṃ prākśaḥ kuśaiḥ kārthya: sampramājajuhaṣatā | pratāpanañca liptānāṃ pracālyṣīna vāriṇā ||14|| prāñcaṃ prāñcamudagagne rudgagraṃ sampataḥ | tattathā''sādayedravyaṃ yadyathā viniyujyate ||15|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | teṣāṃ vyaktibhedāihanāṃ pūrvābhimukha mārjanaṃ kuśaiḥ kāryam | tādijepavatāntu teṣāmuṣṇena jalena pracālanapūrvvamagnau pratā- panaṃ kāryyam | sampramārga iti vā pāṭhaḥ || 14 || sruvastugādidravyamupaygasa nidhikrameṇa svasamīpadeśeṣve kasmāt - pūrvvamekaṃ tataḥ pūrvvamaparamityevaṃ krameṇāgneruttarataḥ uttara|graṃ sthāpayet || 15 || prabhā | teṣāmiti | vyaktibhedāihuvacanamanyeṣāmapi yajñapātrāṇaṃ saṃgrahārthaṃ vā juhaṣatā htumicchatā teṣāṃ prākaśa: pūrvvābhi- mukha kubhaiḥ sampramārga: samyak prakarṣeṇa mārjanaṃ kāryyam | sampramārja iti pāṭhe tvārṣaḥ praygaḥ | ājyādiliptānāṃ teṣāmagnau pratāpanañca kāryyam | kiṃ tvā ? uṣṇana jalena pracālaya || 14 || prācaṃ prāñcamiti | agneruttarasyāṃ diśi vasavidhī vini ygakrameṇa pūrvva pūrvva krameṇa cttarāgraṃ dravyamāsādayet | yasya prathamaṃ viniygaḥ tat prathamamāsādayet, yasya tadanu viniygaḥ kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. kha. ] ājyaṃ dravyamanādeśe juhtiṣu vidhīyate | mantrasya devatāyāśca prajāpatiritisthitiḥ || 16 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | hmeṣu htavyānupadeśe ājyaṃ dravyaṃ htavyaṃ vidhīyate | ājyaṃ gavyamiti pāṭhāntaram | mantradevatayṣānupadeśe prajāpatirdevatā mantr'pi prajāpatiḥ, prajāpataye svāhetyarthaḥ | anye tu, samastāṃ vyāhataṃ prājāpatyaṃ mantramāhuḥ | tatra ca mantre prajāpatiśabda- praygāt mantramay devatetivyaktam | tathā ygiyājñavalkāḥ | "yasya yasya tu mantrasya uddiṣṭā yā tu devatā | tadākāraṃ bhavettasya devatvaṃ devatcyate || 16 || prabhā | tat tataḥ paramityevaṃ rītyā ekasmāt pūrvvamaparaṃ tat'pi pūrvva. maparamityevaṃ krameṇāsādayedityuktaṃ bhavati | purḍāśakapālena tuṣānupavapatītvatra yathā bhaviṣyatā purḍāśena kapālasya nirdeśa- stayā'vāpi bhaviṣyatā'gninttarasyā diś nirdeś bḍavyaḥ | kutaḥ ? "bhūme: samūhanaṃ kṛtvā gmayenpalipya ca | dravyākhyuttarataḥ sthāpya varṣauṃ kuryyādudaṅmukhīm" || iti ṭahyāsaṃgraha bhūmilepanānantarameva dravyāsādanābhi- - dhānāt || 15 || āvyamiti | hmeṣu haviṣ'nādeśe bhājyaṃ hmasādhana[ 1pra. 8kha. ] kapradīpaḥ | nāṅguṣṭhādadhikā grāhyā samit sthūlatayā kvacit | na viyuktā tvacā caiva na sakṭā na pāṭitā || 17 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | samidhamādhāyānuparyukṣedistrtāṃ samidhaṃ parimāṇādiniyamena vyaktīkarti| aṅguṣṭhādhikasthūlā kvacidapi kammaṇi mitra grahītavyā | tadūnā tu sthaulyena grāhyaiva | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 17 || prabhā | dravyamācāryaiḥ kriyateṃ | mantrasya devatāyāścānādeśe prajāpatiriti sirāha| yadyapi dhātukharūpe'rthe śitapvidhiṃ śābdikāḥ smaranti, tathāpi itikarttavyatāvidheryajateḥ pūrvvavattva mili īcate- naśibda miti caivamādipāramarśapraygadarśanād bhāve'pi tastha vidhirmantavyaḥ | ataeva nyāyācārapi,- - "svargāpavargayrmārgamāmananti manīṣiṇaḥ | yadupā stimasāvatra paramātmā nirūpyate" | iti prayuktam || 16 || samidhamādhāyānupayucya iti gbhilasvktāṃ samidhaṃ vyakt- karti nāṅguṣṭhāditi dvābhyām | hmeṣu iti vijānatā iti ca padadayamuttaralkasyamavāpyanveti | sthūlatayā aṅguṣṭhādadhikā tvacā vinirmuktā kṭasahitā vipāṭitā samit keṣucidapi hmeṣu vijānatā na grahtavyā | aṅguṣṭhādūnasthūlā tu na nividā || 17 || 3 kapradīpaḥ | [ 1 pra. 8 ] prādeśānnādhikā nnā na tathā syādiśākhikā | na na tu vaiśvadevahmasyānte eva || 7 || yānyadha iti | agnimupasamādhāya kuśaiḥ samantaṃ paristṛṇayāt iti sūtreṇa gbhilena yatparistaraṇamupadiṣṭaṃ tasmādadhaḥ pūrvaṃ 2 kampradīpaḥ | varhiḥ paryukṣaṇaścaiva vāmadevyajapastathā | kṛtyāhutiṣu sarvvāmu trikametanna vidyate || 8 || haviṣyeṣu yavāmukhyāstadanu vrīhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | māṣakdravagaurādīn sarvālābhe'pi varjayet ||10|| [ 1pra. 8kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | hmavāt staraṇapariṣyrnivṛttiriti | ataekasādhyeṣvavarhi:- khiti gṛhyāntaram || 8|| abhicārahmeṣu sarveṣu varhirāditrikaṃ nāsti | at na karttavyamiti || 8 || - atha haviṣyasthāvasyāgnau juhuyāt – iti sūtr haviṣyaṃ saṣṭayati | haviṣyamadhye yavāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāthamikakalpā ityarthaḥ | tadanantaraṃ | prabhā | yāni sāyaṃprātamādauni gbhilenktāni, teṣu staraṇaṃ na bhavati na kāryyamityarthaḥ | tathā "paridhnapyeka kurvvanti" iti gbhila- strktān paridhnapi teṣu varjjayet | tatvahetuḥ, ekakāryyārthamādhya tvāditi | yathā staraṇasya hmakāryyārthaṃ pariveṣṭanaṃ sādhyaṃ, tathā paridhīnāmapi | ataḥ staraṇavat paridhnapi varjayet || 8 || vahiriti | varhiḥstaraṇaṃ, paryucaṇaṃ adite'numanyastra ityādi mantrairyadukta, vāmadevyajapatha, etatvayaṃ sarveṣvabhicārahmeṣu nāsti ||8|| atha haviṣyasthānasyāgnau juhuyāditi gbhilasūtrktaṃ haviṣyaṃ kammapradṣaḥ | pāṇyāhutidaśaparvapūrikā kaṃsādinā cet suvapūramātrikā | daivena tīrthena ca hayate haviḥ khaṅgāriṇi kharciṣi tacca pāvake || 11 || [ 1pra. 8kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | TAP ṣaṣṭikākhyāḥ smṛtā ānukalpikā iti yāvat | māṣakdrava- gaurasarṣapādīn muhakalāyagdhūmādyabhāve'pi varjayet | esena muhādayaḥ āpatkalpikā ityuktaṃ bhavati | ādipadena rājamāṣā- dīnāṃ grahaṇam | gbhilabhāṣyakatā tu, krādīniti paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaca krvaṭa iti || 10 || -- aṅgulīnāṃ hādaśaparvvāṇi yayā pūrkhante tāvatparimāṇā pāṇyāhutiḥ kāryyā | haviṣyābhāve: dadhipayyavāgūbhiryadā prabhā | vyaktīkarti haviṣyeṣu iti | haviṣyeṣu madhye yavāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ, vrhayaḥ tadanu talamā: anukalpā ityarthaḥ | vrīhiḥ śaratpakadhānyam | sarveṣāmalāme'pi māṣādīn varjayet | māṣa: samīdhānya viśeṣaḥ | kdravaḥ kradūṣaḥ | gaura: khetasarṣapaḥ | ādipadāt rāja: māṣādīnāṃ grahaṇam | krādīniti pāṭhe krvaṭaḥ | evañca māṣādiniṣedhāt mudrādaya āpatkalpā ityuktaṃ bhavati || 10 || ..
pāṇyāhutiriti | aṅgulīnāṃ hādaśaparvvāṇi yāvatā pūryate tāvatparimāyā pāṇyāhutiḥ karttavyā | "kaṃsena vā carusthāsyā vā kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | | hmastadā kaṃsena carasthālyā suveśa ve veti sūtrtakaṃsādika- māhutyadhikaraṇam | sā cāiti: suvapūraparimālā eva ca hmdevatīrthena havirbhātāpādakāṅgārayukte'lilihān kārya iti | rasādinā cedityapapāṭha: | havirādhārapāṇi sāhacaryyavirdhāt | yacca gadyavyāsavacanam | uttānakarapañcāṅga- svagrairbaliṃ haret | hṛṣacakrābāreṇttānāṅguṣṭhāṅguliyāgraparvamāvaṃ prapūrṇa juhuyāt | sahbhilīyetaraviṣayaṃ, gbhilīyānāmapya sambhava- viṣayam | [ 1pra. 8kha. ] "ārdrāmalakamānena kuryyāḍmahavirbalīn | prāṇāhutibaliñcaiva mṛdaṃ gātraviśdhanīm" # ityetasyāpyeṣaiva vyavasthā || 11 || prabhā | suveṇa ve vā" iti gbhilasvānusāra yadi kaṃsādinā iyate, tadā suvapūraparimāyā cāhutirbhavati | sarvvatra devena tīrthena haviyate | taca havanaṃ śbhanāṅgārayukta haviṣbhamatāpādakā- dvāraiti yāvat | svarciyi śbhanārthiryukte ammī kāryam | parimāṇāntaraṃ gbhilīyavyatiriktaviṣayam || 11 ||
garmavyāsavacanam, iti ka pustake pāṭhaḥ | 18 kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha. ] y'naciṃṣi juhtyagnau vyaṅgāriṇi ca mānavaḥ | mandāgnirāmayāva ca daridraśca sa jāyate || 12 || tasmāta samiddhe htavyaṃ nāsamiddhe kadācana | ārgyamicchatā''yuśca śriyamātyantikṃ tathā || 13 || juhūṣaṃśca hute caiva pāṇisūryasphādārubhiḥ | na kuryyādagnidhamanaṃ na kuyādyajanādinā || 138 11 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ uktāṅgārāciḥ śūnye lagnau juhti y mānavaḥ sa dīrghargī · jāyate | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 12 || na kevalaṃ samiddhe hme mandāgmivādiparihāra kiṃ tvārgyādayaḥ sātiśaya sampattay'pi prāpyante ityārgya micchate tyādinktam || 13 || htumicchan hute cāgnau uddīpanaṃ pāṇyādibhirna kuyāt | prabhā | y'narṣiṣīti | ymānavaḥ arci:śūnye vigatāṅgāre cāgnau juhti, sa mandāgniḥ, anyairapyā mayairgairyuktaḥ, daridraśca bhavati || 13|| tasmāditi | yasmādevaṃ, tasmāt ātyantikaṃ ārgyaṃ āyuḥ triyacecchatā samiddhe agnau hsavyaṃ, asamiḍe tvagnau kadācidapi na htavyamiti nindātiśayārthamuktam || 13 || juhaṣaṃtheti | hmāt purastāt parastāñca agneruddīpanaṃ hastā- māṇisya dārūbhiḥ iti ka pustake pāṭhaḥ | [ 1pra. 8kha. ] kama pradīpaḥ | mukhenaiva dhamedagniṃ mukhāḍe'ṣ'dhya jāyata | nāgniṃ mukheneti ca yallaukike yjayanti tat ||15|| navamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | sphāḥ khajākār yajñapāvaviśeṣaḥ | vyajanādinetyādipadaṃ vastrādi- grahaṇārtham || 14 || kena tarhi dhamedityata āha | mukhenaiva jvālayet | hi yasmādeṣ'gnirmukhādadhyajāyata | tathāca puruṣasūktam | mukhādagnirajāyateti | adhauti agne śreṣṭhatā- janmana: | uttamāṅga mukhasthānatvāt | yattu nāgniṃ mukhenpadhame niṣedhavacanaṃ, talaukike'gnau yjayanti na tu saṃskṛta iti || 15 || navamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | prabhā | dibhirna kāryaṃ na kuryyāt | smāḥ khajākāryajñapāvaviśeṣaḥ | prasiddhamanyat | evaṃ vyajanādinā agnidhamanaṃ na kuryyāt | kuryyā- hā vyajanādinā iti pāṭhe vyajanādinā agnidhamanaṃ vidhīyate | ayameva pāṭh bahuṣu pustakeṣu dṛśyate | nārāyaṇāpādhyāyena tu na kuryyāt vyajanādinā iti paṭhitam || 14 || mukhenaike iti | eke ācāvyā mukhenāgniṃ dhamanti | nārā- yaṇpādhyāyena tu mukhenaiva dhamedagnimiti paṭhitam | sukhe- nāgnidhamane hetu: mukhāiauti | yasmādeṣ'gniḥ prajāpatermukhā kampradīpaḥ | prabhā | dajāyata, tasmāt mukhenāmliṃ dhamanti| tathāca tāṇḍe brāhmaṇe | s'kāmayata yajña sṛjeyeti sa mukhataeva triṣṭatamasṛjata taṃ gāyatrchand'nvasṛjyatāgnirdevatā brāhmaṇ manuṣy vasantaṛtu- stasmāt vitṛt stmānāṃ mukhaṃ gāyatrī chanda sāmagni devatānāṃ brāhmaṇīmanuṣyāṇāṃ vasantaṛtunāṃ tasmāt brāhmaṇmukhena vykheṃ karti mukhat hi sṛṣṭa iti | mukhāgnica vāyuca iti ca pauruṣe sūtṃ | mukhāt jātasyāmmermukhena dhamanaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ | yattu, mukhāt mukhapāvyamantrāt eṣa saṃskṛt'gnirajāyata iti tattvavikhyātaṃ taduktyanavalkanena | ‡ [ 1. ṭekha. ] yaca nāmniṃ mukhenṣadhamet iti sukhenāmnidhamanasya niṣedha: te, tantu laukikā nidhamanaviṣaye yjayanti | na tvādhāna- saṃskṛtānnidhamanaviṣaye sa niṣedhaḥ pravarttate | laukikayāgni- rādhāna saṃskṛtādanya iti vācaspatimitraprabhṛtayaḥ | yuktacaitat | bhādhāna saṃskṛtāmnyupame etadabhidhānena tathā pratīteḥ | "amnistu nāmadheyādau hme sarvvata laukika: " | iti nāmāveyādī hmādhikaraṇasyāpyamnelaukikaśabdena parā- marbhāca || 15 || iti navamakhaṇḍaḥ | daśamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || yathā'hani tathā prātarnityaṃ snāyādanāturaḥ | dantān prakṣālya nadyādau gehe cettadamantravat || 1 || pariśiṣṭamakāmaḥ | paribhāṣayā gbhilktaprātarhmādikaṃ saṣṭīkṛtyānuktaṃ prātaḥ- sānamāha - bharg'hani srāne yā paripāṭī tayaiva prātaḥ pratyahaṃ nadī devakhātaprasravaṇādiṣu khāyāhantān jalena pracātya | yadi tu gṛhe svāti tadā khānāṅgamantraśūnyamā śavanamātraṃ śarīraśahārthaṃ kuryāt | tathāca dacaḥ, - "atyantamalina: kāynavacchidrasamanvitaḥ | sravatyeva divārācī prātaḥstrānaṃ viśdhanam || kṛyanti hi suṣuptasya indriyāṇi savanti ca | aṅgāni samatāṃ yānti uttamāṃnyadhamāni ca * || prabhā | khāna madhyāhasrānamevśaṃ na tu prātaḥkhānaṃ, tadidānī- mabhidhatte yathā'hanauti | yasya mānena rgahaḍirbhavati s'tvā- tarapadencate | sa na bhavatītyanāturaḥ | s'yamanātur- utanāmyadhamaiḥ saha ti pāṭhaḥ | , kama pradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 10kha. ] nāradāyuktabāya maṭāṅgulamapāṭitam | satvacaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ syātta greṇa pradhāvayet || 2 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | prātaḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ hi tat | • sarvamarhati śuddhāmā prātaḥsrāyī japādikam" || dṛṣṭaṃ malāpakarṣaṇamadṛṣṭaṃ śucitvam || 1 || dantapracālanaṃ dantakāṣṭhena dalaśdhanapūrvvaka mityāha nāradāyuktaṭacabhavaṃ yaddantakāṣṭhaṃ tasyāgreṇa dantān śdhayet | śeṣaṃ sugamam | tathāca nāradaśikṣā | prabhā | dantān pracātya yathā divase tathā prātaḥkāle nadyādau nityaṃ vāyāt | gṛhe cet tat khānaṃ kriyate tadā tat snānaṃ mantravatra bhavati śramavakamityarthaḥ | prātarityaruṇdayakālaparam | prātaḥsnāyyaruṇakiraṇagrastāṃ prācīmavalkya nāyāditi viṣṇūteḥ | "catasr ghaṭikāḥ prātararuṇdaya uccate | yatīnāṃ nānakāl'yaṃ gaṅgāmbhaḥ sadṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ" | iti smṛtteva | yathā'hani tathā prātarityanena prātaḥstrāne'pyaha:- khānadharmā: pradiśyante | nayādāviti prādipadena devakhāta- prasravaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam || 1 || dantān pracāsyetyuktam | tacca pracālanaṃ dantakāṣṭhena dantānāṃ
vārḍa, itika pustake pāṭhaḥ | . kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | "āmrapailāśavilvānāmapāmārgaśirīṣayḥ | vāgyataḥ prātarutthāya bhacayed dantadhāvanam || khadiraśca kadambaca karavīrakarañjayḥ | sarve kaṇṭa kinaḥ puṇyā: criṇaya viśeṣataḥ"* || [ 1pra. 10 kha. ] pailāśa āyātakaḥ | sthūlatā cāsya viṣṇūkkā | tathāhi, "kannyagrasamasyaulyaṃ sakūcaṃ hādaśāṅgulam | prātarutthāya yatavāk bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam" || sakūrcamagrasthāne dalitam | dvādaśāṅgulavidhiśca gbhilyavyati- riktānām | teṣāmanenaivāṣṭāṅgulavidhānāt || 2 || vāgyataḥ prātarutyāya bhacayeddantadhāvanam || khadiraca kadambaya karavīrakarañjayḥ | prabhā | śdhana pūrvva kamityāha nāradāyuktati | nāradāyukta vṛkṣaprabhavamapā- ṭitaṃ tvacā sahitaṃ aṣṭāṅgulaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ syāt | tasya kāṣṭhasya agrapradeśena dantān prakarṣeṇa śdhayet | nāradaḥ - "āmrapailāśavilvānāmapāmārgaśirīṣayḥ | sarvve kaṇṭakinaḥ puṇyā: kṣauriṇaśca yaśakhinaḥ" || pailāśa ātrātakaḥ | ādipadāt, - -
143 - yaśasinaḥ iti kha pustake pāṭhaḥ | 144 kamapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 10 kha. ] utthāya neve pracālaya śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | parijaṣyaḥ ca mantreṇa bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yathā dantakāṣṭhaṃ bhavayettadāha- bhayyāyā utthāyāciṇ pracāsyācamanena śucirbhūtvā ekacitt- mantreṇābhimalā dantaśudāyeṃ kāṣṭhaṃ bhakṣayet | bhakṣayedisi pūrvī- ttarakālayrbhacaṇaghamācamanātideśāt gauramamnihtra bhandavat || 3 || iti | prabhā | "tiśaṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṭukaṃ sugandhi kaṇṭakānvitam | cirṇāṃ vṛcagulmānāṃ majayehantadhāvanam" || "khadira kadambaya karapraya tathā vaṭaḥ | tigliḍī veṇapṛṣṭhañca pāmvanimbī tathaivaca | apāmārgaśca viśvañca arkañcḍumbarastathā | ete praśastā: kavitā dantadhāvanakammasu" | iti caivamādismṛntartasyāpi parigrahaḥ || 2 || utyāyeti | śavyāyā utyāya catuīyaṃ pracātya bhācamanena śaci rbhūlā vakṣyamāṇena manyeca dantadhāvanaṃ bhakṣayet | ava dantakāṣṭhasya vasut na bhakṣaṇaṃ kintu tena dantaśdhanameva | tena kuchapāyinā- mayane'gnihtraśabdavadava bhakṣiprayg gauṇa: tahamātidemārthaḥ | tena bhjanavadavāpi purastāt parastāva dvirācamanaṃ karttavyam || 3|| [ 1pra. 10 kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | 22 āyurvalaṃ yaśvarcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca | brahma prajñāñca medhāñca tvanndhehi vanaspate || 4 || yavyaya śrāvaṇādi sarvvānayrajakhalāḥ | tāsu snānaṃ na kurvīta varjayitvā samudragāḥ ||5|| pariśiṣṭaṃprakāśaḥ | mantramāha, - - nayādī khāyādityasyāpavādamāha | 145 śravaṇadimāsadayaṃ sarvvīnāḥ samudragetarā aśuddhā atastāsu na nāyāt | yavy māsaḥ | yavyāmāsāḥ khameka: saṃvatsara iti śatapathate | samudragā: sākṣāt na tu paramparayā'pi tathā sati sarvvāsāmeva tathātvāt paryudāsānupapatteḥ | ataeva manuḥ | "yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve samudre yānti saṃsthitim" | iti || 4 || 5 || prabhā || satramāha āyurvvalamiti || 4 || nadyādau nāyādityuktaṃ, tasyāpavādamāha yavyaiyamiti | yavyāmāsāḥ svamekaḥ saṃvatsara iti śruteḥ yavyaśabd māsavacanaḥ | atyantasaṃyge dvitīyā | śrāvaṇādi māsadayaṃ savānady raja- svalā bhavanti, samudragānadrvarjayitvā | tāsu rajasvalāsa nadīsu khānaṃ na kurvīta | aba ca samudragā ityanena sācāt samudra- 1
māsaiyaṃ, iti pāṭhāntaram | 146 kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 10 kha. ] dhanuḥsahasrāṇyaṣṭau ca gatiryāsāṃ na vidyate | na tā nadīśabdavahā garttāste parikrttitāḥ ||6|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | nadīlakṣaṇamāha - yāsāmapāṃ dhanuḥ sahasrāṣṭakaparimitadeśaparyantaṃ gamanaṃ nāsti prabhā | gāminīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ, na tu paramparayā samudragāminīnāmapi | tathāt savvāsāmeva nadīnāṃ tathātvāt varjjayitvā samudragā- ityanupapatteḥ | yadāha manuḥ - "yathā nadīnadā: sarvve samudre yānti saṃsthitim" | iti | smaranti ca | iti | "gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva lakṣajātā sarakhatī | rajasā nābhibhūyante ye cānye nadasaṃjñakā : " | "gaṅgā dhammaṃdravī puṇyā yamunā ca sarakhatī | antargatarajyge sarvvāha : kheva nirmalā: " ||
iti caivamādi | ana ca tāsu ityadhikaraṇatvena nirdeśāt jalāntarāsambhave uddhṛtatalalena snānaṃ na niṣiḍamiti pratīyate | ataeva vyāghrapāda:- "abhāve kūpavāpīnāmanyenāpi samuddhṛte | rajduṣṭe'pi payasi grāmabhg na duṣyati" || 5 || nadīlakṣaṇamāha dhanuḥsahasrāṇauti | yāsāmapāṃ aṣṭau dhanu: sahakampradīpaḥ | upākamaṇi ctsarge pretasnāne tathaivaca | candrasūryyagrahe caiva rajdṣ na vidyate || 7 || [ 1pra. 10kha. ] 147 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | na tā nadīśabdavācyāḥ kintu garttāste sarvairmunibhiruktā iti | dhanuḥ parimāṇaṃ hastacatuṣṭayam | tathāca viṣṇudharmttara prathamakāṇḍam | "hādaśāṅgulika: śaṅkastayañca śayaḥ smṛtaḥ | taccatuṣkaṃ dhanuḥ prktaṃ krś dhanuḥsahasrakaḥ" || bhayhastaḥ || 6 || yavyadayasthāpavādamāha, - upākamādiṣu rajdṣ nāsti || 7 || prabhā | srāṇi, kālādhvanratyantasaṃyge ityanena dvitīyā | gatirnāsti, tā pāpī nadīśabdavāyā na bhavanti | te garttā munibhiḥ kathitāḥ | vidheyaprādhānya viṣacayā te iti puṃsā nirdeśaḥ | dhanuḥ parimāṇamāha viṣṇudharmttaraprathamakāṇḍam- "dādaśāṅgulika : śatruḥ taddayantu śayaḥ smṛtaḥ | tañcatuṣkaṃ dhanuḥ prktaṃ krś dhanu:sahasraka: " || n nadīnāṃ rajdṣasthāpavādamāha upākaṇauti | upākarma, 'prauṣṭhapadyāṃ hastenpākaraṇamiti gbhilktam | utsargaḥ, teṣīmutsṛ- janti iti gbhilasvtaeva | prasiddhamanyat | upākarmādiṣu rajdṣnāsti || 7 || kapradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 10kha. ] vedāśchandāsi sarvāṇi brahmādyāśca divaukasaḥ | jalārthin'tha pitar marcyādyāstatharṣayaḥ || 8 || upākarmmaṇi ctsarge snānārthaṃ brahmavādinaḥ | yiyāsūnanugacchanti saṃhṛṣṭāhyaśarīriṇaḥ || 8 || samāgamastu yatraiṣāṃ tavānye* bahavmalāḥ | nūna sarve kṣayaṃ yānti kimutaikaṃ nadīrajaḥ || 10 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | 148 hetuma nigadamāha- upākaṇi ctsarge ca nānārthaṃ gacchatvedādhyetṝn ṛṣi- devādyā uktā jalārthinaḥ saṃhṛṣṭā adṛśyā pramugacchanti | tathācaiteṣāṃ yatra nadījale samavāyastava gurutarāeva brahmahatyā- day bahavdṣāḥ kāna nāśaṃ yānti kisuteka laghu ca nadīraja iti || 8 || 8|| 10 || prabhā | upākarmaṇyusarge ca rajdṣābhāve hetuvannigadamāha vedā- iti vibhiḥ | ṛgvedādayvedāḥ gāyatrayādīni sarvāṇi eka- viṃśatinchandāṃsi brahmādaydevāḥ pitaraḥ marccādaya ṛṣayava jalārthinaḥ santaḥ samyak harṣayuktā adṛśyā bhūtvā upākarmaṇi usameṃ khānāyeṃ gantumicchan vedādhyetṝn anugacchanti | yatra tatleva iti pāṭhāntaram | [ 1pra. 10 kha. ] kamapradṣaḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ sicyamānānāmantarālaṃ samāśritāḥ | saṃpibeyuḥ śarreṇa parṣanmuktajalacchaṭāḥ || 11 || vidyādīn brāhmaṇaḥ kāmān putrādaunnārthyapi dhruvān | āmubhikāṇyapi mukhānyāpnuyāt sa na saṃśayaḥ || 12|| pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | 148 na kevalaṃ rajdṣanāśa: kintu, - - uccairṛṣīnabhiṣiñcantīti vacanāt sicamānānāmṛṣīṇāṃ madhyamāśritaḥ sekakartṛsamudāyamuktajalacchaṭā yaḥ śarīreṇa pratīcche- brāhmaṇaḥ sa vidyādhanādīn kāmānārthyapi pratīcchantīputrasabhā gyādīn sthirān labhata iti atra na sandehaḥ kārthaḥ || 11 || 12 || prabhā | nadījale eṣāṃ vedādaunāṃ samāgamaḥ tatra anye sarve brahmahatyāday- bahav dṣā: niścitaṃ nāśaṃ yānti, tatra eka nadrajaḥ nāśaṃ yāsīti kimu vaktavyam || 8 || 8 || 10 || ṛṣīṇāmiti | upkamaṇi utsarge ca, uccaiḥ ṛṣīnabhi ṣiścet iti vacanāt uccaiḥ ṛṣīṇāmabhiṣeka: karttavyaḥ | tatra ca siyāmānānāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ antarālaṃ madhyaṃ āśritaḥ yaḥ kacit parṣanmuktajalacchaṭā : sekakarttṛsamudāyamuktān jalakaṇān śarīreṇa
pratīcchet gṛtīyāt, sa brāhmaṇa: vidyādīn kāmānāpnuyāt yṣidapi dhruvān cirasthāyinaḥ putvādīn kāmā nāpnuyāt nāva saṃśayaḥ kārya: || 11 || 12 || 150
kampradīpaḥ | [ 1pra. 10kha. ] aśuccaśucinā dattamāmamṛcchakalādinā | anirgatadaśāhāstu pretāracā si bhuñjate || 13 || svardhunyambhaḥ samāni syuḥ sarvvāṇyambhārasi bhūtale | kūpasthānyapi smārkagrahaṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 || daśamakhaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | pretastrāne rajdṣābhāve hetumavigadamāha - aśucinā mṛtakāśaucavatā'pakkamṛnmayakapālakādinā dattaṃ yāvaddaśāhasamāptirva bhavati tarpaṇaparyante nadrajī na jalaṃ dāḍhapātrayraśucitvādaśacceva tāvapretābhute | tasmātāne dṣya | rakṣāṃsti pretaprasaṅgāduktam | etenāmamṛcchaka lenāpi piṇḍādī jaladāne na dṣa ityuktam || 13 || yasmātsarvvāsyeva bhūmiṣṭhāni jalāni na punaruddhṛtāni smārka. prabhā | pretastrāne rajdṣābhāve hetuṣavigadamāha aśuccaśucinā iti | aśucinā mṛtakāśīcavatā apakamatkapālādinā dattaṃ, ataeva aśuci jalaṃ anirmatadaśāhā: pretā bhujate | rakṣāṃsti dṛṣṭāntārtham | yat maraṇāvadhidaśāhaparyantaṃ pretā aśuci jalameva bhujate ataḥ pretastrāne tarpaṇaparyante rajdṣ nāstī- tyarthaḥ || 13 || candrasūryyagrahaṇe rajdṣābhāve hetuvabigadamāha svardhunyambha:[ 1pra. 10kha. ] grahaṇe gaṅgājalasamāni| suvyaktam || 14 || kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | tasmādrahaṇe'pi rajdṣābhāvaḥ | śeṣaṃ daśamaḥ khaṇḍa: | iti mahāmahpādhyāyaśrīnārāyaṇakate pariśiṣṭaprakāśe prathamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ samāptaḥ || 151 prabhā | samānti | candrasūryagrahaṇe bhūmiṣṭhāni sarvvāṇi bhāṃsi jalāni kūpasthitānyapi gaṅgājalatulyāni bhavanti at na tatra rajdṣa ityabhiprāya: | bhūmiṣṭhajalānāṃ gaṅgājala samatvavacanāt uddhṛtajalānāṃ na tathātvam || 14 || iti daśamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | iti mahāmahpādhyāyaśrīcandrakāntatarkālaṅkāraviracitāyāṃ kanyepradīpaprabhāyāṃ prathama: prapāṭhakaḥ | atha dvitīyaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ | prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | ata ūheṃ pravakṣyāmi sandhypāsanikaṃ vidhim | anarhaḥ karmaṇāṃ vipraḥ sandhyāhaun yataḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 || pariśiṣṭaprakaraṇaḥ | prātaḥsrānānantaraṃ prātaḥsandhyāmāha-- ataḥ prātaḥ snānānantaraṃ sandhypāsanasthānuṣṭhānaṃ kālveṃśana vacyāmi | yasmātkandhyāhīn brāhmaṇa: kanmaṇāṃ nityanaimittikādīnāmana- dhikārīti munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 || prabhā | idānīṃ sabhypāsanavidhiṃ vaktumupakramate ata jaīmiti | yasmāt sandhypāsanarahit brāhmaṇaḥ kamkhanadhikārī, tasmāt prātaḥ snānādanantaraṃ sadhypāsanavidhiṃ prakarṣeṇa vakṣyāmi| uttara- vākyagat yacchabdaḥ sāmathyāt pūrvvavākye tabdpādānaṃ nāpekṣate | atra cpāsyā devatā santhycate | "aharaha: sadhyā- suvāsauta" iti śruteḥ| "sandhau sayāmupāsauta" iti smṛtekha | [ 2pra. 1kha.] prabhā | sā cpāsyā devatā brahmaiva | tathāca taittirīyāḥ samāmananti | "udyantamastaṃ yantamādityamabhiṣyāyan kurvvan brāhmaṇ vidvān sakalaṃ bhadramase asāvādity brahmeti brahmaiva san brahmāpyeti ya evaṃ veda" iti | prāṇāyāmādikaṃ kurvvan ādityamabhidhyāyan ityartha: | mañcāḥ krśanti iti vadavādityaśabdenādityamaṇḍala- madhyavartī paramātmā bhaṇyate | sthānena sthānin lakṣaṇāt | gāyavārthānugamāca | smaranti ca, - iti | kanmapradṣaḥ | "āditye brahma ilveṣā niṭhā hyupaniṣatkhapi | kāndgye bṛhadāraṇye taittirīye tathaivaca" || "praṇavavyāhṛtibhyāñca gāyatrayā tritayena ca | upāsyaṃ paramaṃ brahma mātmā yatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ" || iti caivamādi | tathā, "na bhinnāṃ pratipadyeta gāyatrīṃ brahmaṇā saha | s'hamasmītyupāsīta vidhinā yena kenacit" | iti | "ṃkār bhagavān viṣṇuḥ" ityādivahācyavācakay- ramedādityabhiprāyaḥ | gāyatrī pratipādyaḥ sūryamaṇḍalāntargataḥ parameśvar'hamasmīti, pratyagāramaparamātmanrabhedabuypāsīte- tyarthaḥ || 1 || 20 154 kapradīpaḥ | [ 2pra. 1kha. ] savye pāyau kuśān kṛtvā kṛryādācamanakriyām | hakhāḥ pracaraṇauyāḥ syuḥ kuśādīrghāśca varhiṣaḥ || 2 || darbhāḥ pavitramityuktamataḥ sandhyādikamaṇi | savyaḥ spagrahaḥ kārthī dakṣiṇaḥ sapavitrakaḥ || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | sakhyāpravṛttaḥ prathamaṃ vāmahaste kuśān kṛtvā ācamanānuṣṭhānaṃ kuryyāt | yat iskhāḥ kuśā: pārvvaṇapañcayannādikarmānuṣṭhānārhāḥ, drghāśca staraṇārthaṃ varhiṣ bhavanti, darbhā eva anantargarbhiṇamityādi- lakṣaṇaṃ pavitramityuktam | atastadavasthāpanānāṃ sarvaka sūpaygāt sandhyādika khapi vāmaḥ kar bahutarakuśasahitaḥ, dakṣiṇaya pāṇi: pavitrakuśasahitaḥ kārya iti | anye tu yataḥ kuśaviśeṣāṇāṃ tattatkama viniyg na sadhyādikam | ataḥ sandhyādikamma- svavasthāviśeṣaśūnyāḥ kuśā: pavitramityuktamiti vyācakṣate ||2||3|| prabhā | santhypāsanavidhimāha savye pāṇāviti | vāmahaste kuśān gṛhītvā pācamanaṃ kuryyāt | prasaṅgāt kuśān viśinaṣṭi ikhā- iti sārḍena | hakhā: kuśā: pracaraṇīyāḥ pārkaṇapañcayanādi- kammānuṣṭhānaygyāḥ, dīrghā kuśā varhiṣaḥ svaraṇārthā ityarthaḥ | yatastatatkamsyavasthāviśeṣaviśeṣitāḥ kuśā vihitāḥ, ataḥ sakhyādikammaṇyavasthā viśeṣarahitā: kuśā: pavitramityukta pūrvvā- cā: | nāva pavitrapadena anantargarbhiṇaṃ sāgramiti paribhāṣitaṃ [ 28. 1kha. ] kampradīpaḥ | rakṣānte vāriṇātmānaṃ parikṣipya samantataḥ | śirasmārjanaṃ kuryāt kuśaiḥ sdakavindubhiḥ || 4 || 155 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | ācamanāmte ātmānaṃ jalena veṣṭayitvā rakṣā kāryyeti śeṣaḥ | anantaraṃ kuśerjalavindu sahitaiḥ śirasmārjanaṃ kuryāditi || 4 || prabhā | pavitra grahaṇīyaṃ, kintvavasthā viśeṣaśūndhaṃ kuśamātramityarthaḥ | savy vāmaḥ karaḥ spagrah bahutarakuśayuktaḥ, dakṣiṇavānantarkta- pavitrasahita kāryya: || 2 || 3 || racayediti | samantat vāriṇā pariveśya ātmānaṃ rakṣayet nārāyaṇpādhyāyena tu racānte iti paṭhitam | ghācamanāle ātmānaṃ jalena pariveśya rakṣā kāryeti vyākhyātañca | anantara jalavindumahitaiḥ kubhaiḥ śiras mārjanaṃ kuryyāt | avādita eka mārjanpadeśāt prāṇāyāmāt paramācamanānantaraṃ tadamupadeśāt sandhyāstre cedānīṃ tadanupadeśāt prāṇāyāmāt paramācamanā nantaraṃ tadupadeśācaitadnyānusārādidānīṃ vā sambhyāsūtrānusārāt prāṇāyāmāt paramācamanānantaraṃ vā mārjanaṃ kāryyam | s'yaṃ vikalpaḥ | iyreva vaśāsvatvāt śiṣṭācārasya cbhayathā darśanāt | kecit kila śiṣṭā idānīmeva keciśva sabhyāsūtrkta krameṇaiva mārjanamācarant dṛśyante | ataeva subdhinaukārā
racavet iti pāṭhāntaram | 156 kapradīpaḥ | [ 2ma. 1kha.] praṇavbhūrbhuvaḥ svañca sāvitrī ca tṛtīyikā | avdaivatastṛcaścaiva caturtha iti mārjanam || 5 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | mājjainamantramāha- ṃkār bhūrādivyāhṛtitrayaṃ tṛtīyā ca gāyatrī caturtha āp- hiṣṭhetyādiṛkatrayamitīdaṃ mārjanakriyākaraṇamityarthaḥ || 5 || prabhā | dibhiridānīmeva mādhavācāyaṃprabhṛtibhistu sandhyā sūtrkkakrama eva mārjanaṃ likhitam || 4 || 1 mārjanamantrānāī praṇava iti | satra tāvat praṇava ek- mārjanamantraḥ | vyāhṛtitrayamapara: gāyatrī cānya: | abadevatya- māp hiṣṭhāmay bhuva ityādi ṛktrayamaparī mantraḥ | tṛtīyikā iti caturthamiti cpādānāt tathā'vagateḥ | tathāca praṇaveṇaikaṃ, vyāhṛtibhirekaṃ, gāyacairakaṃ, āphiṣṭhādiṛkvayeṇa caika mārjana karttavyamiti parthavasyati | ataeva, - "ṛgante mārjanaṃ kuryyāt pādānte vā samāhitaḥ | āphiṣṭhācā kāryaṃ mārjanantu kuśdakaiḥ || pratipraṇava saṃyuktaṃ cipembhūti pade pade | racasyānte'thavā kāryyaṛṣīṇāṃ matamdṛśam" || iti smṛtyantare mārjjane bahavaḥ kalpā uktā | tatva vṛścasyānte iti cchandgaviṣayaṃ, svaśāstrānugrahāt || 5 || . deśa caturthaṃ, iti pāṭhāntaram | kampradīpaḥ [ 2pra. 1kha. ] bhūrādyāstisa evaitā mahāvyāhṛtay'vyayāḥ | maharjanastapaḥ satyaṃ gāyatrī śirasā saha || 6 || āpjytauras'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥskhariti śiraḥ | pratipratīkaṃ praṇavamuccārayedante ca śirasaḥ || 7 || etā etāṃ sahānena tathaibhiddaśabhiḥ saha | trirjapedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa uccate || 8 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | 157 anantaraṃ prāṇāyāmamā i- bhūrbhuvaḥ skharityetā eva mārjjanktā: avyayamuktiphalatvādavyayā mahā- prabhā | athedānṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ vaktuṃ tanmantrānāha bhūrādyā iti | bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityetāstisra eva mahāvyāhṛta y'vyayaphalavādavyayāḥ | maharādicatuṣkamapi vyāhṛtaya eva | bhūrbhuva:kharmaharjanastapaḥ satyamiti sapta vyāhṛtaya iti sabhyāstrāt | gāyatrī śiraśca || 6 || kimidaṃ śir nāma ? tadāha prapjytīriti | pratyavayavamādī, śirasa ādāvante ca praṇavamudīrayet | tathāca satānāṃ vyāhatīnāmād sapta praṇavāḥ, gāyatrayā ādau caika: | śirasa ādāvante ceti militvā daśa praṇavā bhavanti || 7 || samprati prāṇāyāmamāha etā iti | etāḥ sapta vyāhatī :
gāyalīca śirastathā itika pustake pāṭhaḥ kama pradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | vyāhatayastisrmaharā dicatuṣṭayaṃ ca tatsavituriti gāyatrī ca tathā āpjytirityādi śiraḥ | etasmin samudāye pratyavayavamādau ṃkāramuccārayet | tatbhūrādivyāitisaptakādau sapta praṇavāḥ, gāyatrādau caikaṃ, śirasañcādāvante ca iyamityevaṃ daśa praṇavāḥ | patā: sapta vyāhat: etāṃ gāyatrīmanena śirasā saha tathebhirdaśabhiḥ praṇavaiḥ saha niruḍamāṇastrirjapet | sa prāṇāyāma- uccate || 6 || 7 || 8|| 158 prabhā | etāṃ gāyatrī anena śirasā saha, tathā ebhirdaśabhiḥ praṇavaiḥ saha, niyamitaprāṇa : trirjapet | s'yaṃ prāṇāyāma: kathyate | yadyapi prāṇāyāmaśabdaḥ prāṇasyāyamanamabhidhātumarhati, tathāpi tasaṃbandhā- jap'pi prāṇāyāma kathyate | prāṇayāmaḥ sa uccate ityabhi dhānāt prāṇāyāmapadārth'va paribhāṣyate | na tvayaṃ tatkarttavyatā- bdhak vidhiḥ | sa tu " evaṃ vn kṛtvā sapta vā ṣḍaśa vācāmet" | iti sabhyāsūtrādupalabdhavyaḥ | tathāca prāṇāyāma- cayamavaśyaṃ karttavyam | smaranti ca | "prākkuleṣu tataḥ sthitvā darbheṣu ca samāhitaḥ | prāṇāyāmavayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet sandhyāmiti śrutiḥ" || iti | • [ 2pra. 1kha. ] "prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kāryaṃ sanyāsa ca tisṛṣvapi " | iti caivamādi bahulam || 8 || kama pradīpaḥ | kareṇddhṛtya salilaṃ ghrāṇamāsajya tatra ca | japedanāyatā survā triḥ sakṛḍā'ghamarṣaṇam || 8 || [ 2pra. 1kha. ] 158 utthāyārkaṃ prati prhet trikeṇāññjalimambhasaḥ | uccitramityṛgḍayena cpatiṣṭhedanantaram || 10 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | anantaraca - hastena jalamuddhṛtya tatra ghrāṇamarpayitvā ṛtace tyādyaghamarṣaṇaṃ niruddhaprāṇ'niruḍaprāṇvā sakkacirvā japediti || 8 || anantarañca - utthitbhūtvā praṇavavyāhṛtisāvitragalakena vikeṇa sūryyābhimukhaṃ jalāñjaliṃ cipet | anantaram uduyaṃ citraṃ devānāmiti ṛg- hayena cpasthānaṃ kuryyāt || 10 || prabhā | kareṇeti | dakṣiṇahastena jalamuvṛtya tasmin jale nāsikāṃ lagayitvā aniyamitaprāṇ niyamitaprāṇ vā vāratrayamekavāraṃ vā ṛtaśca satyavetyādiṛkvayāmakamaghamarṣaṇasūktaṃ japet || 8 || utthāyeti | utthit bhūtvā praṇavatryāhṛtigāyatrātmakena trikeṇa jalāñjalimādityaṃ prati kṣipet | sandhyāsūtre añjalitraya- pracepābhidhānādava cāṣnalimityekavacanasaṃygādanayrvikalpaḥ | añjalivayaṃ vā ekaṃ vā añjaliṃ cipediti | kampradīpaḥ | sandhyādaye'pyupasthānametadāhu rmanīṣiṇaḥ | madhye tvaha uparyasya vibhrāḍādīcchayā japet || 11||
[ 2pra. 1kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | pūrvvā nigadavyākhyātam | madhyāī prātaḥsandhyāyāñca vivāḍabṛhadityanuvākaṃ śivasaṅlyaṃ maṇḍalabrāhmaṇaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca icchayā japet na tvavaśya miti || 11 || prabhā | "karābhyāṃ tyamādāya gāyatrā cābhimantritam | ādityābhimukhastiṣṭhan virūīṃ sandhyayḥ kṣipet || madhyāhe tu sakkadevaṃ kṣepaṇayaṃ dvijātibhiḥ" | iti vyāsavatanktā vyavasthā tu gbhilyavyatiriktaviṣayā | atra sāmānyata evāñjalimityabhidhānāt | sūrypasthāne madhyā viśeṣābhivānenāsya sāmānya viṣayatvāvagateśca | tadanantaraṃ udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti citraṃ devānāmiti ca ṛghayenādityasypasthānaṃ kuryyāt | avāpyutyāyeti varttate || 10 || sadhyāiye'pīti | prātaḥ sāyaṃsandhyayrevamupasthānaṃ manīṣiṇ- vadanti | ah madhye madhyāisandhyāyāntu asypasthānasypari paścāt vibhrā bṛhadityādika daśatisamāptiparyantaṃ icchayā japet | evameva pāṭhaḥ sarvvala dṛśyate | nārāyaṇpādhyāyena tu madhye vaha udaye ceti paṭhitaṃ, madhyāhe prātaḥsandhyāyāntu iti vyākhyātañca | sañcintanīyam | sandhyāiye'pyevamupasthānamityanupapatteḥ || 11 ||
mevama iti pāṭhāntaram | [ 2pra. 1kha. ] kammapradīpaḥ | tadasa saktapārvā ekapādaīpādapi | kuryātkṛtāñjalirvāpi arddhavāhurathāpi vā || 12 || yatra syātkṛcchrabhūyastvaṃ śreyas'pi manīṣiṇaḥ | bhūyastvaṃ bruvate taba kṛcchrācy hyavāpyate || 13 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | tat upasthānaṃ bhūmyalagnagulphatalabhāg bhūmiṣṭhekacaraṇ bhūmiṣṭhāī- caraṇ'pi vā kuryyāt | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 12 || gurulaghuprayāsasādhyānāṃ kathaṃ vikalpa ityavāha prayāsabāhu- lyāt phalabhūyastvamiti | akṣarārthṃ nigadavyākhyāta iti || 13 || prabhā | taditi | bhūmyalagnagulaphatalabhāg vā bhūmilagnaikacaraṇ vā bhūmilagnacaraṇārḍ vā tadupasthānaṃ kuryyāt | tatrāpi kṛtālirvā ūrvabāhurvā kuryyāt | ava sandhyācayaprakrame kṛtāñjalirvā ūī- bāhuti tulyavaddikalpābhidhānāt-. . "sāyaṃprātarupasthānaṃ kuryāt prāñjalirānataḥ | jaībāhuśca madhyānhe tathā sūryasya darśanāt" | iti hārītkkā vyavasthā gbhilīyavyatiriktaviṣayā || 12 ||... laghuguruprayāsasādhyānāmasaṃsalapārthivādīnāṃ vikalpamupaprā- dayati yattreti | yatra prayāsabhūyastvaṃ tatra śreyas'pi bhūyastvaṃ manīṣiṇ bruvate | tatra hetu: kṛcchrāditi | yasmāt prayāsāt kamma pradīpaḥ | [ 2pra. 1kha ] tiṣṭheddavanātpūrvī madhyamāmapi śaktitaḥ | āsītḍūyā cāntyāṃ sandhyāṃ pūrvvatrikaṃ japan ||14|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | 162 anantarañca - pūrvva saṃdhyāṃ praṇavamahāvyāhṛtisāvitrīrūpatrikaṃ japanā udayāt sūrydayaparyantaṃ tiṣṭhet | utthit bhavedityarthaḥ | madhyamāmapi sandhyāṃ yathāśakti trikaṃ japaṃstiṣṭhet | paścimāntu ā uḍūdayānanavadarśanaparyyantaṃ japannāsīta upaviṣṭaḥ syāt | pūrvāmityādidvitīyā'tyantasaṃyge tena sandhyārambhaḥ pūrv japasyā vadhiriti siddham || 14 || prabhā | śreyaḥ prāpyate tasmāt prayāsabhūyastvāt śreyas bhūyastvaṃ yukta miti bhāvaḥ | bhūyastvaṃ bāhulyam | śreyaḥ abhyudayam || 13 || tiṣṭhediti | pūcīmityādau sarvatrātyantasaṃyge dvitīyā | pūrvī sandhyāṃ pūrvatrika praṇavamahāvyāhṛtigāyatrīrūpaṃ japan ā udayanāt sūrydayaparyantaṃ tiṣṭhedut bhavet | prāta:sabhyāyā- mutthitaḥ san sūrydayaparyantaṃ praṇavamahāvyāhṛtiyuktāṃ gāyatrīṃ japedityarthaḥ | evamagre'pi | madhyamāmapi sandhyāṃ pūrvvatrikaṃ japan śakti uttiṣṭhet | aśaktī tvāsīta | antya sandhyāṃ pūrvvatrikaṃ japan ā udayāt nacatrdayaparyantamāsīta upaviṣṭ- bhavet | kampradīpaḥ | etatsandhyātrayaṃ prktaṃ brāhmaevaṃ yava tiṣṭhati | yasya nāstyādarastatra na sa brāhmaṇa uccate || 15 || [ 2pra. 1kha. ] pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | etat sadhyāvayaṃ kārsenktaṃ yadavīnaṃ brāhmaṇyam| śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 15 || prabhā | "praṇavaṃ pūrdhvamuñcāvyaṃ bhūrbhuvasvastataḥ param | gāyatrī praṇavaścānte japaevamudāhṛtaḥ" || iti ygiyājñavalkāvacanaṃ gbhilīyavyatirikta viṣayam | "praṇav bhūrbhuvaḥ svañca sāvitrī ca tṛtīyikā" | iti pūrvvamabhidhānādava ca pūrvvatrikamityuktatvād gbhilauyānā- mante praṇavakalpanānupapatteḥ | na cānte praṇavapraygapi praṇavatvena iyrekyāviruddhamiti tattvakārktaṃ yuktamiti vācyam | ante praṇavasya pūrvvamanutatvena pūrvvatrika mityanupapatteḥ | tāvatāpi vyaktaunāṃ catuṣkatayā virdhasyāparihārācca | pūrvvatrika mityanena hi pūrvtaṃ vyaktitrayamevktamiti dhyeyam | sandhyāsūtre'pi dhyāna- yuktamāvarttayedṃpūrvyāṃ gāyatrīmityuktam || 14 || upasaṃharati etaditi | yatra sandhyātraye brāhmaṇyamadhiṣṭhitaṃ sadetat sandhyātrayaṃ prakarṣeṇkta tatra sandhyāvaye yasthādarī nāsti sa brāhmaṇ na kathyate munibhiḥ || 15 || yadadhiṣitam, iti pāṭhāntaram |
kapradīpaḥ | [ 2pra. 1kha. ] sandhyālpasya cākartā* snānaśīlaśca yaḥ sadā | taṃ dṣānpasarpanti vainateyamivragāḥ || 16 || prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | srānaṃ sandhyāṃ ca stauti- nigadavyākhyātam || 16 || prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ| prabhā | sandhyālpāditi | cakita: bhītaḥ | sandhyālpasya cā karttā, - iti pāṭhe vyakt'rthaḥ | garutvantaṃ - garuḍam | uragā: sarpāḥ | atirhitārthamanyat || 16 || iti prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | sandhyālpāñca cakitaḥ, iti pāṭhāntaram | dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | vedamādita ārabhya śaktit'haraharjjapet | upatiṣṭhettat rudramarvāgvā vaidikājjapāt || 1 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | snānastutyā yathāhani tathā prātarityabhidhānāca snānakarttavyatā sūcitā, tadanantaraṃ ca smṛtyantarapathalcanayā madhye tvana udaye ca etatsandhyātrayaṃ prktamityanena ca sadhyktā, tadanantaraṃ kramaprāptaṃ japayajñamāha - ṛgādirūpaṃ vedaṃ prathamakāṇḍikāyā ārabhya adhyāyaṃ tadadirūpaṃ yathāśakti pratyakṣaṃ japet | tat rudramantrai rudraṃ prakāśayet | upapūrbā- ttiṣṭhateḥ prakāśanārthatvāt | upānmantrakaraṇe ityanena streṇātmanepada- vidhānāt| japayajñātpūrva vā rudramupatiṣṭheta | rudrpasthānamantraya, "ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇa piṅgalam | ūīliṅgaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpaṃ nam namaḥ" || 1 || prabhā | avedānīṃ japayajñamāha vedamiti | ādita ārabhya pratyahaṃ yathāśakti vedaṃ japet | vedajapādanantaraṃ pūrvyaṃ vā rudramupatiṣṭheta | rudrpasthāne ca, — - "ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam | ūīliṅgaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpaṃ nam namaḥ || iti sampradāyāgat mantraḥ || 1 || kama pradīpaḥ | [ 2pra. 2kha ] yaṃvādbhistarpayeddevān satilābhiḥ pitṛnagha | nāmānte tarpayāmīti ādāvmiti ca bruvan || 2 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | anantaraṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ kramaprāptamāha | ayañca kram gbhilīya- vyatiriktānāṃ vājasaneyiprabhṛtīnāṃ, gbhilīyānāṃ tu tarpaṇttara- meva japayajñavidhānam | ataeva gbhilena nam brahmaṇa ityupajāya cetyevamantenāgnistṛpyatu iti ca devāṃstarpayedapasavyena pāṇinā • rāṇāyanī śaṭī kaṣyavālāday divyā yamāṃścāthāmīyāṃstrīn piṭataḥ ln mātṛtaḥ trn patnāśca pitṛtarpaṇaṃ sanakādayaśca nivīta miti manuṣyadhamma iti tarpaṇamukkā, upasthānaṃ gāyatrāṣṭaśatādīn • kṛtvā ityādinā yathāśaktyaharaharbrahmayajña iti gbhilīya ityantena tarpaṇānantaraṃ brahmayajña uktaḥ | gbhilīyenāpi | "āsavane tu saṃprāpte tarpaṇaṃ tadanantaram | gāyatrīṃ ca japetpaścātsvādhyāyaṃ caiva vyaktita:" || prabhā | atha tarpaṇamāha yavādbhiriti | yavasahitā āp yavāpa- iti madhyapadalpī samāsaḥ | yavasahitābhiradbhirdevān, tila- sahitābhiradbhiḥ pitṝn tarpayet | tarpaṇavākyamāha nāmānte iti | tapaṃthīyānāṃ nāmr'nte tarpayāmīti ādau ca śramiti bruvan tarpayet | evaśca ṃ brahmāṇaṃ tarpayāmītyādirūpaṃ tarpaṇavākyamukta bhavati || 2 || satilādbhiḥ pitṝnapi, iti sva pustake pāṭhaḥ | [ 2pra. 2kha ] kampradīpa brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ prajāpatiṃ vedān chandāṃsi devān ṛṣīn purāṇācāryyān saṃvatsaraṃ sāvayavam | devīrapsaras devānugān nāgān sāgarān parvatān nagān sarit divyān manuṣyānitarān yakṣān rakṣāṃsi suparṇān piśācān pṛthivīmṣadha paśūn vanaspatīn bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidhamityupavatī || 3 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | iti tarpaṇānantarameva japayajña uktaḥ | ataeva tarpaṇamapi naita- hbhilīyānām | manuṣyāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuśamadhyenāñjaliiyena ca | tathāgnipurāṇam | "māgagreṣu surāṃstṛpyet manuṣyāṃścaiva madhyataḥ | pitṝṃśca dakṣiṇāgreṣu ekahi vijala | jalīn" | sayavābhiradbhivān satilābhitra pitṛstarpayet | nāmānte tarpayāmi nāmādau ca ṃmiti bruvan | tena ṃbrahmāṇaṃ tarpayāmiti tarpaṇavākyaprayga ukt bhavatīti || 2 || tarpaṇīya- tarpaṇīyānāha- bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidhamityupavītīti, tarpayediti śeṣaḥ || 3 || prabhā | tarpaṣīyānāha brahmāṇamityādinā | ityupavītīti, etānupa- bītī san tarpaye divyarthaḥ | satat sakkadivyuttaravākyasthamatrāpi kapradīpaḥ | [ 2 pra. 2kha ] atha prācīnāvt | yamaṃ yamapuruṣaṃ kavyavālaṃ nalaṃ smaṃ yamamaryamaṇaṃ tathā agniṣvāttān sma- pānna varhiṣadaḥ sakṛt sakṛt || 4 || atha khān pitṝn mātāmahādauniti pratipuruṣa- mabhyaset || 5 || 168 pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | avāpi tarpayediti śeṣaḥ || 4 || pitṝn mātāmahādīn tnityuktatarpaṇavākyena tarpayet | pratipuruṣañca tarpaṇasya virabhyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ || 5 || prabhā | siṃhāvalkitanyāyenānuṣacanīyam | tenaitān sakṛt sakkat tarpayet || 3 || atha prācīnāvītīti | anantaraṃ prācīnāvītī bhūtvā yamā- dn sakat sakkat tarpayet || 4 || atha svāniti | athānantaṃ prācīnāvītyeva khān ātmī ghān pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahān mātāmahapramātāmahabuddha- pramātāmahāṃya tarpayet | ava ca pratipuruṣamabhyaset tarpaṇam | cīniti sannihitalena buhmārhāt pratipuruṣaṃ vāravayamabhyāsaḥ karttavya: || 5 || kavyabāḍanavaṃ, iti pāṭhāntaram | blapīcāna, iti pāṭhāntaram | 2 [ 2pra. 2kha ] kapa jyeṣṭha bhrātṛśvaśurapitṛvyamātulāṃśca mātāmahapitṛ- vaṃśau ca || 6 || ye cānye matta udakamarhanti tāṃstarpayāmītyayama- vasānāññjaliḥ || 7 || atra ślkāḥ | chāyāṃ yatheccheccharadātapārtaḥ payaḥ pipāsuḥ kṣudhitttumannam | atrāpi tarpayediti śeṣaḥ || 6 || anyāñjalirityarthaḥ | atraikavacanādeka evāñjaliḥ || 7 || iti | prabhā | jyeṣṭheti | jyeṣṭha bhrātrādauca sarpayet | ye cānye ityayamava- sānāñjaliranyāñjaliḥ | tadidaṃ tarpaṃ pradhānaṃ piṭayajñarūpam | svānasūtre yattarpaṇamukta, tat snānāṅgam | tattu brahmayajñāt pūṃ- metattu japayajñādanantaramiti na virdhaḥ parataścaitat pravedayi- pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | vyāmaḥ || 6 || 7 || tarpaṇasyāvaśyakatva prajñāpaṇārtha ślkānudāharati atra ślkā- 22
170 kapradīpaḥ | bāljanitra jananī ca bālaṃ yṣitpumāṃsaṃ puruṣaśca yṣām || 8 || tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | viprādudakamicchanti sarve'bhyudayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 8 || [ 2pra. 2kha. ] pariśiṣṭamakāma: | atha ślkā ityanenāva smṛtiritivat smṛtiviśeṣābhidhānam | sarve tarpaṇauyāstarpaṇakartturabhyudayamicchanti | śeṣaṃ suñyatam || 8|| 8 || prabhā | chāyāmiti | janitrīmiti chāndas'yaṃ praygaḥ | janayitrī- mityarthaḥ | nigadavyākhyātamanyat || 8 || 1
tatheti | yathā'yaṃ dṛṣṭānta tathā sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca sarvāṇi bhūtāni viprādukamicchanti | bhūtaśabda: prāṇivacanaḥ | hi yasmāt sa vipraḥ sarveṣāmabhyudayasya karttā sarve'bhyudaya- kāṅgiṇa iti pāṭhe sarve viprasthābhyudayamicchanti iti vyākhye yam | vyatyayāt puṃstvam| sarve śudakakāṅkṣiṇa iti pāṭhe yasmāt sarve udakakāśiṇastasmāt viprādudakamicchanti iti gatena saṃbandhaḥ | avāpi puṃsā nirdeśaḥ pūrvvavarṇanīyaḥ || 8 || sababhyudayalaji saḥ kati pāṭhāntaram | [ 2 pra. 2kha. ] kama pradīpaḥ | tasmāt sadaiva karttavyamakurvan mahatainasā | yujyate brāhmaṇaḥ kurvan viśvametadvibhartti hi ||10|| alpatvāḍmakālasya bahutvāt snānakamaṇaḥ | prātarnna tanuyāt snānaṃ hmalp hi garhitaḥ ||11|| dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | yasmādudakamicchanti tasmādvighātecchājanitapratyavāyabhiyā sarvadā niyamena tarpaṇaṃ kāvyam | etadeva vyaktamāha | brāhmaṇ kurvan mahatā pāpena lipyate yasmāt kurvannetadviśvaṃ puṣṇāti, at'karaṇe pratyavāyaḥ || 10 || yathā'hani tathā prātarityanena madhyāhanānavadvistaraṇa prātaḥ- khānaṃ yadukta tanniragnereva sāgnistu prātaḥsrānaṃ na vistārayet | kintu saṃkṣepeṇa kuyāt | saṃcepatha ygiyājñavalknktaḥ | tīrtha- parikalpanajalābhimantraṇācamanamārjanāntarja lajapatrānānyaghamarṣaṇa- sūktena trirāvṛttnetyevaṃ rūpaḥ | tathāca, prabhā | yasmādevaṃ, tasmāditi | tasmādbrāhmaṇena sadaiva tarpaṇaṃ kartta- vyam | tarpaṇamakurvvan brāhmaṇ mahatā pāpena yujyate | kun punaratat viśvaṃ vibhartīti phalavādaḥ || 10 || alpatvāditi | mātama kālasyālpatvāt nānakamme eśca 172 kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | " snānamantarjale caiva mārjanācamane tathā | jalābhimantraṇaṃ caiva tīrthasya parikalpanam || aghamarṣaṇasūktena cirāvṛttena nityaśaḥ | nānācaraṇamityetat samuddiṣṭaṃ mahāmabhiḥ " || [ 2pra. 2kha ] hetumāha | hmakālasyālpatvāt snānakarmaṇ bahutvāt vistāre hmakālātikramāt yasmāḍīmalīp bhavet sa ca garhitaḥ, prātaḥkāle tasmāḍmārthaṃ saṃkṣepaṃ kuryyāt | nu prātaḥ karttavyaṃ hmasta ditahmināmudayānantara miti nānavistāre'pi na hmakālātikramaḥ | tasmādanuditahmaviṣayamevedaṃ vacanamiti yuktam | nevaṃ, uditahmināmapyudayātpūrvvamagnivitaraṇaṃ vihi- tam | tathāca gbhilaḥ | purdayāprātaḥ prāduṣkṛtydite'nudite vā prātarāhutiṃ juhuyāditi | tathā hastādūī raviryāvadityane- nāpa evaṃ hmakāla ukta: | vistareṇa ca nadyādau srānaṃ vihitam | tatatha snānavistareṇa nadyādita āgamanena ca sarvvamidaṃ lupyediti tasyāpi nānasaṃkṣepaḥ | evaṃ "pūrvva sandhyāṃ sanacavāmupakramya yathāvidhi | gāyatrīmabhyasettāvadyāvadādityadarśanam || prabhā | bahutvāt prātaḥsrānaṃ na vistārayet | snānasya vistāre hi hma- kālātyayāt hmalpa: syāt | sa ca viśeṣeṇa ninditaḥ | tadava kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | pūrvva sandhyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhet sāvitrmārkadarśanāt | paścimāṃ tu samāsnaḥ samyakṣavibhāvanāt" || sajytijytiṣāṃ darśanādityādinarasiṃhapurāṇamanugautamādibhi- ryaduktaṃ, tantriramniviṣayaṃ draṣṭavyamiti || 11 || dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | [ 2 pra. 2kha. ] 173 prabhā | prātaḥ snāna vistāraniṣedhāt saṃcepeṇa snānaṃ karttavyamityuktaṃ bhavati | saṃkṣepamāna vidhiva "sānamantarjalañcaiva tīrthasya parikalpanam | jalābhimantraṇañcaiva mārjanācamane tathā || aghamarṣaṇakrena cirāvṛttena nityaśaḥ | khānācaraṇa mityetat samuddiṣṭaṃ mahātmabhiḥ" || iti smṛtyantarādupalabdhavyaḥ | hmalpabhayena prāta: snāna vistārasya niṣedhāt yathā'hani tathā prātarityatideś'rthā viragniviṣaya- ityuktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ tulyanyāyāt tiṣṭheddayanāt pūrvvāmityā supa deg'pi niragniviṣaya: pratyetavyaḥ || 11 || iti dvitīyakhaṇḍa: | tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | pañcānāmatha satrāṇāṃ mahatāmucyate vidhiḥ | yairiṭvā satataṃ vipraḥ prāpnuyāt sadma śāśvatam ||1|| pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | sartaṇāntastrānānantaraṃ kramaprāptān pañcayajñānāha- atha snānānantaraṃ pañcānāṃ mahāyajñānāmanuṣṭhānamucyate | yairdevādīn satataṃ vipraḥ pūjayitvā sthiraṃ sthānaṃ brahmalkātmakaṃ prāpnti | tathā brahmapurāṇe | " prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ kriyāvatām" | iti | nitye cānuṣaṅgiphalamastītyuktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe | "nityakriyāṃ tathā cānye'nuṣaṅgaphalāṃ śrutim " | iti || 1 || prabhā | pañcānāmiti | athedānīṃ pañcānāṃ mahatāṃ satrāṇāṃ vidhi- rucyate yaiḥ savaiḥ satatamiyā brāhmaṇa: bhākhataṃ sthānaṃ prāpnti | sāranti ca, "prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ kiyāvatām" | iti || 1 || E [ 2ma. śkha. ] pa 175 devabhūtapitṛbrahmamanyuṣyāṇāmanukramāt | mahāsatrāṇi jānīyāttaeva hi mahāmakhāḥ || 2 || adhyāpanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ pitṛyajñastu tarpaṇam | hmdaiv balirbhaut nṛyajñ'tithipūjanam || 3|| pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | pañcānāṃ devatāmāha - anukramāicyamāṇāni | taeva mahāmakhā iti saṃjñāvidhiparam | śeṣaṃ nigadavyākhyātam || 2 || adhyāpanaṃ brahmadaivat yajñaḥ | evaṃ pitṛyajñādāvapi bddhavyam | dev bhauta iti sā'sya devatetyanena vihit devatātaddhitaḥ || 3 || prabhā | devabhūteti | anukramāddaśyamāṇāni mahāsatrāṇi devādīnāṃ jānīyāt | yāni mahāsatrāṇi taeva mahāmakhā mahāyajñāḥ | vidheyaprādhānyavivakṣayā puṃsā nirdeśa: | tathāca devayajña: bhūtayajñaḥ piḍhay brahmayajñ manuṣyayajñayeti pañcayajñā bhavanti || 2 || tāneva pañcayajñān vivṛṇti adhyāpanamiti | devbhauta iti devatārthe taddhitaḥ | nigadavyākhyātamanyat | pitṛyajñastu tarpaṇamiti tarpaṇapadena sannihitaṃ khtaṃ tarpaṇaṃ parāmṛṣyate | vyaktivacanānāṃ satrihitavyaktiparatvasya āgneynyāye siddhāntitatvāt | strktaṃ tarpaṇamupekṣya parktatarpaṇaparigrahasthānyāyyatvāca || 3 || kamapradṣaḥ | [ 2pra. 3kha. ] śrāddhaṃ vā pitṛyajñaḥ sthāpitagr balirathāpi vā | yaśca śrutijapaḥ prkt brahmayajñaḥ sa uccate || 4 || pariśiṣṭamakāśaḥ | śrāddhaṃ nityam | etena trayāṇāṃ piṭayajñatvādasambhave ekenāpi kṛtena pitṛyajñakriyāniṣpatteḥ pratyavāya: parihṛt bhavati | tathāca manu:- "yadeva tarpayatyadbhiḥ pitṝn snātvā hijttamaḥ | tenaiva sarvamāpnti pitṛyajñakriyāphalam" || samuccayena tu trayāṇāmupadeśaḥ sambhave bḍavyaḥ | yaca pūrvvaṃ vedamā- dita bhārabhya ityanena tijapa uktaḥ, s'pi brahmayajña uccate | pūrvaṃ tasya brahmayajña iti saṃjñā nktā, saivedānīṃ vidhīyate | etena dau brahmayajñāvityukaṃ bhavati | atrāpi sambhavāsambhavābhyāṃ vikalpa- samuccayau piṭayajñavadraṣṭavyau | bhaṭṭabhāṣye tu- "gurāvadhyayanaṃ kurvvan śuśrūṣādi yadācaret | sa sarv brahmayajñaḥ syāttattapaḥ paramucyate" || iti vacanādrahaṇāryādhyayanamapi brahmayajña ityuktam || 4 || prabhā | śrāddhaṃ veti | yācaṃ nityatrāham | pitragr baliriti | y'yaṃ balikamaṇi pitr balirdīyate sa vā pitṛyajña: syāt | tadevaṃ chandgānāṃ svaśāstrpadiṣṭastrividhaḥ pitṛyajñ bhavati, yācaṃ tarpaṇaṃ pitarbalibeti| tadava kasyāccidavasthāyāṃ amṣāṃ ekenāpi [ 25, 3khaḥ ] kapradṣaḥ | 177% sa cārvāka tarpaṇāt kāryya: pañcādā prātarāhuteḥ | vaiśvadevāvasāne vā nānyaveti nimittakāt || 5 || pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yaḥ śrutijaparūp brahmayajñaḥ sa pitṛyajñātpū kārthya: | ata- eva tadanantaraṃ yavāhirityādinā tarpaṇamuktam | paścāhā prātarā- huteriti aṣṭadhā vibhaktadinasya dvitīyabhāge dakṣkta'dhyāpanāmak- brahmayajñaḥ kāryyaḥ | tathāca dakṣaḥ | prabhā | kṛtena pratyavāyaḥ parit bhavati, samuccayena sarveṣāṃ karaṇantu sati sambhave jñeyam | yaśceti | vedamādita ārabhya ityanena yā jipa pūrvvamuktaḥ sa vā brahmayajña uccate | tadevaṃ chandgānāṃ brahmayajñ'pi svaśākhāparibhāṣit dvividh bhavati, adhyāpanaṃ tijapaśceti | bhaṭṭabhāṣye tu, " "gurāvadhyayanaṃ kurvvan śuśrūṣādi yadācaret | sa sarv brahmayajña: syāt tattapaḥ paramucyate" # iti vacanāt gurradhyayanaṃ tadānīntanaguruśuśrūṣā dika vyavasthā cāmṣāṃ pūrvkkadiśā ava brahmayajña ityuktam | seyā || 4 || sa cālīgiti | sa ca śrutiparūp brahmayajñaḥ tarpaṇāt kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | "dvitīye tu tat bhāge vedābhyās vidhīyate | vedakhīkaraṇaṃ pūveṃ vicārbhyasanaṃ japaḥ | taddānaścaiva śiṣyebhy vedābhyās hi pañcadhā" || vaiśvadevāvasāne vā vāmadevyajaparūp brahmayajña kāryaḥ | na ca vāmadevyajapasya kamāṅgatvāt na pradhānabahmayajñarūpateti vācyam | tarpaṇavat sambhavāt | ataeva dadhikhadirādeḥ kratvarthasthāpi puruṣārthatayā prādhānyam | ataeva valyanle vāmadevyagānāntik- y japaḥ sa brahmayajña iti bhaṭṭabhāṣyam | vākāraca vyavasthita vikalpapar brahmayajñasyaite vaikalpikā: kālāvibhinnaviṣayā- 175 [ 2pra. 3kha ] prabhā | pū] karttavya: prātamāt pathāhā vaiśvadevāvasāne vā karttavya ityuktakālatrayarūpa nimittāt anyatra na karttavya ityādarārdhamuktam | vaiśvadevāvasāne tu y'yaṃ brahmayajñaḥ sa balikama katvaiva kārya: | balyante vaiśvadevike iti vacanāt | sa cāyaṃ brahmayajña: vāmadevya- gānarūpa iti kecit | vāmadevyagānarūp'nya jipa ityapare | taime brahmayajasya vayaḥ kālā: aniyamena bhavanti | anye tu vāśabdasya vyavasthāvācitvamaṅgkurvvantaḥ tarpaṇāt pūrvaṃ śrutijapaḥ, prātamātparamadhyāpanaṃ, vaiśvadevāvasāne tu vāmadevyagānamiti vadanti | dakṣavacanamapyudāharanti, - "hitīye tu tathā bhārga vedābhyās vidhīyate | kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśaḥ | ityarthaḥ | iti kālarūpanimittatritayaṃ vinā na brahmayajñaḥ kārya: | ava ca kālpadeśādeva niyame siddhe yat nānyatreti niyamābhidhānaṃ, tasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ | brahmayajñasya nityatvāt kālasya ca tadaṅgatvāt nitye ca kiñcittyāgenāpyanuṣṭhānāt aniyame prāpte nimittatvena kālasyādhikāri viśeṣaṇatvāditarāṅga- velacaṇyāt tadātirekeṇānadhikārapratyabhijñānāva nityapraygākṣepa- iti || 5 || [ 2pra. 3kha. ] prabhā | vedakhkaraṇaṃ pūvaṃ vicār'bhyasanaṃ japaḥ | taddānañcaiva śiṣyebhyaḥ vedābhyās hi pañcadhā" || iti | aba kiñcivaktavyamasti | pitṛyajñastu tarpaṇamiti strktameva tarpaṇaṃ gṛhyate ityuktamādāveva | sa cārvāk tarpaṇāt kārya ityatrāpi svktasyaiva pitṛyajñarūpasya tarpaṇasya parigrahaḥ | prakṛtapratyayaśca nyāyya iti śāstratātparyyavidāṃ vacanāt | sannihita buddhirantaraṅgeti nyāyāt | āgneynyāyāca | brahmayajñādisāha- yarthyāccaitadevaṃ pratipattavyam | taccaitadanyāhaśameva tarpaṇaṃ pradhānaṃ pitṛyajñarūpaṃ brahmayajñānantaraṃ karttavyamattrktam | vānagranthe vanyādṛśameva tarpaṇaṃ khānāṅgaṃ sūrypasthānādanantaraṃ karaṇīyamuktam | tadanantaraṃ gāyatrījap brahmayajñaśca tatrktaḥ | ubhayatraiva prakaraṇāt prādhānya maṅgatvañca tarpaṇasya pratipattavyam | tathā khānasūtrapari śiṣṭam | kapradīpaḥ | [ 2ma. 3kha ] prabhā | "āsavane tu saṃgāpte tarpaṇaṃ tadanantaram | gāyatrīñca japet paścāt svādhyāyañcaiva śaktitaḥ || āpnavane tu saṃprāpte gāyatrī japataḥ purā | tarpaṇaṃ kurvvataḥ paścāt snānameva vṛthā bhavet" || sadatra āplavane tvityupakrasāt snānameva vṛthā bhavedivyupasaṃhārāca khānāṅgatarpaṇādanantarameva gāyatrījap brahmayaśceti śiṣyate | tasmāt srānāṅgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ brahmayajñāt pūveṃ, pitṛyajñarūpaṃ pradhāna- tarpaṇantu brahmayajñāt paraṃ karaṇīyamityavirdhaḥ | etenaitadviṣaya- bhedamaparthyālcayatā nārāyaṇpādhyāyena tattvakāreṇa ca brahmayajñā- danantaraṃ tarpaṇaṃ vājasaneyināmiti yaduktaṃ tadasaṅgataṃ veditavyam | chandgapariśiṣṭasya cchandgetaraparatvakalpanasthānyāyyatvācca | yaccā- paramuktaṃ tattvakāreṇa, snānāṅgatarpaṇaṃ pradhānatarpaṇasya prakṛtībhūttam | tena tasyāpi snānāṅgatarpaṇakālataiveti | tadapyayuktam | iy : saparikarābhihitayḥ prakkṛtivikārabhāvakalpanānupapatteḥ | sa cārvāk tarpaṇāt kārya iti kālavidhānena kālāntarakalpanā- nupapatteva | vistareṇa caitat sarvaṃ gṛhyasūtrabhāṣye vicāritama- smābhistatraiva tat draṣṭavyam | ava tāvat śrutijaparūpī brahmayajña- starpaṇādavak kāvye ityuktam | khānayanye tu snānāṅgatarpaṇāt parataḥ sāmajaparūpī brahmayajña ukta iti kasya kenābhisaṃbandha itya- pyanusandheyam || 5 || 2 kama pradīpaḥ | apyekamāśayeḍipraṃ pitṛyajñārthasiiye | adaivannāsti cedany bhktā bhjyamathāpi vā ||6|| apyuddhṛtya yathāśakti kiñcidannaṃ yathāvidhi | pitṛbhy'tha manuṣyebhy dadyādaharaharhije || 7 || [ 2ma 3kha ] 181 pariśiṣṭaprakāśa: | nityā brāhmaṇatrayāsambhave yatkāryaṃ tadāha - ekamapi vinaṃ bahanāmasambhave adaivaṃ vaiśvadevavādarahitaṃ bhjayet | pitṛtṛptisiddhaye | na tu tarpaṇabalibhyāmeva pitṛyajñ- niṣpatra iti kṛtakṛtya: syāt | sa cātitherany bhjayitavyaḥ | tathā balidānānantaraṃ viṣṇupurāṇam -- prabhā | apyeka miti | yadyapar brāhmaṇ bhktā na labhyate, yadi vā aneka brāhmaṇaptiparthyāptaṃ bhjyaṃ dravyaṃ na vidyate, tadā pitṛyajñasya y'rthaḥ pitṛṇāṃ hṛptiḥ, tatsiiye ekamapi brāhmaṇaṃ bhjayet | ekasminrapi brāhmaṇe nityavāī kuyādityarthaḥ | taca nityayācaṃ devapakṣarahitaṃ karttavyam | pitṛyajñārthasiddhaye ityanenaitaduktaṃ bhavati, tarpaṇapitra balibhyāmeva pitṛyajñaṃ kvataṃ na sanceta | kintu sati sambhave śrāimapyavaśyaṃ kurvīteti | tābhyāṃ pitṛyajñaniṣpattistu kasyāñcidevāvasthāyāṃ bhavati || 6 || abhyuhṛtyeti | bhkkuralābhāhjyasyāparthyāsatvādā yadyekā kapradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭa prakāśa: | "tatī gdhamātraṃ hi kālaṃ tiṣṭhedgṛhāṅgane | atithigrahaṇāryāya tadūī vā yathecchayā || atithiṃ tatra saṃprāptaṃ pūjayet svāgatādinā | hiraṇyagarbha buddhayā taṃ manyetābhyāgataṃ gṛhī" || etadanantaraṃ ckaṃ tatraiva [ 2pra. 3kha. ] [ "pivarthaṃ cāparaṃ vipramekamapyāgaye nṛpa | taddeśyaṃ viditācārasambhūtiṃ pāñcayajñakam" | aparamatitherandham| atitheraviditāvārasambhūtitvāt śrāde pāvatvābhāvāt | ataevātithyādhikārī devala:- "na pṛcchehvacaraṇa svādhyāyaṃ deśajanmanī | bhikṣit brāhmaṇeranaṃ dadyādevāvicārayan" || iti | parāśaraḥ - ."na pṛcchehvacaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ janma caiva hi | khaścittaṃ bhāvayettasmin vyāsaḥ khayamupāgataḥ" || tathā yamaḥ- "deśaṃ gvaṃ kulaṃ vidyāmavāyeṃ y nivedayet | vaivasvateṣu dharmeṣu vāntāś sa nirucyate" || prabhā | mitrapi brāhmaṇe nityatrājakaraṇaṃ na sambhavati, tadā pakkādatrāt kampradīpaḥ | pariśiṣṭaprakāśaḥ | yadi tvapyek'pyanyastadeśy nāsti śrāibhktā, bhjyaṃ vā brāhmaṇahaptave paryāptanāsti, tadā sthātyā avamuhṛtya pitṛbhy- manuṣyebhyaya sanakādibhy'tithidvije dayāt | ubhayḥ bāhaṃ kuryyādityarthaḥ | etena manuṣyāṇāṃ nityavāī nāstīti mahārṇava prakāśtaṃ nirast㌚m | ataeva kārṇājinaḥ | [ 2 pra. 3kha ] "damāṃścaivāsane dayāna tu pāṇau kadācana | pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāmevaṃ tṛptirhi śākhatī" | "nityatrāī pitṝṇāṃ ca manuṣyaiḥ saha gyate" | iti brahmapurāṇam | tathāca gṛhyāntaram | ālīyāmabhīṣṭāṃ devatāmuddiśya prāmukhamatithiṃ bhjayet manuṣyārthe iti| manuṣya- yā brāhmaṇasya prāmukhale yajamānasya śrāibhklabrāhmaṇa- sammukhāvasthānasya śrautsargikatvāt nyāyaprāptameva paścimābhi- mukhatvam | tathāca sāmavedīyaṣaḍ viṃśabrāhmaṇam | manuṣyāṇāṃ vā eṣā dik yā pratīcti | tathā jytiṣṭme śrūyate| prāca devā abhajanta dakṣiṇāṃ pitaraḥ pratīcīṃ manuṣyā: udīcīṃ asurā: apareṣāmudīcīṃ manuṣyā iti | atiṣyabhāve bhjyāsambhave vā bhikṣādikaṃ dadyāt | tenāpi piṭayajñaniṣpattirbhavati | tathāca śātātapaḥ | 1 prabhā | yathāśakti kiñcidamyanamuhṛtya pitṝn manuṣyāṃśca divyān sanakādīkampradīpaḥ | [ 2ma. 3kha. ] pitṛbhya idamityuktā khadhākāramudīrayet | hantakāra manuṣyebhyastadante ninayedapaḥ || 8 || pariśiṣṭa prakāśa: | "bhikṣāṃ vā puṣkalaṃ vāpi hantakāramathāpi vā | asambhave sadā dadyādudapātramathāpi vā || grāsamātrā bhaveśikṣā puṣkalaṃ tu caturguṇam | puṣkalāni tu catvāri hantakāraṃ vidurbudhā : " || iti | viṣṇupurāṇañca - "dadyāñca bhikṣāvitayaṃ parivrāibrahmacāriṇe | icchayā ca nar dayādibhave satyavāritam || ityete'tithayaḥ prktā: prāguktā bhikṣavaca ye | caturaḥ pūjayenetān tṛyajñarṇāt pramucyate" || iti | dadyācceti cakāra: pūrvktātithibhjanena samuccayārthaḥ | saca sambhave sati | asambhave tu bhikṣādānamātrameva śātātapa- vacanāditi || 6 || 7 || yathāvidhīti pūrvvamuktaṃ vidhimāha | pitṛbhya
